Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.1
Items.Message: 夏草や、兵どもが夢の跡
Items.MessageLocalize: Remnants of a soldier's dreams!

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.2
Items.Message: 兵どもと言えば…私も、基地ではすっかり古兵ね。…年齢の話はしてないわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Speaking of soldiers and remnants, I'm one of the most veteran soldiers remaining on base. And no, I am not talking about my age.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.3
Items.Message: 私のかかとで踏まれながら豚と罵られたい、と…なるほど…くるくるぱーーーかーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: You wish for me to grind my heel into you while calling you a miserable pig? I see... WHAT YOU ARE IS A DUM-DUM!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.4
Items.Message: 今日は少しだけ時間があるの。ご飯でも付き合ってくれない？　その、あなたがよければだけど。
Items.MessageLocalize: I happen to have some free time today. Would you accompany me for lunch? As long as it's not an imposition, of course.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.5
Items.Message: ああ駄目だ…知らぬ間に相手を傷つける言葉を吐く…くるくるぱーもそのひとつね…。
Items.MessageLocalize: I must learn to stop using such demeaning language... "Dum-dum" is a prime example.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.6
Items.Message: 鳴かぬなら鳴かせてみせよう時鳥
Items.MessageLocalize: If the cuckoo does not sing, make it sing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.7
Items.Message:
あの雲は稲妻を待つたより哉…
せやぁ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Clouds above. Lightning brims within. Soon to fall.
Haah!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.8
Items.Message: この私がかつて天使と呼ばれていたなんてね。自分でも笑っちゃう。
Items.MessageLocalize: Even I find it rather comical that I used to be known as an angel.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.9
Items.Message: あなたに捧げるわ。私のすべてを。
Items.MessageLocalize: I offer you my everything.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.10
Items.Message:
司令塔だったことが司令官の職でも活かせていただなんて、
不思議な縁ね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
To think I'd be able to put my experience as point guard to use in this field, too.
Life works in mysterious ways.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.11
Items.Message: この右腕が戦場ではキャンサーを屠り、コート内ではシュートを決め続けた最強の相棒よ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This right arm of mine is my greatest ally. On the court, it sank shots...and on the battlefield, it sinks Cancers.

Items.Label: CardVoice.STezuka03.12
Items.Message: この制服、すごくフィットしていいのだけどすごく蒸れる…。
Items.MessageLocalize: I appreciate the slim fit of this uniform, but it does get me hot and sweaty...

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.1
Items.Message: おらも司令官にはうんざりだぁーーー！！ セラフ一揆すっだーーーーーーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'M TIRED OF THE COMMANDER TOO!!! GRAB YOUR SERAPHIM! IT'S TIME TO RIOT!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.2
Items.Message: づかっちゃんズゴックとがっちゃんこづかっちゃんズゴックとがっちゃんこづかっちゃんズゴックとがっちゃんこ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Bazooka's such a sucker Bazooka's such a sucker Bazooka's such a sucker.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.3
Items.Message: ログインボーナス？　なんですかそれは？　代わりにこの飴ちゃんをどうぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Login bonus? What in the world is that? Here, have a lolly instead.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.4
Items.Message: 司令官…あなたが犯人だったんですね…。『フロートバイカーの探偵日誌』大ヒット上映中。
Items.MessageLocalize: Commander...so you were the culprit this whole time... "The Hoverbiker Detective's Diary", now playing in cinemas.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.5
Items.Message: ハブユビーンナグッボーイ？　グッナーイ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Have ya been a good boy? G'night.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.6
Items.Message: ドントウォーリー、ドントウォーリー、いつでもこれで駆けつけるからね、ドントウォーリー。
Items.MessageLocalize: No wuckas, no wuckas. I'll come to you any moment on this bad boy. No wuckas.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.7
Items.Message: ばるるーん！　すみません、たまにバイク乗りの雰囲気を醸し出すために言ってることがあります。
Items.MessageLocalize: Vroom! My apologies. I sometimes make that sound to get a bike-riding mood going.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.8
Items.Message: 我が名はバイク乗り！　ゲームの世界よりこの地へ来た！　そなたたちはプレイヤーか！
Items.MessageLocalize: My name is Bike Rider! I have traveled far from the world of video games! Are you lot players?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.9
Items.Message: すみません…見えちゃってますよね…大事なところが…恥ずかしい…耳の奥が…。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am sorry... You saw it, didn't you? My most important secret... This is so embarrassing... You saw the inner part of my ear...

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase03.10
Items.Message: キャンユーヒアミベイベー？　訊いてなきゃ轢くぜ、ベイベー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Can ya hear me, baby? If ya can't hear me, I'll run ya over, baby.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.1
Items.Message: 七麦七米七七海。七麦七米なにゃ…。言いたかっただけで、特に意味はありません。
Items.MessageLocalize: One Nanami, two Nanami, three Nanami, four. Sorry, the urge struck me to recite that all of a sudden. Don't pay it any mind.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.2
Items.Message: ログインボーナスは支給済みです。タップしてもあげません。
Items.MessageLocalize: You have already received today's login bonus. Tapping me will accomplish nothing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.3
Items.Message: 点呼を開始してください。…総員６名現在員０名。私はひとりで何をやっているのでしょうか。
Items.MessageLocalize: Please count off for roll call. Hm... Zero out of six present. What am I doing out here by my lonesome, I wonder.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.4
Items.Message: ななみんなどと、あだ名を付けてきたのは茅森さんが初めてです。私には可愛すぎる気もしますが。
Items.MessageLocalize: Kayamori is the first person who has ever given me a nickname. I must say that "Nanamin" is a bit too cutesy, though.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.5
Items.Message: 輝く天馬でお届けします。穏やかなる祝福を、あなたに。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am here on an ebullient flying stallion to deliver unto you a pleasant benediction.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.6
Items.Message: なぜこんな不安定な乗り方なのか？　このスカートで跨ると見えてしまうからです。何がとは言いません。
Items.MessageLocalize: Why this unsafe riding style, you ask? Were I to spread my legs and straddle my mount, you could see something you're not meant to. I will not specify what.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.7
Items.Message: …さようなら。散りゆく花の美しさを、私は忘れません。
Items.MessageLocalize: Farewell. Never shall I forget the beauty of petals drifting on the wind.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.8
Items.Message: あたたかな日差しですね。職務を忘れることは出来ませんが、一息つくのもいいですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's warm and sunny out today. I cannot shirk my responsibilities, but stopping to smell the roses won't hurt.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.9
Items.Message: この羽、とても温かいです。どこから来たのでしょう。空で天使が羽ばたいてるのかも…なんて。
Items.MessageLocalize: This feather is very warm. I must wonder where it came from. Perhaps an angel in heaven is flapping her wings... Haha.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NNanase04.10
Items.Message: 盗んだバイクがこんな豪奢だったなら、尾崎豊は走り出さず見入っていたでしょう。
Items.MessageLocalize: If the motorcycle he stole had been this beautiful, Yutaka Ozaki would have been too busy staring at it to take off on it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.1
Items.Message: あたしの伝説はこれから始まる！
Items.MessageLocalize: My legend begins now!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.2
Items.Message: バスバスバスバスバスバスドコドコ！ピロピロギュイーーンニャイィーン！ってな具合に行こうぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's give it a whirl, like, ba-ba-ba-BAAAM! Gyrywryyynyyyn!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.3
Items.Message:
よう、あたしとデートしない？
あたしのエスコートに甘えてみなよ。昇天間違いなしだぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hey cutie, wanna go on a date with me?
Give me a chance and I'll rock your world.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.4
Items.Message: シガレットチョコにブラックの缶コーヒー、一息つくにはこの組み合わせがやっぱ最強だな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nothing beats candy cigarettes and a canned coffee when taking a good ol' break.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.5
Items.Message:
終わりにしようぜ…
ざっとこんなもんだぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Let's finish this.
And that about does it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.6
Items.Message: 役不足ながら部隊長を務めさせてもらってるけどさ、そもそも役不足の使い方って合ってる？
Items.MessageLocalize: I might be underqualified for this whole squad leader dealio, but I'll do my best. No, wait, why would you put someone underqualified in this position?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.7
Items.Message: みんなと笑ってたい。それは贅沢かな。でもそうしてたい。
Items.MessageLocalize: I just want to keep laughing with everyone... Is that too much to ask? Regardless, that's what I want.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.8
Items.Message: 夢幻泡影はさ…ケバブのカットにも適してると思うんだ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Honestly, I think this "Ephemeral Cascade" thing... might be useful for slicing kebab meat!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.9
Items.Message:
今日の調子は皆さんいかがかな
あまり無理をせず演りましょう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
How's everyone doing today?
Let's take it easy this time.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.10
Items.Message: 夢幻泡影修学旅行、行くのは東京バスでは嘔吐、そのあときみと回るメリーゴーランド、そんでまた嘔吐。
Items.MessageLocalize: Getting motion sickness on the bus, and then repeating that same experience at the merry-go-round. It's just vomit all over on this field trip.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori03.11
Items.Message: …あたしは、自分を、みんなを信じる！ そして大切なものを守りたい！ みんなはどうさ！？
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm going to believe in me, in everyone! And I'll protect the things that are important to me! Who's with me?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.1
Items.Message: あたしの伝説はこれから始まる！
Items.MessageLocalize: My legend begins now!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.2
Items.Message: バスバスバスバスバスバスドコドコ！ピロピロギュイーーンニャイィーン！ってな具合に行こうぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's give it a whirl, like, ba-ba-ba-BAAAM! Gyrywryyynyyyn!!!

Items.Message:
よう、あたしとデートしない？
あたしのエスコートに甘えてみなよ。昇天間違いなしだぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hey cutie, wanna go on a date with me?
Give me a chance and I'll rock your world.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.4
Items.Message: シガレットチョコにブラックの缶コーヒー、一息つくにはこの組み合わせがやっぱ最強だな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nothing beats candy cigarettes and a canned coffee when taking a good ol' break.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.5
Items.Message: これがルカ王の裁きだ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Verily, heed the decree of King Ruka!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.6
Items.Message:
そんなところジロジロ見てるとさぁ、
後ろのナイトさんに
八つ裂きにされちゃうよぉ？
Items.MessageLocalize: Keep on staring and I might have to set my loyal knight onto you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.7
Items.Message:
ユッキーくん、お手柄だ。
この足を組み替えるところを
真正面からガン見させてあげよう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Fine work, Knight Yukkie.
As a reward I'll let you watch me re-cross my legs from head on!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.8
Items.Message:
ユッキーくん、お手柄だ。
ロイヤルなティーをご馳走しよう。
口移しで。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Fine work, Knight Yukkie.
As a reward I'll let you have some royal tea... straight from my mouth!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.9
Items.Message:
ユッキーくん、お手柄だ。
ユキちゃーーーーーんショック！！
の使用を許可しよう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Fine work, Knight Yukkie.
As a reward I'll let you use the phrase "Yukkie is shooketh!"!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.10
Items.Message:
ルカ様…
そのように御御足を組まれると、
淫らに…いえ、そのままで…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Your Majesty. Crossing your legs like that is highly indecent... Ah! Keep them crossed!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori08.11
Items.Message:
ルカ様。食事の時間ですが、
この世界観でラーメンと餃子を
作らせるのはいかがなものかと。
Items.MessageLocalize: Your Majesty. It is dinner time. But do you really think it is appropriate to order ramen and dumplings when dressed as Western royalty?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.1
Items.Message: あたしの伝説はこれから始まる！
Items.MessageLocalize: My legend begins now!

Items.Message: バスバスバスバスバスバスドコドコ！ピロピロギュイーーンニャイィーン！ってな具合に行こうぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's give it a whirl, like, ba-ba-ba-BAAAM! Gyrywryyynyyyn!!!

よう、あたしとデートしない？
あたしのエスコートに甘えてみなよ。昇天間違いなしだぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hey cutie, wanna go on a date with me?
Give me a chance and I'll rock your world.

Items.Message: シガレットチョコにブラックの缶コーヒー、一息つくにはこの組み合わせがやっぱ最強だな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nothing beats candy cigarettes and a canned coffee when taking a good ol' break.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.5
Items.Message: ＫＯＩ、恋　ＫＯＩ、恋、盲目になってなんでも出来るぜ　素っ裸でも歩ける　ただポリ公には捕まるぜ
Items.MessageLocalize: It's luv, it's luvvy duvvy, it's love, it's lovey dovey. Now you're lovestruck, you can do anything you want. So you wanna run around naked? Do you! Well, until the cops stop you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.6
Items.Message: いつしかひとはこう呼んだ…She is DIVAと！
Items.MessageLocalize: Before long, they would know her as... She is DIVA!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.7
Items.Message: セリーヌディオンより、くそうるさい音楽が好きぃー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Be it Celine Dion or anyone else, just make it loud!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.8
Items.Message: このドレスって体のライン丸見えじゃん！　攻めすぎてない！？
Items.MessageLocalize: This dress shows off every freakin' line and curve of my body! Isn't it a bit too spicy?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.9
Items.Message: 馬子にも小判って奴さ！　いや違うな…猫の額にも衣装って奴さ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Gotta put your pearls before swine! Wait, uhh, that's not how it went... Even pigs deserve lipstick!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.10
Items.Message: ユッキー見て見てー！　抱きしめてあげるー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Yukkie, come take a look at this! Lemme give you a huuug!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori09.11
Items.Message: きみだけにーきみだけにーさよならをー言うために出会ったなんて嘘さー
Items.MessageLocalize: That bit about us meeting only to say goodbye? That was just a joke, y'know?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.1
Items.Message: あたしの伝説はこれから始まる！
Items.MessageLocalize: My legend begins now!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.2
Items.Message: バスバスバスバスバスバスドコドコ！ピロピロギュイーーンニャイィーン！ってな具合に行こうぜ。

Items.Message: ＫＯＩ、恋　ＫＯＩ、恋、盲目になってなんでも出来るぜ　素っ裸でも歩ける　ただポリ公には捕まるぜ
Items.MessageLocalize: It's luv, it's luvvy duvvy, it's love, it's lovey dovey. Now you're lovestruck, you can do anything you want. So you wanna run around naked? Do you! Well, until the cops stop you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.6
Items.Message:
準備完了、起爆…
すべてを凍りつかせる！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ready, set, and detonate.
Freeze everything!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.7
Items.Message: なんか結婚式の衣装みたいだね。ユッキーもドレス着てみようよ！　ほらほら、いーじゃーん。
Items.MessageLocalize: This is kind of like a wedding outfit. Put a dress on, Yukkie! Come on, try it!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.8
Items.Message:
おっと、終電じゃ帰さないよ？
一晩中あんたをエスコートさせてよ、お姫様？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh, no, you're not taking the last train.
Allow me to escort you around town all night long, Princess.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.9
Items.Message: 何ぼーっと見つめてんのさ。あんまり無防備だと、その瑞々しい唇ごと、あたしのものにしちまうぜ？
Items.MessageLocalize: What're you staring at me for? If you don't keep your guard up, I might just steal those pretty lips of yours.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.10
Items.Message: 『あたしの伝説はこれから始まる』って、いい加減始めようぜ！
Items.MessageLocalize: "My legend begins now"? C'mon, let's get it started already!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori11.11
Items.Message:
白は嘘を隠せない色だ。
だから正直に告げよう…あんたに惹かれてるのさ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
White hides no lies.
So I'll be honest...I'm drawn to you.

Items.Message: あたしの伝説はこれから始まる！
Items.MessageLocalize: My legend begins now!

Items.MessageLocalize: It's luv, it's luvvy duvvy, it's love, it's lovey dovey. Now you're lovestruck, you can do anything you want. So you wanna run around naked? Do you! Well, until the cops stop you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.6
Items.Message: ショータイムだ。あんたの心、あたしが頂戴する！　take your heart.
Items.MessageLocalize: It's showtime. I'll be the one to steal your heart! Take your heart!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.7
Items.Message: ペルソナーー！！ってつい叫びたくなるな。魂が震える感じがするぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This totally makes me want to go "PERSONA!" Real soul-shaking stuff.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.8
Items.Message: へいらっしゃい、怪盗印の予告状だよ！　一枚、二枚…ええい持ってけ泥棒、もう一枚おまけだぁ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Here you go, a phantom thief's calling card! There's one, two...fine, have another, you thief!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.9
Items.Message: 今宵オタカラを頂きに参上します…。あたしに盗めないものはないのさ、覚悟はいいかい？
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll be coming to steal the treasure tonight...and there's nothing I can't take. Are you ready?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.10
Items.Message: ジョーカーの淹れるコーヒー、すげーうまい。これとシガレットチョコで…ふう、落ち着く。
Items.MessageLocalize: Joker serves some crazy good coffee. Goes perfect with a candy cigarette... Phew. Really calms my nerves.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RKayamori12.11
Items.Message: ワイヤーとトランスポートの合わせ技で縦横無尽さ。捕まえたいならここまでおいで。
Items.MessageLocalize: Between my grappling hook and teleportation, I can move like nobody else. Don't come near unless you you want to get caught.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.1
Items.Message: Hello world
Items.MessageLocalize: Hello world

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.2
Items.Message: オーキッド所属のハッカーをやってた。今でもその一員であったことをあたしは誇りに思ってるぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I used to be a hacker of the Orchids. Honestly, I'm still pretty proud to have been a member.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.3
Items.Message: KETSUの調子がわりーな。ってあたしのケツみてーじゃねーか。そっちは快調だよ。って何言わせんだよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: ASS is acting up... shit, that came out wrong. My actual ass is fine. Wait, no, that also sounds wrong.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.4
Items.Message: バンマスをやってるだなんて当時のあたしに教えたら驚きのあまり空中で三回転半ぐらい決めそうだぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: If my past self heard that I'd be a bandleader one day, she'd probably flip 1,080 degrees. That's three whole spins.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.5
Items.Message:
実を結ぶために花は散る…
それをてめぇらにもわからせてやる
Items.MessageLocalize:
Flowers wilt to bear fruits...
I'll show you all what that really means.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.6
Items.Message: いやいや、あたしにはもったいねーよ！ 似合うわけねーだろ！ 無理だよ！ ぜってー着こなせねーよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Wait up, wait up, this is too much for me! Am I supposed to look good in this?! No, nah! Seriously, I can't pull this look off!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.7
Items.Message:
なんで笑ってられるんだよ！ 悦に入ってるわけじゃねーからな！？ 
壊れちゃってるだけだからな！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
What's with the smiling?! It's not like I'm feeling good or anything!
Just a bit off-kilter, okay?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.8
Items.Message: そんなに見たいのかよ…だったらいいよ、見ろよ…。ほら、なんの得もねーだろ…もう見飽きたろ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: You really wanna see this...? Fine, whatever, look all you want... you satisfied now? That was pretty pointless, wasn't it? I bet you're already bored of staring.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.9
Items.Message: こんな格好じゃ戦えないしドラムも叩けねーな…はあ、もう好きにしてくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I can't fight or play drums in an outfit like this... Ah, whatever, I don't give a damn anymore.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.10
Items.Message: くそ…ファスナーが締められねぇよ！ 慣れてねーんだよ！ すまん、代わりに締めてくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Dammit... I can't fasten this thing right! I'm really not used to this kind of thing! Hey, help me tighten this, would you?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi07.11
Items.Message: 脇丸出しになってんじゃねーか…なんなら横乳まで見えてねーか？すごい格好してる気になってきたぜ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: My pits are like, way exposed. Actually... can you see my sideboob like this? Damn... I look so ridiculous...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.1
Items.Message: Hello world
Items.MessageLocalize: Hello World

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.2
Items.Message: オーキッド所属のハッカーをやってた。今でもその一員であったことをあたしは誇りに思ってるぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I used to be a hacker of the Orchids. Honestly, I'm still pretty proud to have been a member.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.5
Items.Message:
鏡よ鏡、この世で一番醜いのは…
奴らってことで。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Mirror, Mirror, on the wall...
Who's the most hideous of them all?
Guess it's these chumps.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.6
Items.Message:
胸はだけすぎだろ！子供が読む童話なんだよ！セクシー要素要らねぇし、
あたしの役目じゃねーよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I think we're showing too much skin!
This is a children's story, dammit! It doesn't need sexualization.
And that's certainly not my job!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.7
Items.Message:
この毒リンゴ、食べたら
寝ちまうんだよな…そうしたらさ…
お前が起こしてくれねーかな…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
If I eat this poison apple, I'll fall asleep...
and then maybe you'll wake me up...
or maybe you won't.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.8
Items.Message:
鏡にまではだけた胸
映ってるじゃねーか！！
胸だらけじゃねーか！誰得だよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
When I gaze into this mirror,
all I can see is my cleavage hanging out!
Cleavage for days! Who the hell wants to see this?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.9
Items.Message:
こんな格好してたなんてぜってぇ
あいつらに言うなよ…
秘密にしてくれよな…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't tell them I was ever dressed like this! Keep it a secret, alright?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.10
Items.Message:
くそ、罰ゲームみてぇじゃねぇか…
なんだよこのでけぇリボン…
死ぬほど似合ってねぇだろ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Damn, this is like a hazing ritual.
What's with this big-ass ribbon?
I wouldn't be caught dead in this thing!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi08.11
Items.Message:
あたしが深い眠りについたらさ…
されちまうのかな…キス…。
Items.MessageLocalize: When I fall into a deep sleep, will someone come along and, you know... kiss me?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.1
Items.Message: Hello world
Items.MessageLocalize: Hello World

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.2
Items.Message: オーキッド所属のハッカーをやってた。今でもその一員であったことをあたしは誇りに思ってるぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I used to be a hacker of the Orchids. Honestly, I'm still pretty proud to have been a member.

Items.MessageLocalize: If my past self heard that I'd be a bandleader one day, she'd probably flip 1,080 degrees. That's three whole spins.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.5
Items.Message: ああ、ハックする！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aaaghh, I'm gonna hack it!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.6
Items.Message: ルカ様…あたしは一介の騎士でございますよ…。この手も汚れています…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Lady Ruka, I am but a humble knight... Even these hands are stained with infamy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.7
Items.Message: ルカ様…あたしはその…どこへでも、例え地獄であってもお仕えする所存であります…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Lady Ruka, I offer you my servitude... Wherever you go, I shall follow, even to the depths of Hell...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.8
Items.Message: ルカ様…ロイヤルなティーを口移しでご馳走…というのは、ご、ご冗談ですよね…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Lady Ruka, you would treat me to royal tea, mouth-to-mouth? S-Surely you jest...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.9
Items.Message: （髪、耳にかけるだけでこんな色っぽく…くそ…どきどきがとまんねぇよ…）
Items.MessageLocalize: (God, she looks so erotic when she tucks her hair behind her ear like that... Dammit, my heart's gonna jump out of my chest...)

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.10
Items.Message: いっそこのまま、ユッキーを遠くへ奪い去りたい。そんな気分。
Items.MessageLocalize: Knight Yukkie, I wanna sweep you off your feet and whisk you far, far away. Yeah, something like that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YIzumi09.11
Items.Message: 社交の場は苦手だ。ユッキーくん、ふたりでドロンしてどこかでいちゃつこう。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm no good in social situations. Knight Yukkie, let's sneak off somewhere and make out.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.1
Items.Message: 救世主様のお出ましや。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yer Savior has arrived!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.2
Items.Message:
ゆであがれ！
ゆで卵ぉーーーーーーーーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Get boilin',
ya damned eggs!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.3
Items.Message: うちが救世主っちゅー予言は今でも信じとる。せやけど、それよりも大事なもんが今はある。
Items.MessageLocalize: Am I the savior? Yeah, I still believe in it. But now, I've got even more important stuff that drives me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.4
Items.Message:
生きた金魚を飲み込んでもう一度吐き出してみてくれ？
それはな…超能力やない。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What, ya want me to swallow a goldfish and spit it back out alive?
That's just a party trick, not a psychic power!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.5
Items.Message: ヒットチャート急上昇からの急降下…それがRockstarや！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Risin' up the music charts in a blitz, and then fallin' off in a blink... that's what a rock star life's all about!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.6
Items.Message: この夕焼け…なんやろ、昔おかんと遊んでたこと思い出すわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Lookin' at this sunset... I dunno, it kinda reminds of me when I used to play with my mom.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.7
Items.Message: この港…最高のスポットやな。ええタコが釣れそうや。新鮮なたこ焼き用のタコ釣って帰ったろ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This harbor's a perfect spot to go fishin' for some octopus. I'll fish up a couple to bring back for takoyaki.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.8
Items.Message: そんなじっと見てくんな。恥ずいわ。でも、こんな格好今日ぐらいか。しっかり覚えといてくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Stop with the starin', would ya? It's kinda embarrassin'. But I guess this ain't somethin' you get to see every day, so be sure to etch it in yer mind.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.9
Items.Message: 仲間とこんな格好で世界救うんもわるない。なんか無駄に超能力者集団っぽくて痛々しい。
Items.MessageLocalize: Savin' the world with yer pals, wearin' cool outfits like this? Pretty sweet, honestly. Feels like we're like a secret group of super-powered heroes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.10
Items.Message:
思い出すのは工場越しの夕焼けと
サイレン、か…。
なんか心に染み入るな。
Items.MessageLocalize:
A factory in the sunset, and the sound of a siren...
It's got a vibe to it that speaks to the heart.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa07.11
Items.Message: えげつない数の海鳥飛んどるな…あれはカモメか？ウミネコか？あっぶな、フン落ちてきよった！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Look at how many sea birds are flyin' around... That a seagull or somethin'? ...Agh, it pooped on me!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.1
Items.Message: 救世主様のお出ましや。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yer Savior has arrived!

Items.Message:
ゆであがれ！
ゆで卵ぉーーーーーーーーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Get boilin',
ya damned eggs!!!

Items.Message: うちが救世主っちゅー予言は今でも信じとる。せやけど、それよりも大事なもんが今はある。

Items.Message:
生きた金魚を飲み込んでもう一度吐き出してみてくれ？
それはな…超能力やない。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What, ya want me to swallow a goldfish and spit it back out alive?
That's just a party trick, not a psychic power!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.5
Items.Message:
さかなさかなさかなー！
お魚が天国にご招待や！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Fish, fish, fish!
Let the fish guide ya to the heavens!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.6
Items.Message:
電気クラゲに負けへんで！びりびりを食らえーー！！ぐああぁぁー
自分もびりびりしてもうたーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I ain't losin' to some jellyfish shock! Eat this!!! Graaahhhh!
How'd I end up shockin' myself too?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.7
Items.Message: サイキックでモーゼのように海割ったろか！せやけど未知の深海の生き物ごろごろ出てきてキモいで！！
Items.MessageLocalize: So, I reckon'd I could use ma psychic powers ta part the sea like Moses! But then, I thought about all them deep sea critters tha'd come squirmin' on out, and yeah, no. Gross as hell.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.8
Items.Message:
西の美少女サイキッカーの
キュートなところ見せつけたる！！
ナイスバシャアや！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
The beautiful psychic from the West
makes her cute debut!!!
Yeah, that's how ya make a SPLASH!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.9
Items.Message:
タマがカナヅチなん気にしとった
からうちも浮き輪で過ごしたる。
これであいつも恥ずかしないやろ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I was worried that ol' Tama wouldn't be able to swim,
so I also brought a floaty ring with me.
Now she's got nothin' to be ashamed of.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.10
Items.Message:
なんやこれ！げじげじなんが
水着に挟まっとる！気持ち悪！！
見とらんととってくれ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
What in tarnation?! Somethin' nasty got inside
my swimsuit! It's freakin' gross!!!
Stop that! Don't look at me!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa08.11
Items.Message:
うちはめっちゃ泳げる。ターンも
バサロキックや。サイキッカーでも
あり、バサロキッカーでもある。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'mma real good swimmer. Got a clean turn
and a good dolphin kick. In other words,
I'm a dolphin-kicker AND a psy-kicker.

Items.Message: 救世主様のお出ましや。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yer Savior has arrived!

Items.Message:
ゆであがれ！
ゆで卵ぉーーーーーーーーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:

ya damned eggs!!!

生きた金魚を飲み込んでもう一度吐き出してみてくれ？
それはな…超能力やない。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What, ya want me to swallow a goldfish and spit it back out alive?
That's just a party trick, not a psychic power!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.5
Items.Message: スタジオ行こ！言われんでも行くわ！　これでも新生シーレジェの一員や！　あれはただのツンや！
Items.MessageLocalize: I don't need ya to tell me to go to the studio! I'm a member of the new She is Legend too! I'm just bein' a little standoffish, that's all!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.6
Items.Message: かますか？　やったりましょう！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ready to play? Let's jam!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.7
Items.Message: さあクライマックスや！　むずいんは月歌に回して、うちはパワーコード弾き倒す！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Time for the climax! I'll leave the tricky parts to Ruka and just pump out power chords!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.8
Items.Message: テンションぶち上がってタマが客席にダイブしよった！！　いやただ足滑らせただけか！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Dang, Tama's so hyped up she went stage diving! Wait, no, she just tripped and fell off!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.9
Items.Message: うちらも尊さを取り戻そうやないか！　めっちゃ尊い画になっとるはずや！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's reclaim what's dear to us! This oughta make for a precious picture!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.10
Items.Message: 楽しすぎて客席に背を向けてめぐみさんのほうを向いてしまいました！　なんか尊い！！
Items.MessageLocalize: This is so much fun I ended up turning my back to the audience to face you, Megumi! It's incredible!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MAikawa09.11
Items.Message: その音にちょっとビリビリ混じってますよね！？　ビリビリ最高ーーー！　ぎぃやぁーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: This sound kind of reminds me of zappies, you know?! I love zappies! GIYAAAAAAH!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.1
Items.Message: 真実は一つと限らない！
Items.MessageLocalize: There exists more than one truth!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.2
Items.Message: やっぱりわたしってお母さん似よね。つまり容姿にはとても満足してるってこと。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yes... I inherited my looks from my mother. By that, I mean I'm very satisfied and proud of my appearance.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.3
Items.Message: まさかピアノを習っていたことが軍に来てから活きるなんて思いもしなかったわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I never expected my piano lessons to find use in the military.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.4
Items.Message: 戦場でもステージでもこのわたしが支えなくちゃね。ほっとくと心配だもの。
Items.MessageLocalize: I need to be the one providing support, regardless of whether it's the stage or the battlefield. Leaving them on their own would worry me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.5
Items.Message:
銃と肌のお手入れは丁寧に…
それがはい、RockStar！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Maintaining your guns and skincare...
That's what being a rock star is all about! Probably!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.6
Items.Message: この姿を見てくれたらわたしに似てとっても綺麗って言ってくれるかしら、お母さん。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mother, would you be proud of how pretty I am, like you were?

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.7
Items.Message:
え！？ 今鏡に何か映った！！ 
赤く光る目のようなものが！！ 
誰も居ないわよね！？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Um?! S-Something just flickered in the mirror, like... two glowing red eyes!!!
There's no one here, is there?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.8
Items.Message: 人類は窮地だけど精一杯頑張っているつもり。だからこれぐらいの贅沢許してね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Humanity is on the brink, but we're really doing our best out here. So, please let me have a little bit of leisure time.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.9
Items.Message: ふふ…３１Ａの中でもわたしが一番スーツ姿が似合っちゃってて、なんだかごめんなさい。
Items.MessageLocalize: Hehe... I'm sorry, I look absolutely fantastic in this suit. No one else in 31-A even comes close.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.10
Items.Message:
なに悦に入ってるの？ 馬鹿じゃない。でもまあ、そういう年頃か…
束の間の休息ね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What are you gloating over? That's so idiotic... but I suppose that's an age-appropriate response.
Let it be a short respite.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo05.11
Items.Message: 鏡よ鏡よ鏡さん、世界で一番美しいのは誰？って尋ねたくなる気分、ふふ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mirror, mirror on the wall... who is the fairest of them all? Hehe, it kinda feels like the right thing to say here.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.1
Items.Message: 真実は一つと限らない！
Items.MessageLocalize: There exists more than one truth!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.2
Items.Message: やっぱりわたしってお母さん似よね。つまり容姿にはとても満足してるってこと。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yes... I inherited my looks from my mother. By that, I mean I'm very satisfied and proud of my appearance.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.3
Items.Message: まさかピアノを習っていたことが軍に来てから活きるなんて思いもしなかったわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I never expected my piano lessons to find use in the military.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.4
Items.Message: 戦場でもステージでもこのわたしが支えなくちゃね。ほっとくと心配だもの。
Items.MessageLocalize: I need to be the one providing support, regardless of whether it's the stage or the battlefield. Leaving them on their own would worry me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.5
Items.Message:
ロイヤルストレートフラッシュよ。
クイーンが足りない？
このわたしよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've got a royal flush right here.
It's missing the queen you say?
Why, that would be me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.6
Items.Message:
このわたしにベットだなんて、
勝ったら何をさせたいの？
言ってごらんなさい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You want to make a wager with me?
What would you have me do if you win?
I'll hear you out.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.7
Items.Message:
トランプを扱わせたら敵無しよ。
さあ、勝負しなさい。
ババ抜きか七並べで！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm unbeatable with a deck of cards in my hand.
So, let's see what you've got.
Your pick: Old Maid or Sevens!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.8
Items.Message:
必勝法を思いついたわ。
勝つまで続けるの。
そしたらいつか絶対勝てるわ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've come up with a winning strategy:
I'm not stopping until victory is mine.
That is to say, I'm guaranteed to win eventually!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.9
Items.Message:
ミッションコンプリート。
盤上はグチャグチャ。
負けはなかったことになったわ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Mission complete.
The tabletop's a complete mess though.
Seems like there's no clear-cut winner.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.10
Items.Message:
この体ごとベットよ。
負けたら、持ち帰っていいわよ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm putting my body on the line.
If I lose, I'm yours for the taking.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo06.11
Items.Message:
ハニートラップだってお手の物よ。
この体、指をくわえて
見ていられる？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Honey trapping's a piece of cake for me.
There's no way you can just sit there and stare with a body like this in front of you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.1
Items.Message: 真実は一つと限らない！
Items.MessageLocalize: There exists more than one truth!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.2
Items.Message: やっぱりわたしってお母さん似よね。つまり容姿にはとても満足してるってこと。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yes... I inherited my looks from my mother. By that, I mean I'm very satisfied and proud of my appearance.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.3
Items.Message: まさかピアノを習っていたことが軍に来てから活きるなんて思いもしなかったわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I never expected my piano lessons to find use in the military.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.4
Items.Message: 戦場でもステージでもこのわたしが支えなくちゃね。ほっとくと心配だもの。
Items.MessageLocalize: I need to be the one providing support, regardless of whether it's the stage or the battlefield. Leaving them on their own would worry me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.5
Items.Message: ラノベって小説はすっごく読みやすくて、頭がよくなった気分になるのはわたしだけの秘密！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll let you in on a personal secret! Light novels are really easy to read AND leave you feeling smart once you finish!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.6
Items.Message: 最後の一撃は…儚い。
Items.MessageLocalize: Always sad when a beautiful beast falls...

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.7
Items.Message: 晴れの予報だったのに…！　え、あれ、昨日のニュースだったの！？
Items.MessageLocalize: They said there wouldn't be any rain today! Wait, was that yesterday's forecast?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.8
Items.Message: 濡れ鼠…いや、雨も滴るいい女？　やった！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm like a wet rat... Oh, the dripping water makes my skin shine? Hooray!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.9
Items.Message: ねぇ、見て、お空も泣いてるわ…。え？　わたしが雨女なだけ…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Look, even the sky weeps... What do you mean that's my fault? I'm bad luck?

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.10
Items.Message: ねぇ、今日だけはずっとそばに居て…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Please stay with me for the rest of the day...

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo08.11
Items.Message: 花がいつか散るように、命もいつか終わる…それが世の条理。
Items.MessageLocalize: Just as flowers must wilt, human lives must end. That is the reality of the world.

刺激的でしょ？

It's time for the elite intelligence agent to show what's she's got.
Get ready!
Hot stuff, right?

Items.Message: ペルソナーー！！ってわたしも出してみたかった…！

This is a Hold Up!
Good boy, now just wait right there while I fill you with bullets.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo09.9
Items.Message: オタカラを盗む爽快感…『やったった感』っていうらしいわ。クイーンに教えてもらったの！
Items.MessageLocalize: There's this thrill to stealing treasure, a sense of accomplishment. Queen taught me all about it!

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo09.10
Items.Message: メメントス探索もこの諜報員に任せて。ちょっとそこのシャドウに聞いてくるわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: When exploring Mementos, rely on your trusty intelligence agent. I'll go question that Shadow over there.

Items.Label: CardVoice.TTojo09.11
Items.Message: ハリセンで味方がまともになるなんて便利よね。羨ましいわ、叩きたい奴が何人も居るもの。
Items.MessageLocalize: A paper fan for knocking some sense into your friends sure is useful. I'm jealous, really. I can think of a few people who could use a good whack on the head.

Items.Message: 呼吸をするように息の根を止める！
Items.MessageLocalize: Reaping your last breath!

Items.Message: 久々の休みだし昼間はずっとゲームしてよっと。そして夜には殺して回るぅーーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'll use this break to play some games I've been putting off.
And when the sun falls, it'll be time for KILLING!!!

Items.Message: 切り裂いたキャンサーの体液まみれぇ！！ もっともっと浴びさせてぇーーーー！！

Items.Message: スーツでキルする姿はクール。浴びるはキャンサーのジュース。If you want to能ある鷹は爪を隠す！

Items.Label: CardVoice.KAsakura05.10
Items.Message: ショートパンツなところがお洒落と思わぬかぁーーー！！

Items.Message: 殺れたのはたまたまです！ チャンスを作ってくれた仲間のおかげです！ チームが勝ててよかったです！
Items.MessageLocalize: It's only by chance that I got that kill, all thanks to my team's efforts! I'm glad we won!

ふぐ刺し薄すぎぃーー！！

Items.Message: ゲームでもするように息の根を止める。

Items.Message: 今までゲームはずっとソロだったけど…あなたとなら一緒にやってみたい。

Items.Label: CardVoice.KAsakura09.5
Items.Message: 戦場で仲間と背中を預け合ったり、基地で馬鹿騒ぎしたり、毎日が充実してる…あなたのおかげで。
Items.MessageLocalize: Life isn't so bad. I have comrades to fight alongside...and goof off with back at the base. It's all thanks to you.

Items.Message:
行くよ、カレンちゃん！
合点承知ぃ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Let's go, Karrie!
Don't have to tell me twice!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KAsakura09.7
Items.Message: はっ…こんな感じでゲームも一緒に遊べれば最高に楽しいのになっ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Hah... Would be nice if we could play a game together too...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KAsakura09.8
Items.Message:
ｅスポーツとかチーム戦とか、
全然縁がなかったけど…
あなたとなら最強！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've never thought about participating in eSports or joining a team...
But I think we make a great pair!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KAsakura09.9
Items.Message: 光があるから闇がある、光が強ければ、影はより濃くなっていく！

KARRIE IS BAAACK!!! Wait, this is just a dream?

Items.Message: マイホームグラウンド！出港しましょう！！七つの海を越えていきましょう！！

見えそうで見えない絶対領域！
ここから先は年齢制限がかかっています！

Items.Message: 見てくださいこの衣装！　なんと！　胸元が！　見えてます！　新規層が開拓出来てしまう！

Items.Message: ハロウィンって西洋のお化けも東洋のお化けも関係ないんですね…なんという闇鍋！

Items.Message:
後ろにお化け？
はっ、そんなの居るわけ…ぎぃやああああーーーー！！

There's a ghost behind me?
Hah, don't be ridic—GIYAAAAAAHHH!!!

トラックオラストリート…？

Items.MessageLocalize:
Truck oar street?
Do they flood the street to welcome seaworthy trucks?

Items.Message: どうか安寧な記憶を。

平和になったら今まで出来なかったことに挑戦してみたいです。
その…付き合ってもらえませんか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Once the world is at peace again, I'd like to do new things that I've never tried before. When that time comes, um...would you like to join me?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.3
Items.Message:
ぽかーん…はっ！こんなじっくり
見られることに慣れていなくて…
ぽかーんとしてしまいました！
Items.MessageLocalize: Oooh... Oh! I'm not used to being stared at like this, so I kind of zoned out for a second there!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.4
Items.Message:
こうやって一対一でお話しするのって緊張しますね。あ、あの…
ご趣味は？って、お見合いかっ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's kind of embarrassing to be talking one-on-one like this. So, um, what are your hobbies? ...W-Wait! This feels like an arranged date!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.5
Items.Message:
きみもパーティーにご招待！
Dance! Dance! Dance!
Items.MessageLocalize: You're also invited to the party. So dance, dance, dance!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.6
Items.Message: みんなぁ盛り上がってるかー！ど、どうでしょうか…？蒼井、ちゃんとアイドル出来てるでしょうか？
Items.MessageLocalize: How are you all doing toniiight?! ...H-How was that? Did that seem like the right attitude for pepping up a concert?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.7
Items.Message:
色んなことをやってみたいとは言いましたけど…さすがにここまで
やるとは思いませんでした！
Items.MessageLocalize: I did say I wanted to try new things, but I didn't expect something like THIS!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.8
Items.Message:
う、歌…ですか？聴いても、
笑わないでくださいね…？
約束ですよ…？
Items.MessageLocalize: You want me to...sing? Um, you can listen...but please promise you won't laugh, okay?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.9
Items.Message:
胸の下にお腹に太もも…こんなに肌を晒して歌って踊るなんて、もう
笑うしかないじゃないですか！
Items.MessageLocalize: This outfit... Singing and dancing while exposing so much skin... At this point, all I can do is laugh about it!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.10
Items.Message:
その首に口付け匂いを嗅いでたい
あるいはここで死のうか…Before I Riseってもの悲しい曲ですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: "...Breathe in your sweet scent. Or maybe this is the time to face my death." From just the lyrics, it's kind of a bittersweet song, isn't it?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi05.11
Items.Message:
ああーー！そこはそんなに見ないでください！そこだけはそんな
見つめないでください！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ahhh! D-Don't look there! Please, stop staring there, for goodness' sake!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.1
Items.Message: どうか安寧な記憶を。
Items.MessageLocalize: Peaceful memories upon thee.

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.2
Items.Message:
平和になったら今まで出来なかったことに挑戦してみたいです。
その…付き合ってもらえませんか？

Items.Message: 守れなかったひとたちのこと今でも憶えてます…苦しくて辛いですけど、それが蒼井の戦う理由なんです。
Items.MessageLocalize: I remember the names and faces of everyone I failed to protect. The memories eat away at me, but so too do they provide me with the will to fight.

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.6
Items.Message: 傾注！　出番だよ。ターゲットロックオン！　なんかすごいビーーーム！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Attention, please! It's time...target locked on! Fire, super duper crazy beaaam!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.7
Items.Message: 蒼井艦長化計画が発令中ですので、ぽかーんとはしていられません！　ぼかーんとやってやります！
Items.MessageLocalize: The Captain Aoi Protocol is currently in effect—I cannot sit around staring! I must get out there and start blasting!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.8
Items.Message: こ、こらっ！　規則はしっかり守りなさい！　…うーん、いまいち迫力が出ないなあ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Y-You there! I ask you conduct yourself properly! Mm...I'm not imposing enough for this.

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.9
Items.Message: 祝福の集中砲撃です！　今日誕生日のひとは名乗り出てください。蒼井が祝いに行きます！
Items.MessageLocalize: Celebratory barrage in progress! If today is your birthday, please let me know! I will send you some good tidings!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.10
Items.Message: あっ、びゃ、ビャッコ！　そんなにベルトを弄ったらズリ落ちて…あ、あーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: N-No, Byakko! If you keep tugging at my belt, it's going to slip—Oh nooo!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi07.11
Items.Message: あ、あの…そんなに一か所をじっと見られると、さすがの蒼井も恥ずかしいです…。
Items.MessageLocalize: W-Would you please stop staring so intently? I'm beginning to feel embarrassed.

Items.Message: どうか安寧な記憶を。
Items.MessageLocalize: Peaceful memories upon thee.

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.6
Items.Message:
夏です！　海です！　蒼井です！
ズキュンとやっちゃいます！
ラブリービーム！
Items.MessageLocalize:
It's the summer! The beach! And me, Aoi!
I hope your heart is ready!
Here comes my Lovely Beam!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.7
Items.Message: 見てください！蒼井、勝手に流れていってますよ！こんなプールもあるんですね！
Items.MessageLocalize: Look, the current is pushing me along! I've never swum in a pool like this before!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.8
Items.Message:
水着、似合ってますか…？
あ、ありがとうございます…嬉しいけど、恥ずかしいですね…えへへ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What do you think of my swimsuit?
W-Well, thank you... It's a little embarrassing, being praised like this, hehehe.

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.9
Items.Message: あっ、びゃ、ビャッコ！　背中の紐だけは引っ張らないで！　だから駄目だって…あ、あーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! B-Byakko! Don't tug on that string, of all strings! You're going to—Ah, ooohhh!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.10
Items.Message: ウォータースライダーですか？　す、少しだけ恐いので、一緒に乗ってくれると嬉しいです。
Items.MessageLocalize: The water slide? Honestly, I'm a bit afraid to go on it by myself. Would you join me?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi08.11
Items.Message: ハイパーサイメシアがあってよかったです…この楽しい夏をずっと覚えていられますから。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm glad to have hyperthymesia for once. I'll never forget this summer we had.

Items.Message: どうか安寧な記憶を。

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.6
Items.Message:
来て！　世界にもう一度光を！
White Halo！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Come forth and bring light to the world once more!
White Halo!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.7
Items.Message: 友情と、不滅…。素敵な花言葉です。この花が胸にある限り、蒼井は無敵です！
Items.MessageLocalize: A symbol of friendship and immortality... What a wonderful flower. So long as it is pinned to my breast, I am invincible!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.8
Items.Message:
ベルト…締め付け…強調？
蒼井の何が強調されているんでしょうか…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
This belt is cinched tight for...emphasis?
What of mine is being emphasized, exactly?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.9
Items.Message: ビャッコみたいに優しくかっこよくなれば、みんなも頼りやすくなるかな。ヴァゥゥ！　難しいです…！
Items.MessageLocalize: If I can acquire Byakko's strength and compassion, perhaps others will rely on me more. Grawr! Hmm, this is difficult!

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.10
Items.Message:
…綺麗な夜明け。周辺のキャンサーは掃討出来ましたし、少しだけ、
この光景を楽しみませんか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
What a beautiful dawn sky. The Cancers in the area have been eliminated,
so won't you join me in gazing at it?

Items.Label: CardVoice.EAoi09.11
Items.Message:
危なかったですね、ここは蒼井に任せて撤退を！　まだ戦える…？
分かりました、一緒に戦いましょう！
Items.MessageLocalize:
My, that was close. Get to safety! I'll handle the rest! Oh, you can fight on?
Alright then, let's do this together!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.1
Items.Message: インフェルノに焼かれな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Burn in Inferno!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.2
Items.Message: なんだよ…殺し屋が野菜スティック好きで悪いかよ…。好きなもんは好きなんだからしょーがねーだろ！
Items.MessageLocalize: What? Is it weird that a killer like me likes veggie sticks? Who cares! I just like 'em, okay?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.3
Items.Message:
野菜スティックが好きってあまり知られてねぇ自覚があるよ。もっと
推していったほうがいいよな…。
Items.MessageLocalize: I get that most people don't know veggie sticks are my favorite snacks. Maybe I should mention it more often...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.4
Items.Message:
あたしはまだ殺し屋なのか…？
違うよな…新しい道を歩き
始めてる、そんな気しかしねぇぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Am I still a killer? Nah...I'm taking a step in the right direction, on a new path. That's how I'm feeling right now.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.5
Items.Message:
ああー！
神に見捨てられ業火に焼かれろ！
それでも迎えにいくぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: You know what, go get smitten to hell or whatever! But I'll still come find you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.6
Items.Message:
あ、あたしと握手！？変な奴だな…こんな傷だらけの手握っても
楽しくもなんともねぇだろ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Y-You want to shake MY hands?! These rough, scarred hands?! What's so fun about that? You sure are a weird one.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.7
Items.Message:
こういうのはすももの領分だろ…！
視線お願いしますじゃねぇ！
可愛いとも言うなぁ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Isn't this kind of thing more suited for Sumomo? ...Stop asking me to look your way! And don't call me cute, either!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.8
Items.Message: う、ウィンクのひとつくらい出来らぁ！く、ううっ…！だ、駄目だ！どうしても両目閉じちまう！
Items.MessageLocalize: I-I can totally wink, no problem! Ghh... Damn, it's not working! I keep closing both of my eyes!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.9
Items.Message:
てめぇのハートを狙い撃ち！
殺し屋系アイドル水瀬いちごだ！
くあぁぁ、痛てぇ！激痛だぁ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
A shot, straight into your heart!
It's your girl, Ichigo Minase, the Idol Assassin!
...Dammit, this is SO frickin' embarrassing. I'm cringing so hard it hurts!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.10
Items.Message:
おら、じっくり見ろよ！見られるのが仕事だそーだからな！！
目に焼き付けて推しにしろよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Take a good hard look at me! Being seen is what this is all about, yeah?! So etch me into your mind, and be my fan!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase04.11
Items.Message:
そんな下から覗いてくんじゃねーよ！蹴り殺すぞ！いや殺しちゃ
ダメだ…素足でなぶるぞ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't go ogling from such a low angle, perv! I'll smash your head in!!! ...Wait, no, I can't go around killing people. Fine, I'll just give you a tiny kick!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.1
Items.Message: インフェルノに焼かれな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Burn in Inferno!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.5
Items.Message: 殺しの技術磨いてきたあたしがなんでツッコミばっかやってんだよ！ってまたツッコんじまったよおい！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm an assassin, not a babysitter! Why I always gotta be the voice of reason?! Crap, I'm doing it again!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.6
Items.Message: ステルスキルなんて性には合わねぇ！　オーバーキルだ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Screw stealth, that shit ain't me! Lemme just run in and blast 'em!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.7
Items.Message: スタイリッシュな黒のコートでかっこよくキメるあたしぃ！　こういうのを待ってたんだよぉ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hell yeah, I look sick in this black coat! This is the sorta outfit I been waitin' for!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.8
Items.Message: 太ももばっかじろじろ見るんじゃねぇよ！　次見たらヒールでぐりっとやっちまうからな！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Stop starin' at my goddamn thighs, unless you wanna take one of these heels straight to the face!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.9
Items.Message: 居なくなった奴らの思いも背負ってあたしは進む。黄色い薔薇に誓うぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I won't ever forget you or what you fought for, not for a second. I swear it on this yellow rose.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.10
Items.Message: 闇夜の薔薇は一層華やかに咲く。てめぇに手向ける鎮魂花だ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Roses are even more beautiful at night. I offer this one to you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IMinase05.11
Items.Message: 世界が眠ったみてぇに静かな月夜だ。最後がこんな夜もいいだろ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's so quiet tonight, like the whole damn world's asleep. It's the sorta night I wouldn't mind going out in a blaze of glory.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.1
Items.Message: ニブルヘイムで凍えろにゃ
Items.MessageLocalize: Freeze in Nibelheim, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.2
Items.Message: ビャッコが頭を舐めて毛づくろいしようとしてくるにゃ…子猫だと思われてないかにゃ？
Items.MessageLocalize: Byakko keeps licking my head and trying to groom me, meow. Does she think I'm a kitten, meow?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.3
Items.Message: にゃまむぎにゃまごめにゃまにゃまご！　どうにゃ、すももにかかれば早口言葉なんて余裕にゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: She meows seameows by the meowshore! Well, meow? Pretty good at tongue-twisters, aren't I, meow?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.4
Items.Message: 今日もひとを殺さなかったにゃ。硝煙の匂いも鉄臭い血の匂いも…遠い過去になっていくみたいだにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Another day passes without killing a person, meow. I'm slowly forgetting the scent of gunpowder...and with it, the scent of blood, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.5
Items.Message: にゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーー…茅森から猫版アレンジを頼まれたにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Meow meow, meow meow, meow meow meow, meow... Kayamori requested a cat version, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.6
Items.Message: 木枯らしの季節にゃ。邪魔すると！　雨になるにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A cold autumn breeze blows, meow. Step out of line...and you'll fall like rain, meow!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.7
Items.Message: にゃふわぁ…雨の日は眠いにゃ…そばに居るのはいいのにゃ、けど起こすんじゃないにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Meooow... Rainy days make me so sleepy, meow. You can stay here, meow, just don't wake me up, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.8
Items.Message: この服だと殺し屋に見えにゃい？　そうにゃぁ…花屋でも始めるかにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I don't look very much like an assassin in this, meow? Yeah, meow... Maybe I should open a flower shop, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.9
Items.Message: にゃに油断して見とれてるにゃ。今の隙にすももなら８回は殺してるにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Get your act together and stop staring, meow. I could have killed you eight times over by now, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.10
Items.Message: 黙ってれば可愛い？　いい度胸にゃ、顎の骨砕いて一生口閉じれなくしてやるにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Cute as long as I don't open my mouth, meow? Someone's got nerve, meow. How about I break your jaw so you can never CLOSE your mouth again, meow?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase06.11
Items.Message: 可愛さで悩殺…？　すももはついに直接手を下さなくてもひとを殺せるようになってしまったのかにゃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: So cute you could die, meow? I guess I've honed my assassin skills to the point where I can kill without even needing a weapon, meow.

Items.Message: ニブルヘイムで凍えろにゃ
Items.MessageLocalize: Freeze in Nibelheim, meow.

Items.Message: 今日もひとを殺さなかったにゃ。硝煙の匂いも鉄臭い血の匂いも…遠い過去になっていくみたいだにゃ。

Items.Message: にゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーにゃーー…茅森から猫版アレンジを頼まれたにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Meow meow, meow meow, meow meow meow, meow... Kayamori requested a cat version, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.6
Items.Message: にゃっ！　すもも隊、突撃にゃ！　Ｋｉｌｌ　ｏｒ　Ｔｒｅａｔ！　にゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Meow! Sumomo Squad, charge forth and conquer, meow! Slaughter or Treat time! Meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.7
Items.Message: 二股の尻尾を腕に絡ませると極上の気持ちよさらしいにゃ。特別にお前にならやってやってもいいにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I hear having a pair of pretty cat tails wrapped around your arms feels incredible, meow. For your treat, I'll let you try it out, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.8
Items.Message: 鈴を見る振りしてどこを見てるにゃ。どうやらその眼球、えぐり取られたいようにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I can tell it's not the bell you're looking at, meow. Seems to me like someone wants their eyes gouged out, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.9
Items.Message: お菓子をやるからいたずらしてくれ？　お前どうしようもない変態にゃ。変態は死ぬにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: You'll give me a treat if I give you a trick? That's some real perverted behavior, meow. And perverts deserve to die, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.10
Items.Message: この格好をしてるだけで五円チョコがいっぱいもらえるにゃ…。招き猫にでもなった気分にゃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Wearing this has people giving me chocolate coins left and right, meow. I feel like I've become a maneki-neko, meow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SMinase07.11
Items.Message: ハロウィンは昔、死者の魂が会いにくる日だったって柊木に聞いたにゃ。仮装に紛れて…なんてにゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Hiiragi told me that Halloween used to be a time when spirits would visit the world of the living, meow. They'd slip in among all the people in costume, meow...

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.1
Items.Message: 新鮮な「死」を見せてくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Show me an exciting death.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.2
Items.Message:
来たか。お前のキレ味のいいアレをじっくり見せてもらうとしよう。
舐め回すようにな…ふふふ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
There you are. Now, show me that sharp thing you have on you.
I'll take a good, thorough look at it... Hehehe.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.3
Items.Message: 何しに来たんだ。私は忙しいのだ。お前の相手をしている暇などこれっぽっちもない。帰れ。
Items.MessageLocalize: What do you want? Can't you see that I'm busy? I have no time to waste dealing with you. Leave.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.4
Items.Message: 基地内で私を見かけることがない？ 当然だ、研究所に籠もってるからな。会いたいならそっちから来い。
Items.MessageLocalize: What? You don't see me around base, you say? That's only natural, since I spend most of my time holed up in my lab. If you need me, go find me there.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.5
Items.Message:
無駄に綺麗な星空だな。
最後がこんな夜もよかろう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What a needlessly beautiful starry sky.
I suppose dying on a night like this wouldn't be the worst way to go.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.6
Items.Message: 皆が寝静まった夜は基地も静かになっていい。私に語りかけてくるのはデータのみとなるのだよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: The silence of the base at night is wonderful. With all the prattling people asleep, it's just me and my data.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.7
Items.Message: 女性の美はそれだけで強力な武器になるとか言っていた奴が居たな…。少しは気にしてみるか。
Items.MessageLocalize: I have heard that a woman's charms can be weaponized. Perhaps I should keep that in mind.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.8
Items.Message:
お前の目はどこを見ている？ 私のそんなところに興味があるのか？ 
ふふ…奇特な奴だ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What are you staring at? Am I so interesting to you?
Heh...you certainly have strange taste.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.9
Items.Message: 性能的にはどうだ？ 足を引っ張ることなどしたくない。役立ててくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: So, how am I performing? I have no interest in being dead weight, so make use of me as you see fit.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.10
Items.Message: なんてきれいな夜空ー、生まれてきてよかったー、とかのたまう連中には心底反吐が出るな。
Items.MessageLocalize: "Oh, what a beautiful sky! I'm so happy to be alive!" ...The vapid people who squeal like that make me retch.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi04.11
Items.Message: ひぐみんきれいー、とのたまってくれたら少しぐらいサービスしてやってもいいぞ？ 試してみるか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Want to try lavishing me with compliments like "Higumin, you're so pretty!", huh? I may well reward your efforts.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.1
Items.Message: 新鮮な「死」を見せてくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Show me an exciting death.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.2
Items.Message:
来たか。お前のキレ味のいいアレをじっくり見せてもらうとしよう。
舐め回すようにな…ふふふ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
There you are. Now, show me that sharp thing you have on you.
I'll take a good, thorough look at it... Hehehe.

Items.Message: 何しに来たんだ。私は忙しいのだ。お前の相手をしている暇などこれっぽっちもない。帰れ。
Items.MessageLocalize: What do you want? Can't you see that I'm busy? I have no time to waste dealing with you. Leave.

Items.Message: 基地内で私を見かけることがない？ 当然だ、研究所に籠もってるからな。会いたいならそっちから来い。
Items.MessageLocalize: What? You don't see me around base, you say? That's only natural, since I spend most of my time holed up in my lab. If you need me, go find me there.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.5
Items.Message: 私がすべてを解き明かす日も近い。そうだ…これからどんどん核心に迫っていくぞ。刮目せよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am so very close to unveiling the truth. The day when all comes to light draws ever nearer. Don't you dare look away.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.6
Items.Message: モルモットになってもらう。失敗は付きものだ。死んだらすまん。
Items.MessageLocalize: I want you to be a test subject...and tests often go awry. Don't blame me if you kick the bucket.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.7
Items.Message: どんな苦境でも、眠りから目覚めた世界は美しいものだな。
Items.MessageLocalize: It might be a harsh place, but the world is beautiful once you wake up and see it for yourself.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.8
Items.Message: お前、動悸が速いぞ。何をそんなにどきどきしている。なんでそっぽを向くんだ。こっちを向け。
Items.MessageLocalize: Your heart rate is abnormally high. What's got you so excited? And why are you turning away? Look at me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.9
Items.Message: 今日は衛生兵だ。痛いところはどこだ？　けつの穴だって診てやるぞ？　さあ、脱げ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Today, I'm working as a medic. Tell me where it hurts. We'll need to do an anoscopy, so hurry up and get those clothes off.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.10
Items.Message: 残念ながら恋煩いに効く薬はない。代わりに私を好きになってみるか？　きっと刺激的だぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm afraid there is no antidote for love. Perhaps you could try falling in love with me instead? I guarantee it will be stimulating.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi06.11
Items.Message: なんてきれいな青空だー、生まれてきてよかったー！　なんて私が言っていたとはな、ふっ、面白い。
Items.MessageLocalize: "Oh, what a beautiful sky! I'm so happy to be alive!" Hard to believe I actually said that. Most fascinating, heh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.1
Items.Message: 新鮮な「死」を見せてくれ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Show me an exciting death.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.2
Items.Message:
来たか。お前のキレ味のいいアレをじっくり見せてもらうとしよう。
舐め回すようにな…ふふふ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
There you are. Now, show me that sharp thing you have on you.
I'll take a good, thorough look at it... Hehehe.

Items.Message: 何しに来たんだ。私は忙しいのだ。お前の相手をしている暇などこれっぽっちもない。帰れ。

Items.MessageLocalize: What? You don't see me around base, you say? That's only natural, since I spend most of my time holed up in my lab. If you need me, go find me there.

Items.Message: 私がすべてを解き明かす日も近い。そうだ…これからどんどん核心に迫っていくぞ。刮目せよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am so very close to unveiling the truth. The day when all comes to light draws ever nearer. Don't you dare look away.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.6
Items.Message: 栄養摂取か…ココナッツタイムといこう。お前らにも分けてやる。
Items.MessageLocalize: I suppose some coconut will suffice for nutritionary needs. Gather round—you may share.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.7
Items.Message: 水着というのは案外機能的かもな。実験、風呂、就寝、すべて対応可能だ。普段着にしてもいいな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Swimsuits are rather versatile garments, suited for lab work, bathing, sleepwear, et cetera. Perhaps I could wear mine regularly.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.8
Items.Message: 視線に不感というわけでもない。脚に、胸、首…いや、うなじか。まんべんなく見過ぎだ、酔狂な奴め。
Items.MessageLocalize: For the record, I can sense when someone is staring. You seem to have quite the fondness for my legs, chest, and neck—specifically, my nape.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.9
Items.Message: 水着ごときで存外面白い反応をするな。なら、胸のチャックも下ろすとしよう…。何を本気にしている。
Items.MessageLocalize: That a swimsuit has you so flustered is quite fascinating. How about if I unzip the top? Please, I'm not being serious.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.10
Items.Message: 酸素を吸って二酸化炭素を吐き出すだけの非生産的な一日も偶には悪くない。
Items.MessageLocalize: Every now and again, a day where you do nothing but convert oxygen to carbon dioxide can be refreshing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHiguchi07.11
Items.Message: 女の水着をホーム画面に設定したら、隣の奴から白い目で見られるかもな。それともそういう趣味か？
Items.MessageLocalize: If you set an image of a swimsuit-clad girl to your home screen, people are liable to give you funny looks. But perhaps you're into that?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.1
Items.Message: 眠れ、イノセントレクイエム！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sleep now: Innocent Requiem!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.2
Items.Message: いちごさんとすももさんの訓練…。うーん、あたしもご一緒していいものでしょうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Should I really tag along with Ichigo and Sumomo's training...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.3
Items.Message: いたずらは駄目ですよ。人に迷惑をかける悪い子は、除霊しちゃいますからね。
Items.MessageLocalize: No tricks! I'll exorcise any bad souls who mess with people, okay?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.4
Items.Message: こじらじは～。いた～い話やこわ～い話、今日も楽しんでいってくださいね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Welcome to KozuRadio! Today, we have a fun selection of cringey and scary stories to give you goosebumps.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.5
Items.Message: 深淵を統べるコキュートスの楔よ…永久に昏く凍れ！
Items.MessageLocalize: O bond of Cocytus, ruler of the Abyss... Freeze in eternal slumber!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.6
Items.Message: 蝶は魂の象徴とされてきました。この子たちも、誰かが姿を変えているのかもしれません。
Items.MessageLocalize: Butterflies are often associated with souls. Perhaps these little ones are also souls taking this form.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.7
Items.Message: 白い服は神聖とされています。この服を着ていると霊力が高まる…気がします。
Items.MessageLocalize: White garments are said to be holy, so wearing this enhances my spiritual powers... Probably.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.8
Items.Message: この眼帯かっこいいですよね。赤い薔薇…情熱的でおしゃれで…決め台詞も冴え渡ります！
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, this eyepatch is so cool! Red roses embodying passion, and fashion... This really gets my mind churning, working on catchphrases!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.9
Items.Message: セラフも色や形が変わっています。すごく格好いいです。なんだか強くなった気がします！
Items.MessageLocalize: My Seraph has changed color and shape too. So cool! I even feel a little stronger.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.10
Items.Message: いちごさんとすももさんは、絶対にこちら側だと思うんです。あっ…内緒ですよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: You know, I think Ichigo and Sumomo are very similar to me... Ah, but don't tell them I said that!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi04.11
Items.Message: 最近、菅原さんから熱い視線を感じます。もしかして、何か視えているんでしょうか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Lately, Chie has been staring at me... I wonder, does she see something I don't?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.1
Items.Message: 眠れ、イノセントレクイエム！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sleep now: Innocent Requiem!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.2
Items.Message: いちごさんとすももさんの訓練…。うーん、あたしもご一緒していいものでしょうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Should I really tag along with Ichigo and Sumomo's training...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.3
Items.Message: いたずらは駄目ですよ。人に迷惑をかける悪い子は、除霊しちゃいますからね。
Items.MessageLocalize: No tricks! I'll exorcise any bad souls who mess with people, okay?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.4
Items.Message: こじらじは～。いた～い話やこわ～い話、今日も楽しんでいってくださいね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Welcome to KozuRadio! Today, we have a fun selection of cringey and scary stories to give you goosebumps.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.5
Items.Message:
Welcome to Diner!
エンジェルバーガーをどうぞ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Welcome to our diner!
Please try the Angel Burger!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.6
Items.Message:
セーフ…今日は見えても大丈夫なのを履いています。はい、いわゆる
見せパンで…あれ？ち、違ったー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
No harm, no foul. I'm wearing the type that are meant to be seen,
like idols do... W-Wait, no I'm not!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.7
Items.Message:
うぅ～…いちごさんたちがニヤニヤ
しながらこっちを見てますぅ…
ひゃああ！写真禁止ですーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Wahhh... Ichigo and the others are
all looking at me and grinning...
Eyaaah! No photos allowed!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.8
Items.Message:
はーい、注文を伺いに…
あれ？確かに今声が…。
もう、いたずらしちゃ駄目ですよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What would you like for—
Wait, I just heard a voice...
Settle down, now. No pranks.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.9
Items.Message:
いらっしゃいませ、お水をお持ちしました。え？コップの数が多い
ですか…？あ…あぁ～…あー…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hello there. I've brought some water to start with.
Huh? This is too many glasses? Uh, you see, well...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.10
Items.Message:
こちらお熱くなってますので、
ふーふーして食べさせてあげますね。
え？そういうお店じゃない…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
It's very hot, so let me
blow on it for you...
What do you mean, this isn't that sort of establishment?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi05.11
Items.Message:
上のバンズはクラウン…下のバンズはヒールというらしいです。
いいネーミングセンスをしてますね！
Items.MessageLocalize:
The top bun is called the crown, and the bottom is the heel.
Lovely names, don't you think?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.1
Items.Message: 眠れ、イノセントレクイエム！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sleep now: Innocent Requiem!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.2
Items.Message: いちごさんとすももさんの訓練…。うーん、あたしもご一緒していいものでしょうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Should I really tag along with Ichigo and Sumomo's training...

Items.Message: いたずらは駄目ですよ。人に迷惑をかける悪い子は、除霊しちゃいますからね。

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.4
Items.Message: こじらじは～。いた～い話やこわ～い話、今日も楽しんでいってくださいね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Welcome to KozuRadio! Today, we have a fun selection of cringey and scary stories to give you goosebumps.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.5
Items.Message:
最近、樋口さんがあたしの目をまっすぐ見つめながら言うんです…
『眼球を解剖したい』と…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Recently, Higuchi has been looking me straight in the eyes when we talk...
Apparently, she wishes to scoop out my eyeball and examine it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.6
Items.Message: 魔眼…解放！　宵闇を切り裂け、ヴィーナス・スプラッシュ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Powers...unleashed! Slice through the veil of night, Venus Splash!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.7
Items.Message: うぅ～。どうして水着って、こう…変にズレると気持ち悪いんでしょう…。直さないと…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ugh... Why do swimsuits feel so uncomfortable when they get bunched up? I need to adjust this.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.8
Items.Message:
よいしょっと。ひゃわわわっ！
食い込み見ないでくださーい！見ても見ないふりしてくださーい！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Alright... Hyawawawa!
Don't look at where it's digging into my skin! Or at least pretend not to!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.9
Items.Message:
水の精よ、我が聖痕に応え顕現せよ、邪悪を打ち払う力を！
な、なーんて。あはは…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Spirit of Water, my stigmata beckons you forth! Grant me the power to smite evil!
O-Or something, haha...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.10
Items.Message: 夏…それは魔性の季節。羽目を外しすぎたいた～い思い出…そんなお話をこじらじで募集しています。
Items.MessageLocalize: Here at KozuRadio, we're looking for your cringiest stories about going a little too far during summertime. Send them in anytime.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KHiiragi06.11
Items.Message: 水辺はあの世とこの世の境目と言われます。なので、プールとはいえ気を付けてくださいね？
Items.MessageLocalize: It is said that beaches act as boundaries between this world and the next. While this is only a pool, do be careful.

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.1
Items.Message: ヴァゥーーーーーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: GRAAAWRRR!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.2
Items.Message: ヴァウゥ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Vrrr.

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.3
Items.Message: ヴァゥヴァゥヴァーウゥゥゥーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Vrr, vraw, vrawr, graaawwwrrr!

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.4
Items.Message: ヴァウウゥゥーーー！　ヴァゥゥゥゥ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Vrawwwrrr! Grrrrrr!

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.5
Items.Message:
ヴァーーーゥ、ヴァー！
ヴァヴァヴァヴァゥ、ヴァヴァ、ヴァヴァヴァヴァヴァゥ、ヴァヴァ、ヴァゥゥ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Vrrrrrr, grawr!
Vrr, vrr, vrr, vrrr...vrr vrr, vrr vrr vrr vrrr, grawr, graaawr...

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.6
Items.Message:
ヴァウヴァウヴァヴァゥゥ！
ヴァウヴァウヴァヴァゥヴァゥ！
ヴァウゥゥゥーーー。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Vrr, vrr, vrrr, vrrrr!
Vrawr vrawr vrawr vrawr vrawr!
Graaawrrr!

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.7
Items.Message: 今日のビャッコ、特注の歯ブラシを足で持って器用に歯磨きをしてるにゃ。どこで覚えたんだにゃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Byakko's got her very own toothbrush, and she seems very skilled at using it, meow. Wonder where she picked that up, meow...

Items.Label: CardVoice.Byakko06.8
Items.Message: お揃いの帽子にお揃いのマント。なんだかビャッコとの絆が形になったみたいで、すごく誇らしい。
Items.MessageLocalize: Matching hats and capes... It's like a physical representation of my bond with Byakko. I couldn't be prouder.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.1
Items.Message: この世界は私の実験台よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: The world is my test tube!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.2
Items.Message:
豊後と遊びたいって？
そりゃありがたい申し出だね、
あいつも喜ぶよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You want to go play with Bungo?
That'd be much appreciated, actually.
I'm sure she'd love it, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.3
Items.Message: 遠近感ならとっくの昔に捨てたよ…このイカした目のアタッチメントのためにね！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I've abandoned depth perception long ago... All for the sake of this WICKEDLY COOL eye patch!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.4
Items.Message: どんな家に生まれたら山脇・ボン・イヴァールなんて名前になるかなんてこっちが訊きたいよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: You want to know why someone would name their kid Bon Ivar Yamawaki?! Yeah, same!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.5
Items.Message:
♪ジングルベールジングルベール
セラフがうなる！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Jingle bells, Jingle bells... ♪
With Seraph I shall slay! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.6
Items.Message:
天才科学者は身だしなみなんて気にしてないと思ったでしょ。
見るがいいわ、この脇を！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hah, I bet you thought a "wacky" mad scientist wouldn't think to take care of their hygiene. But BEHOLD! Behold my cleanliness!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.7
Items.Message: トナカイのツノはねぇ、生え替わる時前触れもなくぼとりと落ちるからびびるんだよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Did you know reindeer antlers just suddenly pop off when they're regrowing? It's alarming, really!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.8
Items.Message: さあ豊後！プレゼントを配りに行くよ！よい子のみんなを私たちの配下に加えるのよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Come, Bungo! Let us present zese presents! Everyone on ze nice list shall join my legion in no time!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.9
Items.Message: フライドチキンを豪快にバーレルで買っていくか！ふたりで食べきれなかったら３１Ｃにも配る！
Items.MessageLocalize: You know vhat, I'll buy a whole barrel of fried chicken! If ze two of us can't finish it all off, it vill go to the rest of 31-C!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.10
Items.Message: 甘いケーキのお供にはブラックなコーヒーが合うわね。…私だけ飲めるようになっちゃった。
Items.MessageLocalize: Black coffee goes so well with a sweet cake. ...I guess I'm the only one of us that acquired a taste for it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki04.11
Items.Message:
どこ見てんだぁ？
あんまりじろじろ見てると、
このツノで内臓えぐるわよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
What are YOU looking at?
If you don't keep those eyes to yourself,
you'll find these antlers gouging your guts!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.1
Items.Message: この世界は私の実験台よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: The world is my test tube!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.2
Items.Message:
豊後と遊びたいって？
そりゃありがたい申し出だね、
あいつも喜ぶよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You want to go play with Bungo?
That'd be much appreciated, actually.
I'm sure she'd love it, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.3
Items.Message: 遠近感ならとっくの昔に捨てたよ…このイカした目のアタッチメントのためにね！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I've abandoned depth perception long ago... All for the sake of this WICKEDLY COOL eye patch!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.4
Items.Message: どんな家に生まれたら山脇・ボン・イヴァールなんて名前になるかなんてこっちが訊きたいよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: You want to know why someone would name their kid Bon Ivar Yamawaki?! Yeah, same!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.5
Items.Message:
私の余暇を邪魔するなんてね…
風情がないね！
Items.MessageLocalize:
You dare disturb my leisure time?
That is not good!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.6
Items.Message:
マッドサイエンティストはお休み？
いいや、違うよ！今日の私は清楚系
マッドサイエンティストさ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm taking a break from being a mad scientist?
Nein, nein! Today, I'm a neat-und-tidy mad scientist!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.7
Items.Message:
私だけびしょびしょなんて不公平よ！
あんたも濡らしてやるわ！
食らいなさい！
Items.MessageLocalize:
It is not fair zat I'm zee only one soaking wet!
I vill get you wet too!
Take zis!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.8
Items.Message:
青い空に宙を舞う水玉…
自然ってこんなに綺麗だったんだね…
忘れてたよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Water droplets flying in the air against the blue sky... I've forgotten how beautiful nature is!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.9
Items.Message:
こんな格好でも目のアタッチメントがないと落ち着かないのは、
マッドサイエンティストの性かね！
Items.MessageLocalize:
You know I am a mad scientist vhen, even dressed like this,
I feel uncomfortable without mein eyepatch attachment.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.10
Items.Message:
はあー、楽しかった。
付き合ってくれてありがとう。
いい気晴らしになったよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Haha, that was fun.
Thanks for hanging out with me.
It was a nice distraction.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki06.11
Items.Message:
ふ…年相応の女の子みたい。
たまにはこういうのも悪くないわね。
でも戦いは続くよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hah... For once I'm dressed appropriately for a woman my age?
I guess it's not so bad to do this once in a while.
But the war goes on!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.1
Items.Message: この世界は私の実験台よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: The world is my test tube!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.2
Items.Message:
豊後と遊びたいって？
そりゃありがたい申し出だね、
あいつも喜ぶよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You want to go play with Bungo?
That'd be much appreciated, actually.
I'm sure she'd love it, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.3
Items.Message: どんな家に生まれたら山脇・ボン・イヴァールなんて名前になるかなんてこっちが訊きたいよ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: You want to know why someone would name their kid Bon Ivar Yamawaki?! Yeah, same!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.4
Items.Message: おかしい…いつしかワッキーと呼ばれることに違和感を覚えなくなった…これも成長なのか…！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Well, that's strange... When did the name Wakkie stop feeling off to my ears. Would this be considered growth?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.5
Items.Message: 動くと死ぬわよ！　なんて…動かなくても、死ぬんだけどねえ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't move if you don't want to die! Fooled you. You can stand still all you want, but you'll still die!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.6
Items.Message: 清々しい青空！　清潔感のある白スーツ！　どこがマッドサイエンティストだ！
Items.MessageLocalize: A clear, blue sky! A spotless white suit! Is there anything about this that even remotely screams mad scientist?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.7
Items.Message: 絶対領域？　なんのことかわからないけど必殺技みたいでいいわね。目に焼き付けろ！　私の絶対領域を！
Items.MessageLocalize: Absolute territory? No clue what that means, but sounds like a pretty neat signature move. Burn this into your eyes: my absolute territory!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.8
Items.Message: 今の私ならどんな強敵でも、どんな試練でも、乗り越えられる気がする…付いてきな、あんたたち！
Items.MessageLocalize: I feel I can overcome any foe or trial now... Follow me, minions!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.9
Items.Message: 誰かの敗北の塊でこの血肉は出来ている。その事実を噛みしめて生きてごらん。
Items.MessageLocalize: Our flesh and blood are built atop of someone else's failure. Let that sink in and live your life to the fullest.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki07.10
Items.Message: そうだね…どんな小さな生死も、両の眼かっぴらいて見届けなくちゃね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Right... No matter how insignificant a death may be, we gotta bear witness to it in its entirety, with both eyes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.1
Items.Message: この世界は私の実験台よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: The world is my test tube!

Items.Message:
豊後と遊びたいって？
そりゃありがたい申し出だね、
あいつも喜ぶよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:

That'd be much appreciated, actually.
I'm sure she'd love it, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.5
Items.Message:
準備は？
万端でゲス！
大怪人メカデモンガー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
You ready?
More than ready!
The Mega Monster Demonger!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.6
Items.Message: 私こそが無慈悲な夜と闇の魔王、ヤマワキ。絶望と共に世界を終焉へ導いてあげるわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm ze ruthless demon lord of nacht and darkness, Yamawaki. I shall usher zis world into an age of despair.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.7
Items.Message:
魔王軍志願兵大募集！
未経験者歓迎、週１日から相談可！
アットホームな職場です！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Recruiting demon army soldiers!
No experience required! Work as little as one day a week!
A friendly, homey workplace!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.8
Items.Message:
あいつが望むなら、魔王になって世界さえ滅ぼしてみせるのさ。
何度でも、何度でもね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
If she wishes for it, I will become the demon lord and destroy this world.
Again and again, as many times as I have to.

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.9
Items.Message: けっひっひ、なんて禍々しい姿でゲスか！　太もものエロいベルトにもきっと意味があるでゲスよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ke he he, what a sinister appearance, snip. That sensual belt hanging off her thighs has gotta mean something deep, too!

Items.Label: CardVoice.BIYamawaki08.10
Items.Message:
世界に破滅と混沌をもたらす狂気の魔王様に敬礼！
びしっ！でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: All hail the demon lord of madness who will bring destruction and chaos to the world! Salute, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.1
Items.Message: 星の導きがあらんことを。
Items.MessageLocalize: May the stars guide you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.2
Items.Message:
…私に出来ることは、
ただ占うことだけ。５３％の運命を
信じるも抗うもあなた次第です。
Items.MessageLocalize:
...All I can do is read fortunes.
It is up to you whether you wish to
accept or defy this fate of 53% accuracy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.3
Items.Message:
…この水晶玉の輝きは
…近いうちに新たなカップリングが
生まれる予感…滾ります。
Items.MessageLocalize:
...The crystal ball's luster...
It appears a new pairing will soon be born.
How very rousing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.4
Items.Message: …いくつもの星々を見続けてきました。あなたも、そして私も遠い明日に輝く星のひとつとなるでしょう。
Items.MessageLocalize: ...I have watched countless stars. Together, surely you and I will become a bright star in the distant future.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.5
Items.Message:
鐘の音に永遠の愛を。
天渡る花よ祝福を。
Items.MessageLocalize: Let us proclaim our eternal love to the sound of the bell, and may this bouquet soaring to the skies grant us its blessings.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.6
Items.Message:
…もう少し落ち着いたドレスが
よかったのですが。主に胸が…
どうして拝むんですか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
...I would prefer a more unassuming dress,
in particular around the chest area...
May I ask what you are worshipping?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.7
Items.Message:
…生涯変わることなくお互いを
いたわり合い、幸せに満ちた未来を
過ごすことを誓います。
Items.MessageLocalize: ...I vow to live out our days together in happiness until death do us part.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.8
Items.Message:
…水晶が手元にないと
落ち着かないので、代わりに
手を握ってくれませんか。
Items.MessageLocalize:
...I feel ill at ease without my crystal ball in my hands...
Would you hold my hand in its place?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.9
Items.Message:
…ウエディングベル、ドレスのベール、チャペルでベーゼ、永遠にラブ。
…良い詩が出来ました。
Items.MessageLocalize:
...Wedding bells, a bridal veil, a kiss at the chapel, and an eternal love...
It all combines into a beautiful poem.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.10
Items.Message:
…３１Ｃの皆さんが友人ではなく
母親のような顔で見つめてきます。
…嬉しいような寂しいような。
Items.MessageLocalize: ...My 31-C teammates seem to see me less as a friend than as a mother... It fills me with both joy and loneliness.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba06.11
Items.Message:
…ふたりの道行きを星も祝福しています。…５３％の占いではなく、
１００％の私の願いです。
Items.MessageLocalize: The stars, too, wish us well on our journey together. This is not a 53%-accurate fortune, but 100% my own desire.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.1
Items.Message: 星の導きがあらんことを。
Items.MessageLocalize: May the stars guide you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.2
Items.Message:
…私に出来ることは、
ただ占うことだけ。５３％の運命を

Items.MessageLocalize:

It is up to you whether you wish to
accept or defy this fate of 53% accuracy.
