Items.Message:
…この水晶玉の輝きは
…近いうちに新たなカップリングが
生まれる予感…滾ります。
Items.MessageLocalize:
...The crystal ball's luster...
It appears a new pairing will soon be born.
How very rousing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.4
Items.Message: …いくつもの星々を見続けてきました。あなたも、そして私も遠い明日に輝く星のひとつとなるでしょう。
Items.MessageLocalize: ...I have watched countless stars. Together, surely you and I will become a bright star in the distant future.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.5
Items.Message: …私は尊い存在を観測するだけの壁でありたい。
Items.MessageLocalize: I wish to be but a wall that observes the most heavenly of existences.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.6
Items.Message: …真理を授けましょう。これは運命を変える、星の魔法。
Items.MessageLocalize: I shall bestow upon you the truth. This is a spell of the stars, one that can change even fate itself.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.7
Items.Message: …世界の真理をおさめるいにしえの大魔道士、サクラバ…これより山脇様の配下になります。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am Sakuraba, the ancient sorceress and keeper of this world's truth. From this moment onward, I shall serve only my master, the Great Yamawaki.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.8
Items.Message: …肌面積が５３％。…はしたない体で申し訳ありません。
Items.MessageLocalize: Currently, 53% of my skin is laid bare... I apologize for having such an indecent body.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.9
Items.Message: …あの、紐は引っ張らないでいただけると…あられもない姿になってしまいます。
Items.MessageLocalize: Um, please do not pull on that string... I could end up in the most immodest state.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.10
Items.Message: …もしも自在に魔法が使えるのなら…私は、ひとと目を合わせて話せるようになりたいです。
Items.MessageLocalize: If I could use any type of witchcraft to my heart's content... One where I'd be able to talk to others, looking them in the eye.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SSakuraba07.11
Items.Message:
…どうしました？魅了の魔術はまだかけていません。今からです…
どうなってしまうのか…ふふふ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What is the matter? I have yet to cast enthrall. That comes now...
What will happen, you ask? Hehehe.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.1
Items.Message: 忘却は死、追憶に生きよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oblivion is death, so live on in memories.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.2
Items.Message: まったく、丸山たちにも困ったものだな。わしがいなければ統制がとれんだろう。影のリーダー…いいな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Honestly, Maruyama and the others would be in such trouble without me... A leader behind the curtain, now that sounds nice.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.3
Items.Message:
天然ではないわ！天然ではないわ！
天然ではないわ！天然ではないわ！
天然ではないわーーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Don't call me Witchy! Don't call me Witchy!
Don't call me Witchy! Don't call me Witchy!
Don't call me Witchy!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.4
Items.Message:
これは最初に見た者に恋慕してしまう魔法薬だ。副作用は、以後誰を見ても
その人物に見えてしまう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
This here's a potion that'll make you fall in love with the next person you see...
But everyone you see after that will look like that person to you, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.5
Items.Message:
無限の書庫を知っておるか。
知識の波濤に溺れるが良い！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Have you heard of the eternal library?
A place to drown yourself in endless information!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.6
Items.Message:
この帽子は魔術師の誇りだ！
時々形が変わるだけだ！
絶対に脱がんぞ！脱がんぞーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This hat of mine is my magical pride!
The shape changes from time to time, but it's still the same!
I'll never take it off, never!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.7
Items.Message:
ぎゃあああぁ！太ももに薬品がーー！
布面積が少ない衣装で研究するのは
危険すぎるーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Gyaaaaah! I got chemicals on my thighs!
I knew it, doing research in something this skimpy...
It's untenable!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.8
Items.Message:
赤は膨張色。物を大きく見せるぞ！
どうだ！いつもより背が大きく見え…
ふっ、なんでもない…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Red is an expansive color that makes things look bigger!
What do you think? Am I taller than usual, perhaps?
Bah, forget it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.9
Items.Message:
集中力向上の魔法薬の名は…チョーシューチュウ？いや、サエワタール…
ダサい言うでないわー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
What should I name the potion for improving concentration...Concentrator Ultra? No... Clearheader...
What do you mean, "sounds lame"?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.10
Items.Message:
この衣装は、攻撃魔法も回復魔法も
武器も扱えるという万能魔術師に
倣ったものだ。え…器用貧乏…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
This outfit is modeled after the accouterments of powerful mages
skilled in both offensive and healing magic as well as melee weapons.
Huh... Jack of all trades, master of none?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne05.11
Items.Message:
今日は現世に召喚された異世界の
魔道士という設定で豊後たちと
遊ぶとしよう。お前も一緒にどうだ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Today I shall entertain Bungo with the notion of a mage summoned from another world.
Care to join us?

Items.Message: 忘却は死、追憶に生きよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oblivion is death, so live on in memories.

Items.Message:
天然ではないわ！天然ではないわ！
天然ではないわ！天然ではないわ！
天然ではないわーーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Don't call me Witchy! Don't call me Witchy!
Don't call me Witchy! Don't call me Witchy!
Don't call me Witchy!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.4
Items.Message:

その人物に見えてしまう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
This here's a potion that'll make you fall in love with the next person you see...
But everyone you see after that will look like that person to you, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.5
Items.Message:
最近ヘルメットをグリグリしすぎて、丸いものをみるとつい、
豊後ぉーーー！としたくなる…。
Items.MessageLocalize: I've been thumping that helmet so much as of late, whenever I see something round, I can't help but scream, BUNGOOOO!!!!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.6
Items.Message: 我は不死を司る王…。最弱などではないわーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: I am the king who lords over the undead...AND DEFINITELY NOT THE WEAKEST AMONG US!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.7
Items.Message: なんと禍々しい姿。これで豊後に四天王最弱とは言わせ…っておい！　今、日記に何を書いたーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Look how hellish my accouterments are. Now Bungo can never again call me the weakest of the henchmen... Hey! You just wrote something in your diary, didn't you?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.8
Items.Message: …深淵の叡智を記す呪われしネクロマンサー、テンネ。山脇様のため、不死の軍団を率いよう！
Items.MessageLocalize: I am Tenne, accursed necromancer and keeper of the abyss's wisdom. For the Great Yamawaki, I shall lead my undead army!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.9
Items.Message: 何を覗き込んでいる。履いてないように見えるだと？ちゃんと履いとるわ！履いとるわーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: And where are you peeking? You say it doesn't look like I'm wearing anything underneath? I AM! I AM WEARING SOMETHING!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.10
Items.Message: くくっ。それにしてもこの光の演出、よく出来ておる。まるで漂う霊魂のようだ。…演出だよな？
Items.MessageLocalize: Heh, these lighting effects are quite well done. They look just like wandering souls hovering in the air... They are effects, right?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTenne06.11
Items.Message: 命を失った者を現世に蘇らせる存在、か。これを冒涜と呼ぶか、それとも救いと呼ぶか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Someone who returns to life those who have died, you say? Would that be blasphemy...or salvation?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.1
Items.Message: 世界征服開始でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Time to conquer the world, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.2
Items.Message:
じゃ！らら！じゃららららら～！
じゃららら～！じゃじゃ！山脇様、今のはどうだったでゲスか！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Jya! Ra-ra! Jya-rarararaaa! Jyararararaaa! Jya-jya! ...How was that, master?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.3
Items.Message: 今日も一日楽しかったでゲス。明日もきっと楽しいでゲスよね…。ふあぁ…今日はもう寝るでゲス…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Today was so fun... And tomorrow's definitely going to be just as fun. Yaaawn... but it's time to sleep for today...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.4
Items.Message: 玉ねぎ、にんじん、じゃがいも、牛肉、カレールウ…お使いの最中でゲス。話しかけるなでゲス。
Items.MessageLocalize: Onions, carrots, potatoes, beef, curry stock... Don't talk to me right now! I'm in the middle of a mission.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.5
Items.Message: ♪Silent Night手加減ない攻撃でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Silent night...♪ Beat 'em with all my might, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.6
Items.Message: 山脇様！サンタを待つ子どもたちの家に突撃でゲス！クリスマスを征服するでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Master! The children of the world are waiting for Santa Claws! Let's conquer Christmas, and then the world!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.7
Items.Message:
けっひっひ！サンタ参上でゲス！
大人しくプレゼントを受け取るでゲスよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Keheheh! Shake with fear, Santa Claws is here!
Naughty or nice, you'll be eating these presents!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.8
Items.Message:
砂糖たっぷりのケーキを配って、
世界中を虫歯だらけにするでゲス！
けっひっひ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm going to give out sugary-sweet cakes and give everyone cavities!
Keheheh, what a dastardly plan!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.9
Items.Message:
白くてふわふわできれい…はっ！
悪の組織は雪なんかに見とれていてはダメでゲスね！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ohhh, so soft and white and pretty! ...Ah!
No, an evil minion shouldn't be getting distracted by snow!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.10
Items.Message: この服もこもこして動きづらいでゲス…。でも山脇様とお揃いでゲス。もうちょっとだけ着ておくでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: These clothes are so puffy and hard to move around in... But this outfit matches with master's! So I'm going to wear it a little longer!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo04.11
Items.Message: はしゃぎ過ぎて頭がくらくらしてきたでゲス…でも今日という日が終わって欲しくないでゲス…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oooh, I'm dizzy from running around and playing all day, snip... But I kind of don't want this day to end...

Items.Message: 世界征服開始でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Time to conquer the world, snip!

じゃららら～！じゃじゃ！山脇様、今のはどうだったでゲスか！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Jya! Ra-ra! Jya-rarararaaa! Jyararararaaa! Jya-jya! ...How was that, master?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.5
Items.Message:
団子怪人、参上！
団子より爆発でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: THE DANGO MONSTER HAS ARRIVED! Function over form, snip snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.6
Items.Message:
やったでゲス！
山脇様から頂いたカニのハサミで
三色団子を掴んでみせたでゲス！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I did it! I snapped up that dango with Master Yamawaki's crab claw, snip snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.7
Items.Message:
網タイツみたいなところが
肌が透けてエロいでゲス！あちき、
エロい女になってしまったでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: These fishnet tights are basically seethrough! Talk about lewd! Guess I'm a naughty lady now, huh?! snip snip

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.8
Items.Message:
こう見えて頭重いんでゲス！
でも可愛いが勝つんでゲス！！
Items.MessageLocalize: This makes me look like a big deal! But my cuteness shines through, snip snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.9
Items.Message:
美味しそうなものがたくさん
でゲス～♪みんなで食べるでゲス～♪
落ちてくる花びらも綺麗でゲス♪
Items.MessageLocalize: So much yummy-scrummy food!♪ And we get to eat it all. snip snip! ♪ The petals sure are pretty too, yippee!♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.10
Items.Message:
だんご怪人登場でゲス！！
お前もだんご怪人に
してやろうかーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: The dango monster is here! You should be a dango monster too, snip snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo05.11
Items.Message:
だんごっ、だんごっ、だんごっ、
だんごっ、だんごっ大悪の組織～♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Dango... Dango... Dango...
Dango... The big dango famiglia!♪

Items.MessageLocalize: Onions, carrots, potatoes, beef, curry stock... Don't talk to me right now! I'm in the middle of a mission.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.5
Items.Message: けっひっひ！　悪の組織もずいぶん仲間が増えたでゲス。にぎやかで悪くないでゲスね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ke he he! Our evil organization has really grown, snip. Now it's kinda lively and enjoyable now.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.6
Items.Message: 滅亡タイムでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: It's time for destruction, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.7
Items.Message: あらゆる敵を噛み砕く、スカルハンドの使い魔ブンゴでゲス！山脇様の威光にひれ伏すがいいでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: I am Bungo, the skull-clawed familiar who will crush all enemies, snip! Bow down before her magesty, the Great Yamawaki, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.8
Items.Message: 赤いタイツを着て妖艶さが増したでゲス！　あちき、またエロい女になってしまったでゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: My seductiveness has been jacked up by my red stockings! I've become quite the sexy woman, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.9
Items.Message: 山脇様こそ世界に破滅と混沌をもたらす狂気の魔王！あちきは、ずっとずっと、その使い魔でゲス！
Items.MessageLocalize: The Great Yamawaki is the demon lord of madness who will bring destruction and chaos to the world! And I am, and will always be, her familiar, snip!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.10
Items.Message: いつか一番の友達と笑いあう日のために…私は魔王となってこの世界を滅ぼすのさ！
Items.MessageLocalize: For the day I get to laugh together with my dearest friend again... I vill become ze demon lord and destroy ze vorld!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YBungo06.11
Items.Message: よくやった我が使い魔豊後よ。褒美に私が地獄の炎でパンケーキを焼いてあげるわ…ふっふっふ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Vell done, my dear familiar Bungo. For your reward, I vill bestow upon you pancakes cooked vith ze flames of hell! Mwa ha ha!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.1
Items.Message: イッツニンジャショータイム！
Items.MessageLocalize: It's Ninja Showtime!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.2
Items.Message: うーん、今より目立つためにはどうすればよいでゴザろうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Hmm...what should I do to stand out even more...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.3
Items.Message: 拙者ドイツ生まれの忍者でゴザル！ 日本のアニメやマンガで忍術をしっかりと勉強したでゴザルよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am a German-born ninja! I have studied all of my ninjutsu diligently from Japanese anime and manga.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.4
Items.Message: もしかして…拙者みられているでゴザルか…？ みりゃれてるでごじゃる～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh... Am I being watched?! Ohhh, I will melt from all the attention...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.5
Items.Message:
花言葉は希望と思い出…。
そして繊細さ？でゴザル！
Items.MessageLocalize: Cornflowers symbolize hope and remembrance... and delicateness? I think!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.6
Items.Message: 佐月殿に服装を忍べと言われたでゴザルが…拙者の格好は目立っているでゴザルか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Satsuki-dono told me to be more discrete with what I wear... Do I stand out that much?

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.7
Items.Message: 誰かに背負われ、風になる夢を見たでゴザル。懐かしい気持ちになれたでゴザルよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I had a dream about being carried on someone's back, rushing through the wind. It made me very nostalgic.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.8
Items.Message: ふわあぁ…じいやぁ…アーデルハイドは…まだ眠いですぅ…。はっ！ 寝ぼけてたでゴザル！
Items.MessageLocalize: Yaaawn... Kann ich noch etwas schlafen...? Ah! I must still be drowsy!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.9
Items.Message: また山脇殿と豊後殿と一緒にかくれんぼをするでゴザル。今度は天音殿も誘うとするでゴザルよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will play hide-and-seek with Yamawaki-dono and Bungo-dono again. This time, I am thinking about inviting Tenne-dono to play, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.10
Items.Message: ドイツに居た頃は、オクトーバーフェストのお手伝いでこの衣装を着ていたでゴザルよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Back when I was in Germany, I used to help out at the local Oktoberfest in this outfit.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki05.11
Items.Message: それにしても胸が苦しいでゴザルな。無駄に育ってしまったでゴザル。
Items.MessageLocalize: This is kind of tight around the chest. Maybe I've grown too much?

Items.Message: イッツニンジャショータイム！
Items.MessageLocalize: It's Ninja Showtime!

Items.MessageLocalize: Hmm...what should I do to stand out even more...?

Items.MessageLocalize: Oh... Am I being watched?! Ohhh, I will melt from all the attention...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.5
Items.Message:
忍法！スイカ乱舞！あとで拙者が
美味しく食べるでゴザル！あむっ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Way of the ninja—Watermelon Mayhem!
All that is left to do is to enjoy a delicious slice of watermelon! Nom.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.6
Items.Message:
何もしていないのにいつもより
目立っている気がするでゴザル…！
うへ、うへへへぇ～…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I am not even doing anything,
but I stand out so much!
Heehee...heheheee...

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.7
Items.Message:
昔より体が楽に
水に浮くでゴザルな～。拙者も
たわわになったものでゴザル。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I can float on water so much better than before.
I suppose I've gotten rather busty.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.8
Items.Message:
佐月殿が向こうで手を振ってくれているでゴザル。ここは派手に返事を
…忍法・水嵐の術ー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Satsuki-dono is waving at me over there. I need to make a huge splash to greet her back!
Way of the ninja—Water Tempest!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.9
Items.Message:
忍法、お色気の術！
うっふ～ん！でゴザル。
…なんか違うでゴザルな。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Way of the ninja—Sex appeal!
Ooh la la!
...I am not sure that worked.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.10
Items.Message:
この髪は佐月殿に編んでもらったのでゴザル。お返しに拙者も
編んでみたいでゴザルなぁ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
It was Satsuki-dono who braided my hair.
I really would like to braid hers to return the favor!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki06.11
Items.Message:
グラビア撮影用に、佐月殿とセットでと桜庭殿が選んでくれた水着
でゴザル。似合うでゴザろう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Sakuraba-dono picked out these swimsuits for Satsuki-dono and me specifically for this photo shoot.
Looks great, don't you think?

Items.Message: もしかして…拙者みられているでゴザルか…？ みりゃれてるでごじゃる～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh... Am I being watched?! Ohhh, I will melt from all the attention...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.5
Items.Message: お嬢様をやってほしい？　いいでゴザルよ！　じいや。友人が来ます、お茶の用意を。照れるでゴザルな～。
Items.MessageLocalize: You want me to play the part of like a rich lady? Sure thing, nin! Butler? I will be having friends over. Please prepare some tea. This is kind of embarrassing, ja...

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.6
Items.Message: 目覚めよ獣！　爪と牙は不滅也！　決まったでゴザル…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Awaken, beast! These claws and fangs are invincible! And that's that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.7
Items.Message: 白く大きなファーに腋丸出しの服…そして自ら破ったスカート…今の拙者、目立つ要素の塊でごじゃる～。
Items.MessageLocalize: A large white tuft of fur leaving my armpits exposed...and this skirt that I tore myself... Right now, I'm covered head to toe in showy elements!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.8
Items.Message: いつもより足に視線を感じるでゴザルが…。見るなら胸を！　この鋭い牙の首飾りを見てほしいでゴザル！
Items.MessageLocalize: I can feel more eyes staring at my legs than usual...but if you're gonna stare, stare at my chest instead! Look at this necklace made of sharp fangs!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.9
Items.Message: サツキ殿が背中を守ってくれるから、拙者は憂いなく突撃できるでゴザルよ！　さぁ行くでゴザル！
Items.MessageLocalize: With Satsuki-dono having my back, I can charge forth without worry! Now, let's go, nin!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.10
Items.Message: 森羅を狩り穿つ厄災の獣王、カンザキ。山脇様の野望を邪魔する者は、すべて蹴散らすでゴザルよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm Kanzaki, the calamitous king of beasts who pierces all nature. I will tear through all those who stand in the way of the Great Yamawaki's ambitions!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AKanzaki07.11
Items.Message: ケル！　ベロ！　スー！　狩りの時間でゴザル！　お、お散歩じゃないでゴザルよ！　戦うでゴザルぅ～！
Items.MessageLocalize: Cer! Ber! Us! It's hunting time! W-We're not going on a walk! Fight, please!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.1
Items.Message: 全滅のご注文承りました♪
Items.MessageLocalize: One order of total annihilation, coming up! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.2
Items.Message:
いらっしゃいませ♪ 
ゆっくりご覧になってなんか絶対買っていきやがれ♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Welcome! ♪
Take your time looking, but don't you dare forget to buy! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.3
Items.Message: とんでもない掘り出し物を掘り出してきました♪ こちら２ｍ越えの自然薯です♪ 粘りがすげーぞ♪
Items.MessageLocalize: We've just unearthed something incredible! ♪ Take a look at this gigantic tuber, it's over two meters long and its stickiness is unparalleled! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.4
Items.Message: 今だけは憧れるのをやめましょう。誰よりも部隊の支柱になるためにやってきたのですから。
Items.MessageLocalize: For now, I'm going to stop dreaming and simply accept it, because I've put my all into supporting my squad.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.5
Items.Message:
幸せのご注文は返品不可だぞ♪ 
えい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
We don't take returns on happy purchases! ♪
Here!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.6
Items.Message: ええと…こんな口が悪く粗暴な自分が着ていいものなのでしょうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, um... Should someone as rough and foul-mouthed as me wear an outfit like this?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.7
Items.Message: ウェディングドレスとマシンガン…こんな窮地だからこそ許される組み合わせですね♪
Items.MessageLocalize: A wedding dress and a machine gun... That's a combo that only works in high-stake situations like this! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.8
Items.Message:
やがれ、がきっと駄目なんですね。買ってくださいやがれ…あれ？ 
どうしてもやがれがつきますね…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
It's probably my attitude that's the problem. Maybe I should phrase it more gently, like: Please buy our stuff! OR ELSE!
...Wait, that's still kinda threatening.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.9
Items.Message:
思い切りブーケトスするぞー！ 
怪我したくない奴はどいてやがれーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm going to toss the bouquet now, so if you don't want to get hurt, GET YOUR ASS OUT OF THE WAY!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.10
Items.Message:
今はたくさんの仲間が居ます！ 
そんな大切な仲間たちと今を大事に楽しんで生きたいと思います！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I have so many friends now!
So, I want to live life making the best of my time with the people I love!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki05.11
Items.Message:
相応しい相手を見つけて。
そして、幸せになって、マリ…。
はい、絶対なります。
Items.MessageLocalize:
"Find a suitable partner. And above all, Mari, be happy."
Yes, Mother. I'll find my happiness for sure.

Items.MessageLocalize: We've just unearthed something incredible! ♪ Take a look at this gigantic tuber, it's over two meters long and its stickiness is unparalleled! ♪

Items.Message: 今だけは憧れるのをやめましょう。誰よりも部隊の支柱になるためにやってきたのですから。
Items.MessageLocalize: For now, I'm going to stop dreaming and simply accept it, because I've put my all into supporting my squad.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.5
Items.Message:
海の家、開店です♪
あまり浮かれるんじゃねーぞ♪
まいどあり♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
The beachside cafe is open for business! ♪
Don't you get carried away! ♪
Come again! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.6
Items.Message:
どこを見てんだブタ野郎♪
視線が気持ち悪りーぞ♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
What are you looking at, you swine? ♪
Your gaze is freaking gross! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.7
Items.Message:
アーデルちゃんとセットで、と
星羅ちゃんが選んだ水着です♪腰の赤いリボンが尊いと言ってました♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Seira picked out swimsuits for me and Adel and made sure they match. ♪
She even called the red ribbon on my waist heavenly! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.8
Items.Message:
スイカ割りしませんか？
スイカと木の棒セット購入で
２割引…どこ見てやがる♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
How about some watermelon smashing?
Buy both a watermelon and a wooden stick for 20% off...
Eyes up here, please. ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.9
Items.Message:
アーデルちゃんのあの髪の毛、
わたしが編んだんですよ。今度、
わたしもやってもらいましょうか。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I braided Adel's hair, you know?
Maybe I should ask her to braid mine next time.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.10
Items.Message:
キャンサーの皮で作ったビーチバッグはいかかですか？防水機能付きで
とっても頑丈ですよ♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
How about this beach bag made from Cancer hide?
It's waterproof and ultra sturdy. ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki06.11
Items.Message:
あそこにアーデルちゃんが
居ますね。また派手な忍術使って…
まったく、忍べ♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh, there's Adel.
Look at her with her showy ninjutsu again...
Be stealthy, dammit. ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.1
Items.Message: 全滅のご注文承りました♪
Items.MessageLocalize: One order of total annihilation, coming up! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.2
Items.Message:
いらっしゃいませ♪ 
ゆっくりご覧になってなんか絶対買っていきやがれ♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Welcome! ♪
Take your time looking, but don't you dare forget to buy! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.3
Items.Message: とんでもない掘り出し物を掘り出してきました♪ こちら２ｍ越えの自然薯です♪ 粘りがすげーぞ♪
Items.MessageLocalize: We've just unearthed something incredible! ♪ Take a look at this gigantic tuber, it's over two meters long and its stickiness is unparalleled! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.4
Items.Message: 今だけは憧れるのをやめましょう。誰よりも部隊の支柱になるためにやってきたのですから。
Items.MessageLocalize: For now, I'm going to stop dreaming and simply accept it, because I've put my all into supporting my squad.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.5
Items.Message: お母さん。最近、なりたい自分に近づけてるような気がしてるんです。大切な友達のおかげで…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mother, I'm getting closer to being the person I want to be, and it's thanks to my dearest friends.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.6
Items.Message: お前の存在価値…あら、ゼロ円。
Items.MessageLocalize: Your existence is merely worth...oh my, zero yen.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.7
Items.Message: …悪魔総帥にして忠実なる副官、サツキ。山脇様のご要望とあれば、世界であろうとご用意しましょう。
Items.MessageLocalize: Satsuki, faithful adjutant and generalissimo of the demons. If the Great Yamawaki wishes for it, I will prepare for her even the world itself.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.8
Items.Message: 卑しい視線を向けるな。下級オークのくせに。どうして二本足で立ってる？
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't cast your filthy gaze upon me, you low-ranking orc. How are you even standing on two feet anyway?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.9
Items.Message: しゃがんでどこを見ている。気付かれないとでも思ったか。立て、この下級オーク。
Items.MessageLocalize: Where are you looking, squatting like that? You truly think I haven't noticed? Stand up, you low-ranking orc.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.10
Items.Message: いらっしゃいませ♪　禁忌の魔法薬、幻惑の水晶玉、破滅のスカルハンド…魔王軍セットがお買い得だぞ♪
Items.MessageLocalize: Welcome! ♪ We have forbidden magic potions, alluring crystal balls, and skull claws of destruction... Bring home the whole demon lord army set with an exclusive set discount! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.MSatsuki07.11
Items.Message: なかなか恥ずかしい衣装ですが、みんなが喜んでるなら仕入れた甲斐がありました♪
Items.MessageLocalize: These costumes are quite embarrassing to wear, but everyone seems to be enjoying this so much. I'm glad that I picked them up to sell! ♪

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.1
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse Oblige!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.2
Items.Message: 私は皆の先輩として頼れる存在となれているだろうか。時々不安になる…。いや、自信を持てユイナよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm really living up to everyone's expectations as a reliable veteran... No, Yuina, you mustn't lose confidence!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.3
Items.Message: は…！ お前が一位という天啓が聞こえた！ なんだその天啓は！ 理想の先輩ランキングであってくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! I just heard a voice saying that I'm number one! What does that even mean?! Am I number one in the Reliable Veteran Ranking?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.4
Items.Message: 人類の命運は我らセラフ部隊にかかっている。必ずや勝利してみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: The fate of humanity is in our hands. We shall attain victory, no matter what.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.5
Items.Message: 夏のFairy？ ふ、侮ってもらっては困るな…極北のBerserkだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A siren in the summer? No, you must be mistaken... I'm far fiercer than that!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.6
Items.Message: この戦時下になんて格好で居るんだ、この私は！！ 誰も見ていないよな！？
Items.MessageLocalize: What a ridiculous outfit I'm in! And during wartime, too! I can only hope no one is watching!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.7
Items.Message: は…！！ よく似合っているという天啓が聞こえた！ なんだその天啓は！ 親か！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! I just heard a voice saying I look great in this outfit! What in the world is this revelation supposed to be, a comment from my mother?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.8
Items.Message: 私なんかより夕焼けのほうがずっと綺麗だ！ 夕焼けを見ろ！ こっちを見るな！
Items.MessageLocalize: Look, the sunset is far more beautiful than I am! Stare at that view instead! Don't look at me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.9
Items.Message: 海も夕日もなんて綺麗なんだ。こんな素晴らしい景色を、私は人類のために取り戻したい。
Items.MessageLocalize: What a wonderful view... The sun, and the sea. Someday, I hope such vistas will be available to all again.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.10
Items.Message: こんな姿を桐生に見られでもしたらまたえろ、えろ、えろ！！と否、否、否の勢いで言われてしまう！！
Items.MessageLocalize: If Kiryu were to see me in this state, she would no doubt go crazy with her "lewd, lewd, lewd!!!" and "nay, nay, nay!!!" as she often does!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa06.11
Items.Message: お前が隠し持つ秘密を教えて欲しい。それだけで特別になれる。強くもなる。すごいだろう。
Items.MessageLocalize: Share with me your hidden secret. I feel like that's all I need to feel special, and stronger. Isn't that amazing?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.1
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse oblige!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.2
Items.Message: 私は皆の先輩として頼れる存在となれているだろうか。時々不安になる…。いや、自信を持てユイナよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm really living up to everyone's expectations as a reliable veteran... No, Yuina, you mustn't lose confidence!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.3
Items.Message: は…！ お前が一位という天啓が聞こえた！ なんだその天啓は！ 理想の先輩ランキングであってくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! I just heard a voice saying that I'm number one! What does that even mean?! Am I number one in the Reliable Veteran Ranking?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.4
Items.Message: 人類の命運は我らセラフ部隊にかかっている。必ずや勝利してみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: The fate of humanity is in our hands. We shall attain victory, no matter what.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.5
Items.Message: 月歌、お前が欲しい。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ruka...I want you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.6
Items.Message:
チェックメイトだ、月歌。
これでお前はもう動けまい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Checkmate, Ruka.
I have you trapped.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.7
Items.Message:
月歌、今宵お前は私のものだ。
誰にも渡さない。
好きにさせてもらうぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ruka, you belong to me tonight.
Me, and no one else.
I will have my way with you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.8
Items.Message:
奔放なくせしてこんなに無臭とは、
どんな体だ。いっそその首筋に
口づけてみようか。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Your body fascinates me.
For how boisterous you are, there's no stain of sweat in your scent.
Perhaps I should plant a kiss on that neck of yours.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.9
Items.Message:
天啓がこう言っている…
月歌ユイヴィレッジが跡形もなく
燃え上がると。なんだそれは。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've been given a revelation:
"The RukaYui village will burn till not even ash remains."
What is that supposed to mean?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.10
Items.Message:
避けなくてもいい。
唇まで奪いはしないさ。
だがそれ以外は頂く。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You needn't run from me.
I won't steal your lips.
Just the rest of you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa07.11
Items.Message:
ユイナ様、
足腰が立たなくなるぐらい
無茶苦茶にしてください。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Please ravish me, Lady Yuina...
Until I can no longer stand.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.1
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse Oblige!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.2
Items.Message: 私は皆の先輩として頼れる存在となれているだろうか。時々不安になる…。いや、自信を持てユイナよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm really living up to everyone's expectations as a reliable veteran... No, Yuina, you mustn't lose confidence!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.3
Items.Message: は…！ お前が一位という天啓が聞こえた！ なんだその天啓は！ 理想の先輩ランキングであってくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! I just heard a voice saying that I'm number one! What does that even mean?! Am I number one in the Reliable Veteran Ranking?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.4
Items.Message: 人類の命運は我らセラフ部隊にかかっている。必ずや勝利してみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: The fate of humanity is in our hands. We shall attain victory, no matter what.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.5
Items.Message:
それ以上騒ぐと…その…
キスするぞ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Keep making a fuss, and
I'll...um...seal those lips with a kiss.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.6
Items.Message:
私が先陣を切る。
光の速さを超えてみせよう！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I will take the vanguard.
Behold as I move faster than light!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.7
Items.Message:
ネクタイが緩んでしまっていたか。
結んでくれるのか？ありがたいが…
なんだか気恥ずかしいな。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh, my tie is loose?
You would adjust it for me? Thank you.
Though I must say, this is embarrassing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.8
Items.Message:
この美しい景色も、お前のことも、
何があろうと守ってみせる。だから、安心して私についてきて欲しい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I pledge to protect both you and these wonderful surroundings,
no matter what. You have nothing to fear if you come with me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.9
Items.Message:
は…！！目指せ一位奪還！
という天啓が聞こえた！なんだ！？
何の一位なんだ！？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh! I just heard a voice saying:
"Go, Yuina, reclaim first place!" Excuse me?!
First place in what, exactly?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.10
Items.Message: さっきから妙に足に視線を感じるんだが、まさか…伝線しているのか！？どこだ！教えてくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: I can feel you staring at my legs. There must be a rip in my stockings! Where is it? Come, tell me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa08.11
Items.Message:
タイツを黒くするだけで
大人っぽくなるな。踏んで欲しい？
お前は何を言ってるんだ！？
Items.MessageLocalize:
I must say, black stockings carry a note of maturity.
You want me to step on you?
I'm sorry, but what?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.1
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse Oblige!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.2
Items.Message: 私は皆の先輩として頼れる存在となれているだろうか。時々不安になる…。いや、自信を持てユイナよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm really living up to everyone's expectations as a reliable veteran... No, Yuina, you mustn't lose confidence!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.3
Items.Message: は…！ お前が一位という天啓が聞こえた！ なんだその天啓は！ 理想の先輩ランキングであってくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah! I just heard a voice saying that I'm number one! What does that even mean?! Am I number one in the Reliable Veteran Ranking?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.4
Items.Message: 人類の命運は我らセラフ部隊にかかっている。必ずや勝利してみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: The fate of humanity is in our hands. We shall attain victory, no matter what.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.5
Items.Message:
それ以上騒ぐと…その…
キスするぞ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Keep making a fuss, and
I'll...um...seal those lips with a kiss.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.6
Items.Message: この身燃え尽きようとも…すべてを焼き払う！　…ふふっ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Even should I be reduced to smoldering cinders, I shall raze all that stands before me! Ahaha.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.7
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュか…無骨な私には勿体ない言葉だが、力なきもののためなら、喜んで戦おう！
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse Oblige, you say? An ideal I am woefully unfit to embody, but I shall fight for the sake of the powerless all the same!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.8
Items.Message: ジャンヌ度というパラメータがあるとしたら、満タンを越え、吹き零れている！
Items.MessageLocalize: If I had a Jeanne d'Arc meter, the bar would be spilling out of the frame right now!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.9
Items.Message: 脇開け加工だ。腕を上げる際負担を軽減し通気性を高めてくれ、主に野球選手が使用している。なぜ私が？
Items.MessageLocalize: This armor has open armpits, which lessen strain when lifting one's arms and improve ventilation. It's a common adjustment on baseball uniforms...but why on my armor?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.10
Items.Message: ノブレス・オブリージュ…どういう意味なんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Noblesse Oblige... What does it mean, really?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YShirakawa10.11
Items.Message: この髪は桐生が結んでくれたのだ。結び終えた瞬間お面が空の彼方へ吹き飛んでいった。屋内だったのにな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Kiryu tied back my hair for me. The instant she finished, her mask shot up into the air, flying off into the great blue yonder. What's strange is that we were indoors.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.1
Items.Message: 風林火山
Items.MessageLocalize: Wind, Forest, Fire, Mountain.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.2
Items.Message: 我が求めるのは強さであり、ただの力ではない。
Items.MessageLocalize: What I aim for is not mere strength, but power of will.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.3
Items.Message: 亡き友との約束が、戦場で我を支えてくれる。
Items.MessageLocalize: My promise with my dear friend keeps me fighting.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.4
Items.Message: 不器用ですまん。
Items.MessageLocalize: Sorry. I am not used to these kinds of things.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.5
Items.Message:
このくらいでいいか。
おおおおぉっ！砕け散れっ！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This should be enough.
RAAAGHHH! Break and shatter!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.6
Items.Message:
この自販機に用があったか。
邪魔をしてすまん。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Did you need to use this vending machine?
Sorry, I did not mean to be in the way.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.7
Items.Message:
我と立ち合いを望むのか？
ストリートでのファイトとは変わった仕組みだな。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You wish to go up against me?
In a street fight, no less. What a strange way to spar.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.8
Items.Message: 貴様も誰かを待っているのか？　我は…ふっ…ただ待ち続けているだけだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Are you waiting for someone too? Hah, so am I... I am waiting, simply waiting as long as it takes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.9
Items.Message: ほう、この服は我に似合っていると言うのか。これは友の見立てだ。いつか礼を言わねばな。
Items.MessageLocalize: So, this outfit looks good on me? A friend picked it out for me, actually. I should probably thank them someday.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.10
Items.Message:
当たり付きの自販機か…。
おお！当たったぞ！
ふむ、貴様が好きな物を選べ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
This vending machine has a chance for a random bonus...
Ah! I won! Hrm, yes,
choose whatever strikes your fancy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro04.11
Items.Message: 貴様には親友と呼べる友は居るか？　居るのなら僅かな時間も大切にするといい。
Items.MessageLocalize: Do you have anyone you consider a true friend? If you do, you should cherish every moment with them, no matter how brief.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.1
Items.Message: 風林火山
Items.MessageLocalize: Wind, Forest, Fire, Mountain.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.2
Items.Message: 我が求めるのは強さであり、ただの力ではない。
Items.MessageLocalize: What I aim for is not mere strength, but power of will.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.3
Items.Message: 亡き友との約束が、戦場で我を支えてくれる。
Items.MessageLocalize: My promise with my dear friend keeps me fighting.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.4
Items.Message: 不器用ですまん。
Items.MessageLocalize: Sorry. I am not used to these kinds of things.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.5
Items.Message: 遊びも修行だと思えるようになるとは…我も随分と丸くなったものだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: To think I would be able to equate playing around with training... I must be getting soft.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.6
Items.Message: 花吹雪く剣の道。修羅の如く斬り捨てん！
Items.MessageLocalize: Walking the way of the blade among fluttering petals. Like a ferocious demon, I shall strike you down!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.7
Items.Message: 夜桜に思いを馳せながら、貴様と一杯交わすのも悪くなかろう。熱々の豚汁をな。
Items.MessageLocalize: I wouldn't mind sharing a cup with you while contemplating the cherry blossoms at night. A cup of piping-hot pork soup, I mean.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.8
Items.Message: 大きな白黒まんじゅうが最高…？　そんな美味そうなもの、どこにも無いように見えるが…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Giant black-and-white manju are the best? Where? I don't see anything that delicious around here.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.9
Items.Message: 桜か。儚く散らず、ただそこにあって欲しいと願うのは、我の我儘なのだろうな…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Cherry blossoms? Hrm. I suppose it would be selfish of me to wish for them to linger longer, rather than fade so quickly.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.10
Items.Message: この三つ編み、無骨な我にしては上手く編めたのではないだろうか…ああ、不思議とひとりで編めたのだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: How did I do this French braid, given how clumsy I am? Miraculously, I managed by myself, somehow.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MTsukishiro05.11
Items.Message: いよおおっし！　これで花びら連続キャッチ勝負は引き分けだな！　次こそは勝つ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hoo-rah! That makes the petal-catching contest a tie! The next round shall seal my victory!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.1
Items.Message: 鳴らせ退魔の弦！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ring true, bolt of evil's bane!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.2
Items.Message: ではこの、日本伝統文化保存同好会の入会申込書にサインを。
Items.MessageLocalize: Here, please sign this application to join the Association for the Preservation of Traditional Japanese Culture.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.3
Items.Message: 会を謳っておきながら未だひとりとは…これではただの日本伝統文化保存同好の人…否否否、会会会！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Although it is an association, there is still only one member. At this rate, it's just a Person for the Preservation of Traditional Japanese Culture. ...Nay, nay, nay! It must be an association!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.5
Items.Message:
ココンコンコン♪ 呼びましたか？ 
我は神の眷属なり♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ring-ding-ding-ding-dingeringeding. ♪
Did you summon me, the descendant of the great fox goddess?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.6
Items.Message: こんなにひらひらがついた着物は初めてです。どうでしょう？ 似合っていますでしょうか。
Items.MessageLocalize: I have never worn such a frilly kimono before. How does it look on me? Does it suit me?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.7
Items.Message: なんて素晴らしい…稲荷神の使いになった気分です。目に見えない霊獣で白狐と呼ばれていたそうです。
Items.MessageLocalize: My, how wonderful. I feel like a messenger of the fox god Inari. They say these messengers were holy beasts in the form of white foxes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.8
Items.Message: 紅葉と五重塔！！ わたくしなんてどうでもいい！！ 見てください、紅葉と五重塔の織りなす美！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Behold, the famed Goju-no-To in autumn splendor! Pay no heed to me, and feast your eyes on the beauty of this cultural marvel!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.9
Items.Message: え？ 京都の和菓子店５０軒の３００品全種をわたくしに？ そないにようけあっても食べられへんよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh? Are you offering me 300 types of Kyoto's best Japanese sweets collected from over 50 shops? My, I would not be able to even sample all of that!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.10
Items.Message: はい、ちょうどきつねうどんのＣＭ撮影に行ってくるところです。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah. I am currently in the middle of filming a commercial for Kitsune Udon.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu04.11
Items.Message:
脇丸出しの着物なんてものが？ 
なんなら胸まで見えてません？ 
ものすごい格好をしてる気が…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
To think, there are kimono like this with open shoulders.
You...cannot see my breasts, can you?
I feel as if I am wearing something incredibly risqué.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.1
Items.Message: 鳴らせ退魔の弦！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ring true, bolt of evil's bane!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.2
Items.Message: ではこの、日本伝統文化保存同好会の入会申込書にサインを。
Items.MessageLocalize: Here, please sign this application to join the Association for the Preservation of Traditional Japanese Culture.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.3
Items.Message: 会を謳っておきながら未だひとりとは…これではただの日本伝統文化保存同好の人…否否否、会会会！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Although it is an association, there is still only one member. At this rate, it's just a Person for the Preservation of Traditional Japanese Culture. ...Nay, nay, nay! It must be an association!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.5
Items.Message: この弦音はいつか永遠を数える…。
Items.MessageLocalize: The twang of my bowstring shall one day ring to eternity.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.6
Items.Message:
触れ合うほどそばにいらしても結構
ですよ。日本伝統文化保存同好会に
入会していただければ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
You may stand close enough for our
skin to touch...but only if you join the
Association for the Preservation of Traditional Japanese Culture.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.7
Items.Message:
斜め４５度に持つと長続きするそうです。ならいっそ逆さにすれば？
熱、熱、熱！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I have heard it will last longer if you hold it at a 45-degree angle.
Then what if I hold it pointing up?
Hot, hot, hot!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.8
Items.Message:
どこを見ているのですか？さらしを
巻いて強調を抑えてるぐらい、
慎ましやかな姿なのに。
Items.MessageLocalize:
What is there to ogle?
Why, I've even wrapped my upper body in sarashi
to minimize my curves and present a modest profile.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.9
Items.Message:
ああ…あそこがあられもない…
もしかして見えちゃってますか…
その…うなじが…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ooh, but no, I am in fact exposed.
You must be able to see it all...
All of the nape of my neck.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.10
Items.Message:
白河さん、一緒にどうですか。
いや、もちろんいいですよ…
茅森さんも。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Will you join me, Shirakawa?
Oh, of course I don't mind.
You can come too, Kayamori.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu05.11
Items.Message:
４２本入りの線香花火があと
１０箱ぶんあるんよ。
最後まで付きおうてくれへん？
Items.MessageLocalize:
There are ten boxes of fireworks left,
each containing 42 sparklers.
Won't you join me in burning through them all?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.1
Items.Message: 鳴らせ退魔の弦！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ring true, bolt of evil's bane!

Items.Message:
抹茶を飲むと思い出す…
あの時交わしてしまった間接キス…
その味を…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Every time I try to drink matcha...
I cannot help but to recall the indirect kiss we shared...
The taste of...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.6
Items.Message: かつては悪疫退散を祈ったそうな。たまやー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Apparently, people used to turn to prayer to ward themselves from plague and pestilence. Tamayaaa!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.7
Items.Message: 日焼け止めの塗り合いっこ！？　わたくしはどれだけでも塗られて構いませんが、あなたをぉ！？
Items.MessageLocalize: A sunscreen-slathering contest, you say?! Naturally, I can accept being plastered all over, but what of you?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.8
Items.Message: 白河さん、絶対その肌を焼くことは許されません！　このわたくしが満遍なくお塗りします！
Items.MessageLocalize: Shirakawa, you must not allow your impeccable skin to be tanned! Allow me to apply this thoroughly and evenly!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.9
Items.Message: 足の先まで塗るのは難しいですね…え？　手伝ってくれるのですか？　あ…ありがとうございます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: It is no easy feat making sure everything is coated from head to toe... Huh? You would like to help me? Well, um...thank you...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.10
Items.Message: わたくしの肌が、貞子みたいな白さ…？　もう、褒めてもなんにもでぇへんよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: My skin is as fair as Sadako's? Oh, hush, you. No amount of flattery will get you anywhere.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKiryu07.11
Items.Message: そんな屈んでわたくしを盾にして…よほど日焼けしたくないのですね。それとも別の理由が？
Items.MessageLocalize: Crouching down like that to use me as a shield... Are you so afraid of getting sunburnt? Or do you have some other motive?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.1
Items.Message: カワイイは最強ですわ
Items.MessageLocalize: Cute de la Crème!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.2
Items.Message: あたくしに釘付けになってもよろしくてよ？あなたも幸せ、あたくしも幸せ、素晴らしいことですわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, you can gander at me all you want. You're happy, I'm happy, it's a win for everyone.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.3
Items.Message:
ロリータとは常に可愛いを追求し、
自らを磨き上げていくもの。
肝に銘じておくように。
Items.MessageLocalize: To embody lolita is to pursue perpetual self-improvement, all for the sake of cuteness. Keep that in mind, would you?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.4
Items.Message: ロリータでもキレる時はキレますの。キレ芸って言うなぁーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: A raging lolita is not to be trifled with. IT'S NOT JUST FOR SHOW!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.5
Items.Message: 可愛い選手権宇宙大会優勝のこの技を食らいなさい。うふ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This skill you're about to eat won me "Cutest Combatant in the Universe." Hehe.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.6
Items.Message: このシロクマはロリータ服を際立てるアクセント。野生のシロクマを手懐けたのではありませんわよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This polar bear is simply to enhance my outfit. It's not as if I tamed a wild one.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.7
Items.Message:
乱ロリータをお許しください。
今後ともごロリータを賜りますよう
お願い申し上げます。
Items.MessageLocalize: Apo-lolis for my un-loli-sticated manners. I do sincere-loli hope you will forgive my lapse in lolita.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.8
Items.Message: 流石あたくし。スウィートロリータも似合ってますわ…ってなんだその目ぇ！文句あんのか！！
Items.MessageLocalize: My! I look wonderful in sweet lolita style! ...What are YOU staring at?! You got a problem with me?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.9
Items.Message: 誰かこの鳥籠からあたくしを連れ出して…。おい！誰だ今笑った奴！
Items.MessageLocalize: Please, someone free me from this birdcage... HEY! Who laughed just now?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.10
Items.Message: 見ろ、この憂いに満ちた表情とポージング！服と相まって完っっ璧！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Look! Are you seeing this wistful expression, this pose?! It works PERFECTLY with these clothes!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara04.11
Items.Message: このままスノードームにしてあなたの部屋に飾って…って笑うな、そこぉーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll capture this moment in a snow globe, so you can display it in your room... Hey, why are you laughing?!

Have at them!

Items.MessageLocalize:
I am a lolita for the new age,

Kneel before me, knaves!

Items.Message:
ロリータは時に厳しく時に優しい…
まさに飴と鞭。これが鞭で、可愛い
あたくしを眺める権利が飴ですわ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
A lolita must deliver punishment and reward
in equal measure. This whip is your punishment, and
your reward is the privilege of gazing upon my adorableness.

Items.Message:
あたくしの前に跪きなさい。そう、
そしてそのままスカートの中を…
って何覗いてんだー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Kneel before me!
Yes, good. Now, gaze up at me in—
What are you doing looking up my skirt?!

ミリロリと言うよりＳＭの女王様に
見える？本当にお仕置きしてやろうか
ゴラァ！

This looks more like an S&M getup than
military lolita fashion, you say?
Maybe I should slap you around some, pig!

フリルと花弁がひらりと舞い…

Frills and petals dancing...
A lolita in their midst, smiling...
Truly, she is as beautiful as a rose.

この美しさ…精巧に作られたお人形のようですわ。黙ってれば、そう…
誰がキレさせてると思ってんだ！

So beautiful one would mistake her for a

Who do you think keeps pissing me off?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara07.6
Items.Message: ビーストモード解放。可愛くもギャオーンと殺りますの。
Items.MessageLocalize: Unleashing Beast Mode! I'll finish you, as adorably and fiercely as can be!

Items.Message: 時に粗暴に食べたくなるの…あら、あなたも食べられたいんですの？　いいですわよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Sometimes, I wish to eat without restraint, to devour without etiquette... Hm? You wish to be devoured as well? That can be arranged.

Items.Message: モフりたいんですの？　ふぅん、構わないですけどちゃんと面倒を見てくださいまし。
Items.MessageLocalize: You want to give me a good floofing? Fine by me, but do be mindful as to not to mess anything up.

Items.Message: 血の滴る生肉はお腹を壊しますの…ですのでこうして果肉を滴らせて我慢してますの。
Items.MessageLocalize: Raw meat dripping with blood does awful things to one's stomach...so I am holding back and merely letting the juices run.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CSugahara07.10
Items.Message: She is Legendの新曲『本能寺、ドレスコードで。』のイントロは血湧き肉躍りますわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: The introduction to She is Legend's "Dress Code at Honnoji" truly gets one's blood pumping.

Items.Message: もふもふな尻尾…ココンコンコンの美也さんと並んだら最強の『可愛い』の出来上がりですわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This wonderfully fluffy tail...when combined with Miya's foxy mode, we shall reach previously unseen pinnacles of cuteness.

Items.MessageLocalize: Approach and be sundered!

か、可愛いって言わないでください！
心が乱れますっ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
D-Don't call me cute!
It's going to corrupt me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara05.4
Items.Message:
剣を使えば最強ですー！
誰にも負けませんーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm unbeatable, as long as I use a blade!
I won't lose to anyone!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara05.5
Items.Message:
はわわわわ！これで部隊最強です！
どや！あれ…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
W-Wow! With this, I'm definitely the strongest in my squad!
See! I think...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara05.6
Items.Message: え…？あれ！？なんですこの耳は！？　天音さんの魔法薬のせいですか！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Wha—? What are these ears?! Is this because of Tenne's potion?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara05.7
Items.Message: 可愛いって言われる…絶対に言われる…心が持ちませんっ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh no...people are going to call me cute. I-I can't handle it!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara05.8
Items.Message: こ、こんな姿ではお弟子さんに対して威厳が保てません！
Items.MessageLocalize: I-I don't dare to face my dear pupil while wearing this embarrassing outfit!

この制服は世を忍ぶための仮の姿。

Items.MessageLocalize:

I am a veteran, and your senior!!!

Items.Message:
へいゆー！ほーるどあっぷ！
動くと斬りますよ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hey you! Hold up!
One false move and you shall be sundered.

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara07.8
Items.Message:
わたしが天才かどうか、
今ここで試してみますか？
無事でいられる保証はしませんが。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Would you like to find out
whether I'm truly a genius?
You may not survive the process.

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara07.9
Items.Message:
お弟子さん、今はわたしを先輩と
呼んでもいいんですよ。あれ？どこに行くんですか？お弟子さーん？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Feel free to refer to me as
senpai, my dear pupil. Huh?
Where are you going, my pupil?

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara07.10

その背中の得物は飾りですかって？
そうです、飾りです！
天才剣士なのに！ははははっ！

Is this sword just for decoration, you ask?
Indeed it is!
Even though I'm a genius swordswoman! Hahahaha!

ぴょんっ、ぴょーんっ…はっ！

Jump! Sproing! Oh...
My dear pupil, do not look at me with such pity in your eyes!!!

Items.Message:
う、うさぎさんたちっ、膝に登らないでください！　ひゃうっ！？
ぺろっもだめですーー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
P-Please, little rabbits, don't climb up my legs like that! Hyah?!
And don't lick me, either!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara09.9
Items.Message: うぅ…一体いつまでこのポーズをしていれば…絶対顔真っ赤になってます…変な汗も出てきましたぁ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oogh... How long must I hold this ridiculous pose? I'm certain my face is bright red...and now I've started sweating.

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara09.10
Items.Message: どうしてクールな天才剣士に毎回耳や尻尾付きの可愛い服を着せるんですか！
Items.MessageLocalize: Why must a mysterious and aloof genius swordswoman such as myself be forced to wear these cutesy outfits time after time? I've grown tired of animal ears and tails!

Items.Label: CardVoice.HOgasawara09.11
Items.Message:
あ、見つけました！
イースターエッグです！
中身は何かなー…ってさらに卵！？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh, I found an Easter egg!
What could be inside? It's...another egg?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.1
Items.Message: 五穀豊穣、刈り入れ時だね！
Items.MessageLocalize: A bountiful harvest, ripe for reaping!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.2
Items.Message: あたいと月城ちゃんのコンビは最強さ。戦闘だろうと定食屋だろうと、なんだって成し遂げてみせるよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Tsukishiro and I are an unbeatable duo. Whether on the battlefield or in a fine dining establishment, there is nothing we cannot accomplish.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.3
Items.Message: 裏通りの田んぼはあたいの宝物だよ。小さな田んぼだけど、ありったけの愛情を籠めて稲を育ててるのさ。
Items.MessageLocalize: The little paddy in the woodway is my treasure. It might not be much, but I put my heart and soul into growing rice there.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.4
Items.Message: 特製グルメは半年先まで予約でいっぱいだよ。その日まで楽しみにしておきな、きっとご馳走するからさ。
Items.MessageLocalize: We're fully booked six months out if you want a chance to taste our gourmet specialty. Do look forward to that day, however—we shall treat you to a spectacular feast.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.5
Items.Message: 本当に履かないほうがすっきりするのかね。試してみるか…？　いや、大事なものを失う気がするよ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Does it really feel better not wearing anything underneath? Should I try... Forget it—I feel like I would be losing something important if I did that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.6
Items.Message: 暑い夏こそしっかり食べな！　キンキンの冷やし茶漬けお待ちどぉ！
Items.MessageLocalize: The torrid heat of summer is all the more reason to eat well! I have ice-cold ochazuke waiting right here for you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.7
Items.Message: どんなボールだろうと絶対に拾ってみせるよ！　月城ちゃん、アタックは任せた！
Items.MessageLocalize: No matter how they hit it, I will get the save, I guarantee! Tsukishiro, I leave the spike to you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.8
Items.Message: 触らせて？　駄目だよ。この身体の虜になったら、ぼーっとなって戦場での死亡率が高まっちゃうからね。
Items.MessageLocalize: You'd like to give me a feel? Absolutely not. If you get addicted to this body, you would be at greater risk of dying in battle.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.9
Items.Message: バレーしてテニスして、タコ狩って…。楽しいだけのはずなのに、涙が出ちまいそうなあたいが居るよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Volleyball, tennis, octopus hunting... These things are supposed to be merely for fun, and yet I find myself on the verge of tears.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.10
Items.Message: なんだい、よっ、トロピカルだねぇ！って。トロピカルはあたいの専売特許だよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: What's that? Oh, "totally tropical"? I can do totally tropical. It's basically my specialty.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SKura06.11
Items.Message: 特製お米パフェが新登場だよ。団子に米粉のアイス、米ぬかで作ったクッキーが入った米づくしの逸品さ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Now introducing: our brand-new special rice parfait. A veritable ensemble of rice including dango, rice flour ice cream, and rice bran cookies.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.1
Items.Message: 天元、取ったり
Items.MessageLocalize: To claim the nexus.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.2
Items.Message: 未来の棋聖へと至るべく碁を打ち続け、囲碁の世界の全てを塗り替えてみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will continue to lay stones on the board, in order to become a Go grandmaster and change the landscape of the game.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.3
Items.Message:
その…なんだ、
みさりん…というのはやめないか？私には可愛すぎると思うんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Um...could you stop calling me "Misarin"? It seems...slightly too cute for me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.4
Items.Message:
きゃー！宇治抹茶と
ホイップクリームのパンケーキ！
私これ好きー！大好きーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohhh! Matcha pancake with whipped cream! I love this so much! So, so, sooo much!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.5
Items.Message:
来い。白くて丸いお前たち！
さあ進めー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Heed me, my round and snowy little friends! March forward!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.6
Items.Message:
色違いだが伊達と衣装を
揃えてみたんだ。どうだ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
The color scheme is different, but I chose this outfit to match Date's.
How does it look?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.7
Items.Message:
それにしてもこの衣装は足が
出すぎではないか…？
こういうのがいいのか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't you think this outfit is a bit too... breezy around the legs? Is this what's fashionable nowadays?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.8
Items.Message:
その…最近、伊達と命の仲が
いいように見えるのだが…
気のせいだろうか。
Items.MessageLocalize: It seems Date and Mikoto are getting quite close these days... Or is it just me?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.9
Items.Message:
リンリン～、聖夜の使者の登場だ。…すまん、忘れてくれ。
今のは気の迷いだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Jingle, jingle! Here I am, an emissary of the holy night... W-Wait, ignore that. I just got a little carried away...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.10
Items.Message:
クリスマスか。懐かしいな、
プレゼントで扇子をもらったことを
今でも覚えている。
Items.MessageLocalize: Christmas, hm? I can still recall fondly of the time I was given a beautiful paper fan as a present.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido04.11
Items.Message:
サンタクロースを信じているかだと？何を言っている。
サンタさんは居るぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Do I believe in Santa? Why, of course Santa exists. What a silly question.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.1
Items.Message: 天元、取ったり
Items.MessageLocalize: To claim the nexus.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.2
Items.Message: 未来の棋聖へと至るべく碁を打ち続け、囲碁の世界の全てを塗り替えてみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will continue to lay stones on the board, in order to become a Go grandmaster and change the landscape of the game.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.3
Items.Message:
その…なんだ、
みさりん…というのはやめないか？私には可愛すぎると思うんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Um...could you stop calling me "Misarin"? It seems...slightly too cute for me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.4
Items.Message:
きゃー！宇治抹茶と
ホイップクリームのパンケーキ！
私これ好きー！大好きーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohhh! Matcha pancake with whipped cream! I love this so much! So, so, sooo much!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.5
Items.Message:
最近パパと呼ばれるのに慣れてきている自分がいる。もしかしてこれが
父性の芽生え…！？
Items.MessageLocalize: I've been getting used to people calling me "Daddy" recently. Could this be...the beginning of my daddy powers?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.6
Items.Message:
（距離補正、空気抵抗、熱効率、
敵思考、クリア）
囲碁・ザ・ブラスト！
Items.MessageLocalize: (Accounting for distance, air resistance, thermal efficiency, and enemy vantage. All clear.) Go: Strategic Strike!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.7
Items.Message:
私と夜の街をデートしたい？
いいだろう、スイーツビュッフェに
繰り出すぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: You want to take me out for a night on the town? Sounds good to me. Let's go to a dessert buffet.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.8
Items.Message:
この格好を伊達に見せたら、顔を
真っ赤にして倒れてしまった。そこまで似合っていないのだろうか…。
Items.MessageLocalize: When I showed this outfit to Date, she turned beet-red, then passed out. Maybe it doesn't look good on me after all...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.9
Items.Message:
ネクタイはあまり得意じゃないんだ。実は今朝も室伏に締めるのを
手伝ってもらった。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm not very good at tying ties. To be honest, Murofush did mine for me this morning.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.10
Items.Message:
任務終わりのパフェは最高だな。
仕事終わりにビールを飲むサラリーマンの気持ちがわかる気がする。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nothing beats a parfait after a tough mission. I suppose this is similar to an office worker cracking open a can of beer after a day's work.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido06.11
Items.Message:
今の私を祖父が見たら孫が反抗期になったのではと心配かけそうだ…
ふふっ。
Items.MessageLocalize: If my grandfather saw me now, he'd probably think I'm going through a rebellious phase... Heh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.1
Items.Message: 天元、取ったり
Items.MessageLocalize: To claim the nexus.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.2
Items.Message: 未来の棋聖へと至るべく碁を打ち続け、囲碁の世界の全てを塗り替えてみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will continue to lay stones on the board, in order to become a Go grandmaster and change the landscape of the game.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.3
Items.Message:
その…なんだ、
みさりん…というのはやめないか？私には可愛すぎると思うんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Um...could you stop calling me "Misarin"? It seems...slightly too cute for me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.4
Items.Message:
きゃー！宇治抹茶と
ホイップクリームのパンケーキ！
私これ好きー！大好きーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohhh! Matcha pancake with whipped cream! I love this so much! So, so, sooo much!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.5
Items.Message:
最近パパと呼ばれるのに慣れてきている自分がいる。もしかしてこれが
父性の芽生え…！？
Items.MessageLocalize: I've been getting used to people calling me "Daddy" recently. Could this be...the beginning of my daddy powers?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.6
Items.Message:
白黒つけるぞ！
Ｇｏ！　Ｆｉｇｈｔ！　Ｗｉｎ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Time to settle this!
Go! Fight! Win!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.7
Items.Message: いつもあんなに食べてるのにお腹を出して平気か、だと？　失礼だな、ほら、触ってみろ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Should I be showing my midriff when I eat so much all the time, you ask? How rude! Here, go ahead! Touch and see for yourself!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.8
Items.Message:
フレっ！フレっ！黒石！
頑張れ頑張れ白石！…って囲碁でこんな応援しないだろ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hooray! Hooray! Black stones! You can do this, white stones!
Wait... You aren't supposed to cheer in a Go match!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.9
Items.Message:
笑顔が素敵だと？　ふっ、当然だ。大事な仲間達への応援だからな。
自然と顔が綻ぶ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
My smile looks wonderful? Heh, of course. I'm cheering my dear friends on.
Of course I'm beaming.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.10
Items.Message: 案ずるな伊達、スカートの下は完全防御だ。え、太ももが露わになってる？　そ、そんなところ見るな！
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't worry, Date. My defenses under the the skirt are foolproof. Huh? My thighs are on full display? D-Don't look at them!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MNikaido07.11
Items.Message: 全力で体を動かした後のスイーツはきっと格別だろうなぁ～…はっ！　よだれが服に！
Items.MessageLocalize: Desserts taste so much better after a good workout! Ack! My drool is getting all over my clothes!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.1
Items.Message: 世界をあーし色に染め上げるッス
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll paint the world in my colors!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.2
Items.Message: ま～る描いてゴブシュッ、ま～る描いてズブシュッ、塗り塗り～…出来たっス！　ナービィの完成っスー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Draw a big ol' circle like thiiis, then throw a splash of paint in it like thaaat, and fill it all in~ There you go, a perfect Narby!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.3
Items.Message: 創作意欲がバリバリ湧いて止まんねーっス！　あーしにしか描けない絵を描いていくっス！
Items.MessageLocalize: My creative juices are flowing strong and they aren't gonna stop! I'm gonna draw something only I can draw!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.4
Items.Message: 駆逐するぜキャンサー、見る目もないぼんくら、それがあーし自身のアンサー、その名は石井色葉ー！
Items.MessageLocalize: All these Cancers, blind fools with no taste, will be exterminated by my hand! That's what it means to be me, Iroha Ishii!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.5
Items.Message: ちょっとストップ！　表情キープっス！　いまムメミョメーってきたんで描かせて欲しいっス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hold it right there! Yeah, keep that expression! I just got struck by a bolt of inspiration, and so I've gotta DRAW!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.6
Items.Message: あーしにかかれば…世界の全てがキャンバスっス！　グラフィティパレード！！
Items.MessageLocalize: If you ask me...the entire world's my canvas! Graffiti Paraaade!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.7
Items.Message: ここに来たってことは…あーし色に染まる覚悟完了ってことっすよネ！　ズバシャーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: The fact that you're here...means you're ready to get dyed in my colors! *SPRAY*!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.8
Items.Message: また胸見てるっすネ。いいっすけど…え？　お腹？　お…お腹は…うぅ…じっと見ないで欲しい…っス…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oglin' my chest again? Sure, look all you want... Huh? My tummy? Wh-What about it? Ugh... P-Please don't stare like that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.9
Items.Message: あーしの筆がキャンバスだけに走るなんて誰が言ったっすカ？　カメラに塗り塗り～！
Items.MessageLocalize: Who said my brush is limited to a canvas? I'm gonna paint the camera too!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.10
Items.Message: 髪解くと絵の具で汚れて固まっちゃうんすけド…けど今は解き放ちたいっス！　フリーーダーーーム！！
Items.MessageLocalize: My hair's gonna get all crusty with paint if I let it down...but right now, that's EXACTLY what I wanna do! FREEEDOMMM!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii05.11
Items.Message: いつかこのアトリエをあーしの絵でいっぱいにしたいっス。そしてあーしの世界をみんなに届けたいっス。
Items.MessageLocalize: One day, I'd like to fill this entire studio with my paintings, and share my world with everyone.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.1
Items.Message: 世界をあーし色に染め上げるッス
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll paint the world in my colors!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.2
Items.Message: ま～る描いてゴブシュッ、ま～る描いてズブシュッ、塗り塗り～…出来たっス！　ナービィの完成っスー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Draw a big ol' circle like thiiis, then throw a splash of paint in it like thaaat, and fill it all in~ There you go, a perfect Narby!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.3
Items.Message: 創作意欲がバリバリ湧いて止まんねーっス！　あーしにしか描けない絵を描いていくっス！
Items.MessageLocalize: My creative juices are flowing strong and they aren't gonna stop! I'm gonna draw something only I can draw!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.4
Items.Message: 駆逐するぜキャンサー、見る目もないぼんくら、それがあーし自身のアンサー、その名は石井色葉ー！
Items.MessageLocalize: All these Cancers, blind fools with no taste, will be exterminated by my hand! That's what it means to be me, Iroha Ishii!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.5
Items.Message: ちょっとストップ！　表情キープっス！　いまムメミョメーってきたんで描かせて欲しいっス！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hold it right there! Yeah, keep that expression! I just got struck by a bolt of inspiration, and so I've gotta DRAW!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.6
Items.Message:
これがあーし色ウエディング！
幸せのお裾分け！っすヨ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This is a wedding splashed in my colors!
I'll share all my happiness with you, yo!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.7
Items.Message: うおおおーー！　溢れ出るハピネス！　絵の具の代わりに花びらをまき散らすっス！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Whoooaaa! The happiness is surging out! Instead of paint, there's, like, flower petals flying everywhere!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.8
Items.Message: いざ着てみると、意外といいものでぃすネ…って、みさとっちとりさっちが号泣してるっスーー！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Now that I'm wearing this, it's totes not so bad... Whoa, Misatocchi and Risacchi are, like, bawling for real!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.9
Items.Message: はっ！？　ゴリヌブシャとインスピレーションが！　でもドレス汚さないよう道具没収されてるっスーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Wait! Inspiration just struck like golinubusha! But they took my painting tools away cause they could, like, get the dress dirty!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.10
Items.Message: 健やかなる時も病める時も嬉しい時も悲しい時も…あなたの色に染まってみるのもいいっすネ
Items.MessageLocalize: In happiness and in sorrow, in sickness and in health...it totes wouldn't be so bad to be painted in your colors, yo.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IIshii06.11
Items.Message: あーしの理想のお嫁さん像でぃすカ？　大事なひとのために頑張れる、お母さんみたいなお嫁さんでぃス！
Items.MessageLocalize: My ideal bride? That's totes somebody who works hard for the person dearest to her, just like my mom!

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.1
Items.Message: Make a Change… Kill Yourself
Items.MessageLocalize: Make a change... Kill yourself.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.2
Items.Message: ギャイアグレイーイボドドドゥドオー！！って気が合うじゃねーか。最高だぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This deserves a GYAYAGRAYYYBODODODODUOH!!! Dang, that felt good.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.3
Items.Message: はっ、平和な時あんな音楽性のために孤独になっちまったのに、戦時下になって仲間が出来るとはおかしなものだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: *sigh*... How ironic that my music left me only loneliness in times of peace, but brought me friends in times of war.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.4
Items.Message: なああんた…なぜ生きてるんだ？と疑問に思ったりしないかい…さあ、こっちに来なよ…あたしの音楽を聴けぇ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hey you, ever wonder why were even alive? Now, come over here...and listen to my music!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.5
Items.Message: あたしの音源を買ってくれた２１人のファン、元気にしてっかな。たまに聴いてくれてるかな。この絶望の世界で。
Items.MessageLocalize: I wonder how the 21 fans who bought my music are doing. Hopefully they give it a listen every now and then. In this world of despair...

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.6
Items.Message: そしてサンタは顕現するーー！　by命吹雪
Items.MessageLocalize: Thus Appeareth Santa! – by Fubuki Mikoto.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.7
Items.Message: いいね…これだけ露出していると凍え死にそうだ…朝には凍死したサンタが一丁上がりさ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yeah, sure... I'm just gonna go freeze to death with how little this covers... And come morning, you'll have yourself an iced-over Santa-sickle.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.8
Items.Message: くそ…恥ずかしいぜ…そんな見てくんなよ…慣れてねぇんだよ…素顔を晒すことにさ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ugh... this is so damn embarrassing. Stop looking at me like that...I'm not used to...showing my real face like this...

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.9
Items.Message: なになに…ゲームソフトをください？　いいだろう、鬱ゲーならたくさん知ってるぜぇ…？
Items.MessageLocalize: What's that? You want video game recommendations? Uhh, sure. I've got lots of emo stuff.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.10
Items.Message: なになに…告白する勇気をください？　いいだろう、告白するまでその背に銃口を突きつけてやるよ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: What's that? You want the courage to confess your love? Uhh, sure. I can hold a gun to your head until you 'fess up.

Items.Label: CardVoice.FMikoto04.11
Items.Message: なになに…可愛いぬいぐるみをください？　いいだろう、有刺鉄線にぐるぐる巻きにした奴をやるよぉ！
Items.MessageLocalize: What's that? You want a cute stuffed animal? Uhh, sure. I'll find one for you, wrapped in barbed wire!

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.1
Items.Message: 常に上を向いていきましょう
Items.MessageLocalize: Believe in good things to come.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.2
Items.Message: ふふふ、甘えたくなっちゃったんですか？　いいですよー。ぎゅーってしてあげます。
Items.MessageLocalize: Teehee. Oh, you want a good pampering? Fine by me~ Come here so I can give you a big hug.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.3
Items.Message: 気持ちが沈んだ時は一緒にバレーボールをしましょう。上を向いて声を出すと、前向きになれますよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: If you're ever feeling down, let's clear your mind with a game of volleyball. Lift your head up and let your voice resound, and before long, you'll feel far more positive.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.4
Items.Message: ふう…私もたまには…甘えたくなる時もあるんですよ？　ばぶぅ。…ちょっと恥ずかしいですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mm... You know, there are times when I feel like being coddled. Ga-goo... No, that's far too embarrassing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.5
Items.Message: 私はあなたのいいところ、たくさん知っていますよ。えらいですねー。すごく、すごーくえらいですよー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Actually, I know all about what makes you amazing. You're totally awesome. Without a doubt in my mind.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.6
Items.Message: あなたも一緒にお祝いしますか？　初日の出、ですよー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Would you like to come celebrate with me? The first sunrise of the year will be here soon.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.7
Items.Message: あら、迷い込んでしまったんですか？　飛び立つ前に少し、羽休めですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh my, did you lose your way? Why not rest your wings for a spell before you fly off again?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.8
Items.Message: お正月に食べるお餅は美味しいですねー。いくつ食べますか？　ところで、どこを見ているんですかー？
Items.MessageLocalize: New Year's mochi always tastes amazing, doesn't it? How much would you like? By the way...where are those eyes wandering~?

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.9
Items.Message: おせちも準備してありますからねー。ゆっくり、ごろごろ、一緒に寝正月にしちゃいましょう？
Items.MessageLocalize: I've finished preparing osechi. Let's just relax, unwind, and enjoy the New Year together.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.10
Items.Message: 瀬をはやみ岩にせかるる滝川のわれても末にあはむとぞ思ふ。離れてもいつかまた巡り合えますように。
Items.MessageLocalize: Even if surging rapids eventually slow to a trickle and waterfalls eventually split apart, I believe that we will meet again in the end. No matter the distance, I hope our paths cross again one day.

Items.Label: CardVoice.RMurohushi07.11
Items.Message: この蝶はどこに飛んでいくのでしょう…願うなら暖かくて平和な世界に…家族の元に辿りつけますように。
Items.MessageLocalize: Where will this butterfly go, I wonder? To a warm and peaceful world, I hope.... May you find your way back to your family.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.1
Items.Message: エースをねらわれるな
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't aim for the Ace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.2
Items.Message:
わ…わたしなんかより
ゾウリムシの繊毛のほうが
よっぽど役に立ちます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: E-Even the tiny cilia of a paramecium serves more purpose than... someone like me...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.3
Items.Message: 先輩が居たからテニスを続けることが出来ました。ずっと尊敬しています。尊敬し続けます。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's because of her... my senior... that I was able to continue playing tennis. I still admire her even now, and forever.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.4
Items.Message: す、すみません…でしゃばってますよね…わたしなんてお目汚しですよね…。消えたい…。
Items.MessageLocalize: S-Sorry... I shouldn't be flaunting around my trashy self like this... Ohhh, I wish I could just melt into nothing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.5
Items.Message: わたしからのクリスマスプレ…えええええ！　やってしまいました…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Here's my Christmas present to... yooou?! I-I didn't mean to do that!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.6
Items.Message:
く、黒いサンタは悪い子を懲らしめる…そうです…。こ、こ、
懲らしめちゃうぞ…！
Items.MessageLocalize: I-If you're on the naughty list... y-you... You'd better be prepared for some punishment from Santa...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.7
Items.Message: ス…スカートが短い気がしますけど…アンダースコートを履いて…あれ？忘れてる…！？
Items.MessageLocalize: T-This skirt seems awfully short, but at least I wore my shorts undernea... wait, um... D-Did I forget to put them on...?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.8
Items.Message: 二階堂さんと…お揃い？とんでもありません！あちらは太陽のように神々しくわたしはゴミです！
Items.MessageLocalize: Me? Wearing matching outfits with Nikaido...? Oh, no, I'm no match to her at all! She's absolutely glowing and divine, while I'm as dull as grime smeared on a trash can!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.9
Items.Message:
命さんにも似合うって言われました…衣装は可愛いと思いますが、
中身は産業廃棄物です…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mikoto said this outfit looks good... I mean, the clothes are certainly very cute... but with cute clothes or not, I'm still pure industrial waste.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.10
Items.Message:
シングルベール、シングルベール、鈴は泣く～…
メリ～くるしみます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the waaay... Oh, what pain it is to live... I should just go away...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate04.11
Items.Message: わ、わたしがクリスマスプレゼント…です…。って、まっすぐゴミ箱行きですよね。
Items.MessageLocalize: I-I'm your...Christmas present. But I bet...I'll just be tossed straight into a dumpster...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.1
Items.Message: エースをねらわれるな
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't aim for the Ace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.2
Items.Message:
わ…わたしなんかより
ゾウリムシの繊毛のほうが
よっぽど役に立ちます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: E-Even the tiny cilia of a paramecium serves more purpose than... someone like me...

Items.Message: 先輩が居たからテニスを続けることが出来ました。ずっと尊敬しています。尊敬し続けます。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's because of her... my senior... that I was able to continue playing tennis. I still admire her even now, and forever.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.4
Items.Message: す、すみません…でしゃばってますよね…わたしなんてお目汚しですよね…。消えたい…。
Items.MessageLocalize: S-Sorry... I shouldn't be flaunting around my trashy self like this... Ohhh, I wish I could just melt into nothing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.5
Items.Message: アホ毛ですか…？　はい、アホなので生えてます…アホですみません…可愛い？　え、ええええっ！
Items.MessageLocalize: My ahoge...? Why yes, I do have one because I'm an idiot... Sorry, that's just how I am... Huh? It's cute? Huh? Hwuuhhh?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.6
Items.Message: 今年こそ皆さんのお役に…あばばばば。二階堂さーん！　命さーーん！　へぶっ！
Items.MessageLocalize: This year...I'll prove my worth to everyone... Ababababa! Nikaido! Mikotoooo! Bweh!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.7
Items.Message: 生まれて初めて大吉を引けました…！　とても嬉しいです！　これでもう思い残すことはありません…。
Items.MessageLocalize: This is the first time in my life that I've ever drawn "Great Fortune"! I'm so happy! I could pass on with no regrets now...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.8
Items.Message: 待ち人は…はっ！　わたしごときが何を…二階堂さんと命さんには内緒に…あー！　なんでもありません！
Items.MessageLocalize: The person I'm waiting for is...*gasp!* What can a good-for-nothing like me even do... Please keep it a secret from Nikaido and Mikoto... Ah! Forget I said anything!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.9
Items.Message: あ、あれ…お神酒を頂いたら急にくらくら、して…。ん…。す、少しだけ大胆になっていいです…か？
Items.MessageLocalize: H-Huh...? Why is my head spinning after trying the sacred sake...? Uhhh... Huh? I can afford to be a bit more confident...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.10
Items.Message: 花飾りですか？　これは白梅といって花言葉は、上品、気品…ふふ、わたしには欠片もないものですね…。
Items.MessageLocalize: A floral garland? I believe white plum blossoms symbolize...elegance and grace. Heh...things that I have absolutely none of...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate05.11
Items.Message: はひゃっ！？　せ、背中に何か、ひぇ！？　なんでもしますから取ってくださいー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: H-Hwuh?! Th-There's something on my back?! Eek! Just get it off me already, I'll do anything!

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.1
Items.Message: エースをねらわれるな
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't aim for the Ace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.2
Items.Message:
わ…わたしなんかより
ゾウリムシの繊毛のほうが
よっぽど役に立ちます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: E-Even the tiny cilia of a paramecium serves more of a purpose than...someone like me...

Items.Message: 先輩が居たからテニスを続けることが出来ました。ずっと尊敬しています。尊敬し続けます。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's because of her... my senior... that I was able to continue playing tennis. I still admire her even now, and forever.

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.6
Items.Message: どこ行くんですかー！　なんで大玉がー！？　ぴぎゃっ！　うぅ～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Where are you going? Why is there a giant ball here?! Pygah! *whimper*

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.7
Items.Message: 網くぐりは得意かもしれません…這いつくばるのには慣れてますから。
Items.MessageLocalize: I might actually be good at crawling underneath a net... After all, I'm used to crawling on the ground...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.8
Items.Message: ににに二階堂さん！　そっその衣装だと、引き締まったお腹と艶めかしい太ももが露わに…！
Items.MessageLocalize: N-N-Nikaido! Th-That outfit is revealing your toned abdomen and your captivating thighs...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.9
Items.Message: うぅ…あと少しなのに胸やお尻が引っ掛かって出れない…もうこのまま障害物として一生を過ごします…。
Items.MessageLocalize: *whimper* I'm almost there, but I can't get out since my chest and butt got stuck... I guess I will just live out the rest of my life as an obstacle in this race...

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.10
Items.Message:
借り物競争でわたしが必要…？
お題はゴミでしょうか…それとも焼却炉で焼き払いたいもの…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
You need me for the scavenger hunt race?
Do you need a piece of trash...or something that should be burned in the incinerator?

Items.Label: CardVoice.ADate06.11
Items.Message: こんなわたしでも、応援してくれるひとが居る…このバトンはなんとしても繋げてみせます…！
Items.MessageLocalize: There are people who are rooting for me even though I'm nothing but a disappointment... I'll pass on this baton no matter what!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.1
Items.Message: どこまでも潜るさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Dive deep into the unknown.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.2
Items.Message:
瑞原印のじゃこおにぎりさー。
ひとりひとり愛情を込めて大切に
育てたからよく噛んで味わうさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: These? They're Mizuhara-brand baby sardine rice balls. Each and every one was made with love and care, so be sure to savor every bite!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.3
Items.Message:
サメ映画は大好きさー。最後には
サメがひどい目に遭うのがサイコーさー。ふっとぶ様はザマーさー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I love shark movies! I especially love when the shark gets what's coming at the end of the film. Serves them right for being mean sharks!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.4
Items.Message:
海洋生物学に興味があるさー？
あいー！
一名様、深淵にご案内さー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Do you want to learn more about marine biology? Aye! Allow me to be your guide to the depths!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.5
Items.Message:
あいあいあいーー！キャプテン
あいなのクッキングタイムさー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aye aye!!! It's time for Captain Aina to cook!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.6
Items.Message:
ヨーホー、ヨーホー♪
キャプテンあいなの縄張りで、
サメに生存権はないのさー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Yo, ho! Yo, ho~ ♪
Listen up, sharks! You have no place in Captain Aina's domain!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.7
Items.Message:
海賊が眼帯をするのは常に片目を
暗闇に慣らしておくためさー。
これで深海でも安心さー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Did you know that pirates wear an eyepatch over one eye to keep it accustomed to the dark? That's how you survive in the deep sea!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.8
Items.Message:
あ、あい～～～！ドクターフィッシュのみんな、おへそをくすぐる
のはやめて欲しいさ～～～！
Items.MessageLocalize: A-Ayeeeee! Doctorfishies...p-please stop tickling my tummyyy~!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.9
Items.Message:
マキコは浅瀬に置いてきたさー。
これから先の冒険には
ついてこれないさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: I had to leave Makiko behind in the shallows. She won't be able to keep up with us on our adventure.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.10
Items.Message:
眼帯のロマンを語る会への招待状
from K.H.…？あいー…
底知れぬ深淵を感じるさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: An invitation to discuss the romance of eyepatches...from K.H.? Aye... Feels like I might be stepping into an unfathomable abyss.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara05.11
Items.Message:
この髪型はタチウオの三つ編み料理をイメージしたさー。…でもあいなの
ことは食べちゃダメさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: This hairstyle is braided to resemble a fish tail. But, that doesn't mean you should munch on me!

Items.MessageLocalize: Dive deep into the unknown.
