Items.Message:
海洋生物学に興味があるさー？
あいー！
一名様、深淵にご案内さー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Do you want to learn more about marine biology? Aye! Allow me to be your guide to the depths!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.6
Items.Message: あいー！　姫の眠りを妨げると…極刑さー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aye! The punishment for disturbing the princess's sleep is...death!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.7
Items.Message: みんなが選んでくれたドレスさー…でも、色々隙間があってちょっとだけ恥ずかしいさー…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Look at the dress the others picked out for me! It's, um...not as covering as I'm used to, so it's somewhat embarrassing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.8
Items.Message: 綺麗？　あいー、深海の魅力を知ってもらえてうれしい…え？　綺麗なのはあいな…？　あい～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Pretty, right? Aye, I'm glad that you're now able to appreciate the charms of the deep sea. H-Huh? You think I'M pretty?! Aye...

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.9
Items.Message: みんなをあいな姫の海底パーティに招待するさー。お魚さんが好きなら誰でもウェルカムさー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Everyone is invited to Princess Aina's underwater party! All fish-lovers are welcome!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.10
Items.Message: この場所、まるで海の中に居るようで心地いいさー。ふわふわ、ゆったり…ふわ～ぁ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: This place is so comfy, just like floating in the middle of the ocean. Swish, swoosh... It's so soft and fluffy!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara06.11
Items.Message: きゅっきゅ～♪　きゅきゅ～っ♪　かーちゃん。あいなはこれから、みんなとたくさん冒険するさー。
Items.MessageLocalize: *whistle whistle~ ♪* *whistle whistle~ ♪* Mommy, Aina is going to set off on fun adventures with her friends now.

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.6
Items.Message:
あいなと一緒にぐるぐるさー！
波乗り飛び魚スライダー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Come spin and spin with Aina!
On the wave-riding flying fish slider!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.7
Items.Message:
あかりちんが大量のナマコに埋もれてるさー！？　今助けるさー！
あいー？　自分で埋まったさー？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Akari-chin is being buried by tons of sea cucumbers! Let's go help her!
Aye? You buried yourself?

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.8
Items.Message: あはははーっ！　３１Ｄの皆でかーちゃんフロートに乗ってサメのどてっ腹ぶち抜くさー！　突撃さー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ahahaha! All of us from 31-D will ride the Mommy float and pierce through the sharks' tummies! Charge!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.9
Items.Message:
ひゃあっ！？　タコが水着の中に入ってきたさー！　あははっ！
そこは弱いからダメさー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hyah?! An octopus is trying to get inside my swimsuit! Ahaha!
Stop! That tickles!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.10
Items.Message: 水着はみさとちんとりさちんに選んでもらったひらひらクリオネ風さー。ポシェットはいろはちんさー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Misato-chin and Risa-chin picked this frilly clione swimsuit! And Iroha-chin picked the shoulder bag!

Items.Label: CardVoice.AMizuhara07.11
Items.Message: ふぁ……。ね、眠くなんてないさー！　まだまだ………みんなと海で、あそぶ…さー…ぐぅ。むにゃ……。
Items.MessageLocalize: Fwaaah... I-I'm not sleepy! I...I still wanna...play with...everyone at the beach... Mnngh...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.1
Items.Message: 大島家長女ここにあり！
Items.MessageLocalize: Have no fear, big sis is here!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.2
Items.Message: この本はもう頭に入ったから、次の本を借りてきましょう。勉強、勉強！
Items.MessageLocalize: I've already memorized this book, so let's go to the next one! Study, study, study!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.3
Items.Message: 妹たちを養っていくために、軍の中で出世しないと。もっと頑張らないと！
Items.MessageLocalize: I need to work even harder to move up the ranks so I can support my little sisters!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.4
Items.Message: 今週の週刊イチコは…うーん。ちょっと漫画の勉強をしましょう。ええと、この漫画をリスペクトと…。
Items.MessageLocalize: This week's "Weekly Ichiko" is... Hmm... Maybe I should study manga a little more. What if I did an homage to this work...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.5
Items.Message: ふふ…あなたも今日から大島家の一員です。
Items.MessageLocalize: Hehe... From now on, you're a part of the Ohshima family, too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.6
Items.Message: 笑顔が硬い…？ だってこんなに高そうで綺麗なドレス…。汚さないように気を付けないと。
Items.MessageLocalize: My smile's kinda stiff...? Well, I have to be extra mindful not to dirty such a pretty and expensive-looking dress.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.7
Items.Message: 素敵なお嫁さんになるための勉強もしっかりとしました！ 特に節約はお任せください。
Items.MessageLocalize: I've studied how to be a lovely bride, too! Leave the budgeting to me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.8
Items.Message:
妹たちのドレス姿も楽しみです。
あれ？ でもそれって誰かの元に？ 
ぴーががががががががががー。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I can't wait to see my sisters in a wedding dress.
Oh, but, that means they would be... leaving me... to join someone else's family...?
...Piipiipiipiipii BAAA pwiiGAApwiiGAApwii-PYSSHHHKKK.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.9
Items.Message: 妹たちが喜んでくれたのが、わたしにとって一番の祝福です。
Items.MessageLocalize: My sisters' happiness is the best blessing.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.10
Items.Message: 大島式結婚式のやり方ですか？ うーん、ただ言葉をかわすだけですね。永遠に変わらない言葉を。
Items.MessageLocalize: What would an Ohshima family style wedding be like? Um, I guess it would just be a vow of eternal, unchanging love.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima04.11
Items.Message: 健やかなるときも、病めるときも、喜びのときも、悲しみのときも、この命ある限り真心を尽くすわ。
Items.MessageLocalize: In happiness and in sorrow, in sickness and in health, until death do us part... I pledge to you my love.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.1
Items.Message: 大島家長女ここにあり！
Items.MessageLocalize: Have no fear, big sis is here!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.2
Items.Message: この本はもう頭に入ったから、次の本を借りてきましょう。勉強、勉強！
Items.MessageLocalize: I've already memorized this book, so let's go to the next one! Study, study, study!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.3
Items.Message: 妹たちを養っていくために、軍の中で出世しないと。もっと頑張らないと！
Items.MessageLocalize: I need to work even harder to move up the ranks so I can support my little sisters!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.4
Items.Message: 今週の週刊イチコは…うーん。ちょっと漫画の勉強をしましょう。ええと、この漫画をリスペクトと…。
Items.MessageLocalize: This week's "Weekly Ichiko" is... Hmm... Maybe I should study manga a little more. What if I did an homage to this work...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.5
Items.Message: 姉さん。一千子姉さん。いち姉～。一千子。一千子姉！　はい、わたしを呼ぶ妹たちのモノマネです！
Items.MessageLocalize: Dear sister. Big Sis. Sis. Ichiko. Big sister Ichiko! Why yes, I am imitating the way my sisters address me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.6
Items.Message: Photon Field Canceler起動！　シスター・シックス・レイ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Photon Field Canceler, activate! Sextuplet ray!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.7
Items.Message: このスーツ、一体いくらするんでしょうか…え？　そ、そんなに…？　ぴーががががががががががー。
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm curious. How much, exactly, does a suit like this cost? Huh? THAT much?! Piipiipiipiipii BAAA pwiiGAApwiiGAApwii-PYSSHHHKKK.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.8
Items.Message: あの、スーツって、フォーマルな衣装なのに…これスカート短くないでしょうか？　見えてません…よね？
Items.MessageLocalize: Umm, I understand that suits are meant to be formalwear...s-so isn't this skirt a bit too short? They're not showing... are they?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.9
Items.Message: 白は光の象徴でもあるそうです。長女のわたしが、妹たちの道を照らす光になります！
Items.MessageLocalize: The color white is also said to symbolize light. As the eldest daughter, I shall be the light that illuminates the way for my younger sisters!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.10
Items.Message: 大人しそうだからって油断しましたか？　大島家長女は、荒事だって慣れっこなんです。
Items.MessageLocalize: Did you let your guard down because I seem so mild-mannered? The eldest daughter of the Ohshima family is naturally no stranger to rough-and-tumble situations.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IcOhshima06.11
Items.Message: 妹吸いはいいですよ。どんな病気もイチコロです。
Items.MessageLocalize: Sniffing my sisters is a positively wholesome thing. It cures any illness.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.1
Items.Message: うぬぼれ、大いに結構！
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, to drown in my own reflection.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.2
Items.Message: 大島家の次女として、姉さんを支え妹たちの良き見本となるよう、日々背筋を伸ばしています。
Items.MessageLocalize: As the second eldest, I try my best to support my older sister, and be an upstanding role model for my younger sisters.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.3
Items.Message: 読者モデルをしていましたが、いつかプロのモデルになってランウェイを歩いてみせます。
Items.MessageLocalize: I was once an amateur model, but someday I hope to become a professional on the runway.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.4
Items.Message: はぁはぁ…鏡に映る私とても綺麗…その艶めかしい視線も…あぁ…永遠に見つめ合える…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah, ohh... My reflection in the mirror is so exquisite... Just look at that sultry gaze. My, I could stare at myself forever...

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.5
Items.Message: 艶やかに、雅やかに、散紅葉のように美しく！
Items.MessageLocalize: Lustrous, graceful, and beautiful like scattered autumn leaves!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.6
Items.Message: ここの温泉は美肌効果があるそうですよ。ずっと来たかったんです。広い露天風呂、楽しみですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: This hot spring is apparently excellent for the skin, so I've always wanted to visit. I'm really looking forward to the open-air baths.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.7
Items.Message: お風呂上がりのフルーツ牛乳が楽しみです。貧乏だった頃は一本を姉妹六人で分けて飲んでいました。
Items.MessageLocalize: I can't wait for the post-bath fruit-flavored milk. Back during our poor days, we sisters would share a single bottle between the six of us.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.8
Items.Message: いつもと雰囲気が違いますか？ ふふ、癒やしの場ですし、少し気持ちが緩んでいるのかもしれないです。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, do I have a different air to me than usual? Hehe, it might be because we're at a spa. I feel quite relaxed.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.9
Items.Message: あまりじっと見ないでください。髪もセットしていませんので恥ずかしいです…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Please don't stare at me too hard. I haven't done my hair yet, so it's rather embarrassing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.10
Items.Message: 浴衣美人の撮影ですか？ もちろんいいですよ。…え？ すっぴんで？ それは…ちょっと困ります。
Items.MessageLocalize: Taking photos for the Miss Yukata shoot? I'd be happy to... Wait, did you say without any makeup? That's... I'm sorry, I can't afford to be seen without makeup.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima05.11
Items.Message: あの…履いてますし着けてますよ？ あ、あたりまえじゃないですか！
Items.MessageLocalize: Um... Yes, of course I'm wearing undergarments under this! Both top and bottom!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.1
Items.Message: うぬぼれ、大いに結構！
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, to drown in my own reflection.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.2
Items.Message: 大島家の次女として、姉さんを支え妹たちの良き見本となるよう、日々背筋を伸ばしています。
Items.MessageLocalize: As the second eldest, I try my best to support my older sister, and be an upstanding role model for my younger sisters.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.3
Items.Message: 読者モデルをしていましたが、いつかプロのモデルになってランウェイを歩いてみせます。
Items.MessageLocalize: I was once an amateur model, but someday I hope to become a professional on the runway.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.4
Items.Message: はぁはぁ…鏡に映る私とても綺麗…その艶めかしい視線も…あぁ…永遠に見つめ合える…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ah, ohh... My reflection in the mirror is so exquisite... Just look at that sultry gaze. My, I could stare at myself forever...

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.5
Items.Message: ひゃっ、今、何か踏んで…って浅見さん！？　こんなところで寝てたら風邪を引きますよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Eep! D-Did I step on something just now... I-Instructor Asami?! You can't be falling asleep here! You might catch a cold!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.6
Items.Message: 夏の新フレグランス。爽やかで鮮烈な香りを、あなたへ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A new summer fragrance. A fresh and vibrant scent, dedicated to you.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.7
Items.Message: きゃあっ！　こら六宇亜っ！　お返しです！　あなたもびしょびしょになりなさーい！
Items.MessageLocalize: Eek! Darn you, Muua! It's payback time! Prepare to get absolutely soaked!

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.8
Items.Message: 舞い散る水を纏う私はまさしく海辺のヴィーナス。今の私は美の巨匠ボッティチェリも見とれますね。
Items.MessageLocalize: I am truly the seaside Venus, clad in shimmering cerulean ripples. Even the maestro of beauty, Botticelli, would be captivated by me in this moment.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.9
Items.Message: 濡れスケ…ですか？　残念ですが、この下は水着で…んんっ！　ちょっと失礼…します…。
Items.MessageLocalize: My skirt...might get wet? Unfortunately for you, I am wearing a swimsuit undern—Nghh?! O-One moment please...I'll be right back.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.10
Items.Message: せっかく姉妹そろっての海ですから、今回の服装は二以奈セレクションのリンクコーデにしました。
Items.MessageLocalize: Since the six of us sisters were all going to the beach together, we decided that we would coordinate our fits, facilitated by yours truly.

Items.Label: CardVoice.NiOhshima06.11
Items.Message: 夏はモデルにとって重要なスタイルキープの季節…ですが大島家育ちの私には節制など造作もありません。
Items.MessageLocalize: Summer is always a critical season for models who need to maintain their figure. But as someone who grew up in the Ohshima family, moderation is no issue for me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.1
Items.Message: はいよ、戦力お待たせ
Items.MessageLocalize: Special delivery, incoming!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.2
Items.Message:
配達は迅速・丁寧・確実に！
大切な荷物を
しっかりお届けするよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Speedy, attentive, and reliable!
All the things important to you, I'll deliver, no matter what!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.3
Items.Message:
むにゃ…四ツ葉、ちっちゃくて
抱き心地さいこー…すぅ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Zzz... Yotsuha's so small...
So huggable... Zzz...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.4
Items.Message:
この服可愛い…憧れるなぁ…って
わぁ！何も見てない！
何も見てないよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This outfit is so cute... Wait, huh?
Whoa! I'm not looking!
I'm not looking at cute outfits at all!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.5
Items.Message:
ひゃっほーーーい！
どーいてどいてー！
速達便のお通りだよー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Let's gooo!
Outta the way!
Express delivery, comin' through!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.6
Items.Message:
たまにはおしとやかにね。
花言葉は大切な思い出。えへへ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Gotta act a bit more graceful every now and then.
These flowers symbolize precious memories. Ehehe.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.7
Items.Message:
こうして浴衣で歩いてると、お忍びデートみたい…って何言ってるん
だろ！聞かなかったことにして！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Walking around in a yukata makes this feel kinda like an incognito date... What am I saying?! You didn't hear that!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.8
Items.Message:
ええっ、旅館の歯磨き粉って
タダで使っていいの！？すごい！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Huh? I can use the ryokan's toothpaste for free?!
That's sick!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.9
Items.Message:
ま、待って…走ったらはだけて
きちゃって…。その…下は着ける
もんじゃないって五十鈴が…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
H-Hold up, if we run, my yukata will come undone...
Well, you see...Isuzu said you're not supposed to wear anything underneath...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.10
Items.Message:
この髪飾りが可愛い？へへ…
ぼくが選んだんだけど…どうしよう、すごく嬉しい。ありがとう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
The hair clip looks cute? Hehe...
I picked it myself... What should I do...that makes me so happy. Thanks!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima04.11
Items.Message:
浴衣なんて、小さい時に着た以来
かも。あの時は、お母さんが
着付けをしてくれたんだっけ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I don't think I've worn a yukata since I was a kid.
I think my mom might've helped me get dressed back then.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.1
Items.Message: はいよ、戦力お待たせ
Items.MessageLocalize: Special delivery, incoming!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.2
Items.Message:
配達は迅速・丁寧・確実に！
大切な荷物を
しっかりお届けするよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Speedy, attentive, and reliable!
All the things important to you, I'll deliver, no matter what!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.3
Items.Message:
むにゃ…四ツ葉、ちっちゃくて
抱き心地さいこー…すぅ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Zzz... Yotsuha's so small...
So huggable... Zzz...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.4
Items.Message:
この服可愛い…憧れるなぁ…って
わぁ！何も見てない！
何も見てないよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This outfit is so cute... Wait, huh?
Whoa! I'm not looking!
I'm not looking at cute outfits at all!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.5
Items.Message:
ひゃっほーーーい！
どーいてどいてー！
速達便のお通りだよー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Let's gooo!
Outta the way!
Express delivery, comin' through!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.6
Items.Message:
シェイキングタァイム…
あちらのお客様からお届けだよー！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Shaking time.
This one's on her!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.7
Items.Message:
基地の片隅で繰り広げられる、悲喜こもごものスペシャルナイト…
マスターの仕事の始まりです。
Items.MessageLocalize:
A bittersweet special night, a mix of joy and sorrow, delivered in this little nook of the base...
It's time to begin my work as a bartender.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.8
Items.Message:
人前に立つ仕事だからね。リップも塗っておしゃれしたんだ。
…どう、かな？
Items.MessageLocalize:
This is a service job, so I thought I'd put on some lipstick to glam myself up a little.
How's it look?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.9
Items.Message: 一杯のカクテルがひとを繋ぐこともある…。知ってた？　バーって、そんな素敵な場所なんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Did you know that cocktails can bring people together? That's just what a wonderful place a bar is.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.10
Items.Message: 五十鈴、大島家ジュースを再現したよ。１％の野いちご果汁と水道水のさわやかな味わいをどうぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Isuzu, I managed to recreate the Ohshima family fruit juice. It's 1% wild strawberry juice, 99% tap water. Enjoy the crisp, refreshing flavor.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MiOhshima06.11
Items.Message:
フレアバーテンディング…パフォーマンスも練習したんだ。
目でも楽しんでいってね！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've been working on my flair bartending skills.
Feast your eyes on this!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.1
Items.Message: 頑張らない！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm not even going to try!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.2
Items.Message:
寝るのにも体力いんだぞー。
だから回復させるために、
あたいはまた寝んだよ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: It takes energy to sleep, y'knowww? So I gotta sleep again to recover that energy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.3
Items.Message:
ごろごろ～…あたいの
眠りに落ちるまでの平均時間は
２．８秒だぞ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mmm... You know, it only takes me about 2.8 seconds on average to fall asleep. Cool, huh?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.4
Items.Message:
あたいが寝てられるってことは、
まだまだ安心てことだろー。
もっと心に余裕を持てよぉ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: If I can stay asleep in a situation like this, that means it's not tooo bad yet. So relax, and take it easyyy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.5
Items.Message:
めぇめぇタ～イム。
一匹目で充分寝れんだろ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's ba-ba-bed tiiime. Even one of these sheep should put you straight to sleeppp...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.6
Items.Message:
パジャマパーティーとか、
わけわかんねー。
パジャマ着たらすぐ寝ろよ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: I don't get the point of pajama parties, maaan. Just go to bed once you're in your jammies!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.7
Items.Message:
このパジャマ、さん姉が抱きついてきて面倒だ～…でも、折角選んで
くれたから脱げねぇ～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Ughhh, Minori keeps clinging onto me when I'm in these pajamas... But she picked them out just for me, so I don't really wanna take them off eitherrr...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.8
Items.Message:
う～あ～…このモコモコ
たまんねぇ～。いつも以上に
深い眠りに落ちれそうだ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: Awww maaan... this fluffiness is amazinggg. I'm gonna be able to sleep way better than usual with this level of fluff.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.9
Items.Message:
ぱーふぇくとどりーまー？
何言ってんだ～？
あたいが寝ぼけるわけねーだろー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perfect Dreamer? What's that all abouttt? I'm not the type to go around sleepwalking, no wayyy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.10
Items.Message: おいおい、あたいを抱き枕代わりにすんなよ～。あ～…でも、あったけーからかまわねぇーかぁ～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Heyyy, I'm not your pillow...but I guess this is kinda warm, so... Okay, I don't mind it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima04.11
Items.Message: 眠りのSleepと羊のSheepが似てっから、数を数えるようになったらし～ぞー。ま～秒で寝るから関係ねー。
Items.MessageLocalize: Sleep and sheep rhyme, so I guess that's why people count sheep to sleep? Not that it matters for me, since I can fall asleep in a flash.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.1
Items.Message: 頑張らない！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'm not even going to try!

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.2
Items.Message:
寝るのにも体力いんだぞー。
だから回復させるために、
あたいはまた寝んだよ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: It takes energy to sleep, y'knowww? So I gotta sleep again to recover that energy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.3
Items.Message:
ごろごろ～…あたいの
眠りに落ちるまでの平均時間は
２．８秒だぞ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mmm... You know, it only takes me about 2.8 seconds on average to fall asleep. Cool, huh?

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.4
Items.Message:
あたいが寝てられるってことは、
まだまだ安心てことだろー。
もっと心に余裕を持てよぉ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: If I can stay asleep in a situation like this, that means it's not tooo bad yet. So relax, and take it easyyy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.5
Items.Message: 寝る子は育つってゆーだろ～。つまりあたいは成長株ってことだ～。つーわけでもうひと眠り～。
Items.MessageLocalize: They say that a sleeping child is a growing child. Which meeeans, I'm basically a growth stock. And with that, back to sleep for me~

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.6
Items.Message: 金魚の復讐だぞ～。あの夏を思い出せ～
Items.MessageLocalize: It's the goldfish's reveeenge. Remember thaaaat summer~

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.7
Items.Message: 何じぃ～っと見てんだよー。これ最後の一本だからなー…？　ったく、しょうがねーな～ほれ～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: What'cha staring at? Too bad, this is the last one... Ugh, fiiine. Here~

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.8
Items.Message: 足湯っていいよな～…全身浸からなくてもあったけーし…これもう風呂に入ったってことでいいよな～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Feels greeeat to soak your feet. The warmth spreads everywhere without having to get your whole body wet... So it's like I basically took a bath already.

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.9
Items.Message: この浴衣、割と着心地いーから眠くなんだよな～…もし寝ちまっても変なこと…すん…な～…くぅ～。
Items.MessageLocalize: This yukata is so comfy, it's making me all sleepy... But even if I doze off...you'd better not...do anything weird to m—zzz...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.10
Items.Message: 太もも見すぎだろ～あたいに色気とか期待すんなよ～。そーいうのは五十鈴の役目…だから見んなって～…。
Items.MessageLocalize: You're ogling my thighs waaay too much. Don't expect that kind of fanservice from a girl like me. That's Isuzu's job...so stop staring at me...

Items.Label: CardVoice.YoOhshima05.11
Items.Message: 浴衣は下着を着けなくてもいいから、楽ちんだな～。普段…？　あー…面倒で着けてねー時もあんな～。
Items.MessageLocalize: A big reason why yukata are so comfy is because you usually don't need to wear anything underneath. "Usually"? I mean, yeah, I sometimes don't bother 'cause it's a paaain.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.1
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック！
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.2
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック。あたしの手にかかれば、どんな扉だって開けられるさ。もちろん心の扉だってね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame. There's no door I can't pry open...including the door to your heart.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.3
Items.Message: この基地には何か秘密があるはずなんだ。あたしの鍵開け職人としての勘がそう言ってる。
Items.MessageLocalize: My lockpicking instincts are telling me there's gotta be some juicy secrets hidden on this base.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.4
Items.Message: 別に一千子だけが大事なわけじゃねぇからな。二以奈も三野里も四ツ葉も六宇亜も大事にしてるぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's not like Ichiko is the only one that's important to me. I love Niina, Minori, Yotsuha, and Muua too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.5
Items.Message: せっかくだし…あっつーいのをお先にどーぞ！ あちっ！ あっちぃー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Since we're here...you get the first dibs! Augh, wait, that's hot! HOT!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.6
Items.Message: ふーあっち～…ちょっとのんびりと温泉に浸かりすぎたよ…。もうちょっと休んでいこうぜ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Phew, I'm boiling up over here... Maybe spent too much time in the hot spring. Let's cool off for a little longer.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.7
Items.Message: 浴衣って楽でいいよな。雑に着ると着崩れしやすいけど…まあ、気にしなくていいか。
Items.MessageLocalize: Yukata are so comfy and easy to wear. But if you wear it too loosely, it comes undone really easily. Well, it's not really something worth worrying about.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.8
Items.Message: 風呂上がりのマッサージは効くぜ。よかったら一揉みいっとくかい？
Items.MessageLocalize: Getting a post-bath massage does wonders. Wanna give it a go?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.9
Items.Message: 温泉宿で夜風に吹かれながら舞い落ちる紅葉を眺める…いい家族旅行だと思わないかい？
Items.MessageLocalize: Watching the autumn leaves flutter in the night breeze at a hot spring... What a wonderful family vacation.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.10
Items.Message: 旅館の部屋に置いてある和菓子って食っても金取られないのか？ 本当かよ！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Wait, we can eat the room snacks for free?! Seriously?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima04.11
Items.Message: え…？ あー、熱いしちょっと苦しいから着けてないなー…下は…あれ？ 履いたっけかな…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Huh? Oh, yeah, it's a bit hot and stuffy so I'm not wearing anything up top. And... wait, am I wearing any underwear at all?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.1
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック！
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.2
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック。あたしの手にかかれば、どんな扉だって開けられるさ。もちろん心の扉だってね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame. There's no door I can't pry open...including the door to your heart.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.3
Items.Message: この基地には何か秘密があるはずなんだ。あたしの鍵開け職人としての勘がそう言ってる。
Items.MessageLocalize: My lockpicking instincts are telling me there's gotta be some juicy secrets hidden on this base.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.4
Items.Message: 別に一千子だけが大事なわけじゃねぇからな。二以奈も三野里も四ツ葉も六宇亜も大事にしてるぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's not like Ichiko is the only one that's important to me. I love Niina, Minori, Yotsuha, and Muua too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.5
Items.Message:
タネも仕掛けもあるかもな♪
バレなきゃセーフさ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I might have a couple tricks up my sleeve.
As long as no one finds out, what difference does it make?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.6
Items.Message:
タネも仕掛けもいらないね。
あんたの心の鍵は、
あたしがこの手で開けてやるよ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I don't need to pull any tricks.
I'll pry open that door to your heart with my own hands.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.7
Items.Message:
…あれ？仕込んだうさぎがどっかに
…ひゃああぁーーっ！こ、このっ、
どこに潜り込んでんだよっ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Huh? Where did the bunny I hid in the hat go...
Aghhhh! Y-You little rascal!
Watch where you're going!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.8
Items.Message:
ん？タネも仕掛けもあるんだろ
って？ふーん、じゃあさ、
触って確かめてみるかい？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hm? There's gotta be some kind of trick behind this?
Hmm... In that case, wanna feel around to make sure there's nothing?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.9
Items.Message: 脱出マジックするから一千子はこっちの鍵のかかる部屋に入っててくれ。大丈夫、最後にはちゃんと出すよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Time for an escape stunt. Ichiko, you'll be in this room that'll be locked. Don't worry, you'll eventually get released.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.10
Items.Message:
３つ数えたら心の扉が開くぜ。
３、２、１…お姉ちゃん大しゅき～
…はっ！　あたしは何を…！？
Items.MessageLocalize:
On the count of three, the door to your heart will be wide open.
3, 2, 1... I love you sooo much, Big Sis!
Hah! What am I saying?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima05.11
Items.Message:
ふー、この服ちょっと
胸がきついんだよなー。
ボタンもう一個外せねーかなぁ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Huff... This outfit's a bit tight around the chest area.
I wonder if I can undo another button.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.1
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック！
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.2
Items.Message: オープン・ザ・ロック。あたしの手にかかれば、どんな扉だって開けられるさ。もちろん心の扉だってね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Open sesame. There's no door I can't pry open...including the door to your heart.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.3
Items.Message: この基地には何か秘密があるはずなんだ。あたしの鍵開け職人としての勘がそう言ってる。
Items.MessageLocalize: My lockpicking instincts are telling me there's gotta be some juicy secrets hidden on this base.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.4
Items.Message: 別に一千子だけが大事なわけじゃねぇからな。二以奈も三野里も四ツ葉も六宇亜も大事にしてるぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It's not like Ichiko is the only one that's important to me. I love Niina, Minori, Yotsuha, and Muua too.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.5
Items.Message: 苦しいことも楽しいことも分け合って生きていけばいい…。ったく、自分で言ったことなのにな。
Items.MessageLocalize: As sisters, we should share both the pains and the joys in life... Sheesh... I'm the one who said that in the first place.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.6
Items.Message:
夜の絶景をプレゼントするぜ。
星に乾杯、なんてな？
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'll treat you to the most spectacular night view ever.
Let's raise a glass to the stars above, yes?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.7
Items.Message: どうだい、このドレス。サマになってるだろ？　香水もイイヤツで…って近い近い！　嗅ぐにしても近い！
Items.MessageLocalize: What do you think about this dress? Looking sharp, right? And my fine perfume is—Hey, whoa, personal space! You can have a whiff, but you're way too close!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.8
Items.Message: 三野里…大島家ジュースをみんなにも振舞ってくれないか？　野いちごの甘味を堪能してほしいのさ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Minori... I'll buy the bar a round of Ohshima family fruit juice. I want everyone to savor that wild strawberry delicacy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.9
Items.Message: 肌…綺麗だろ？　二以奈特製の化粧水のお陰さ。胸のケアにも使えて…。何想像してんだよ、紳士様？
Items.MessageLocalize: Doesn't my skin just glow? It's all thanks to Niina's special toner. It's great for breast care too... Hey, mind out of the gutter, mister.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.10
Items.Message: 心の扉を開くのに酒の力は借りないさ。だって…刺激がなくなるだろう…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Much as I love unlocking the doors to the heart, alcohol is no good for that. I mean, where's the fun, right?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IrOhshima06.11
Items.Message: バーのフードって割に合わなくないか？　一品の金額で大島家なら一週間は食えるぞ…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Is it just me or is bar food way overpriced? For the cost of one little dish here, I could feed my whole family for a week.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.1
Items.Message: あたしはこけたりしない。
Items.MessageLocalize: I won't ever stumble.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.2
Items.Message: ははっはっはっはっ…はぁはぁはぁはぁ…はぁ～…はぁ～はぁ～！　ふ、ひひ…ぷひぃ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hahaha...ahha, hah, hhh, haaah...hhh, haaahhh! Heh...Hehe, heee!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.3
Items.Message: ドＭってよく言われるけど、そんなことないもん。でも…最近ドＭって言ってくれないと物足りないかも。
Items.MessageLocalize: People keep calling me a masochist, but I'm not! But also, I feel like I'm not getting called a masochist enough lately...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.4
Items.Message: 大島屋の運営も順調！いつか世界が平和になったらお姉ちゃんたちと色々な所で商売をするよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohshima Sundries is doing great! Whenever the world is peaceful again, I'd like to try opening up a whole bunch of businesses with my sisters, all across the region!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.5
Items.Message:
当たるまで引き続ける！
はぁはぁ…大吉～！！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll keep pulling fortunes until I get a winning one! Ahh... THERE IT IS!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.6
Items.Message:
わーー！雪！すごいふかふか！
足跡が残って面白い！足の指先が
冷たくて痛くなるのもいい！
Items.MessageLocalize: Wow, look at that snow! It's so soft and powdery! And look, I can leave my footprints on it! My toes are getting deliciously cold and achy, too!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.7
Items.Message: 振袖で走ろうと思うとね、いつもより窮屈で、まるで拘束されてるみたいなんだ。なんか…いいよねぇ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Running in a furisode is a lot more difficult than not. Almost like you're bound up. It's...kinda nice.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.8
Items.Message:
あのね、帯が緩んできたから締め直してくれないかな。ぎゅーって、
遠慮なくぎゅーってして。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, my sash is coming loose. Could you tighten it back up for me? Reeeally tight, please.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.9
Items.Message:
しゅごい…氷点下の中で深呼吸したら…胸の中が痛気持ちいぃ～！
こりぇ…クセになっちゃう～！
Items.MessageLocalize: Wowww! Breathing in the crisp, freezing air like this makes my lungs all tingly and hurty from the cold! I might have found myself a new habit...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.10
Items.Message: 大島式おみくじは、六人でひとつだけ引くんだ。大吉なら喜び６倍！　凶なら哀しみ６分の１！
Items.MessageLocalize: In our family, we always do new years fortune telling by pulling a single ticket with the six of us, together. If we get a good fortune, that's multiplied by 6! If it's bad, then it's divided by 6!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima05.11
Items.Message: 成人式の時は、みんなで振袖を着て、お父さんとお母さんに、こんなに成長したよって報告するんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: During the coming-of-age ceremony, it'd be nice if us sisters could all dress up in furisode outfits. That way we can show our parents how much we've grown.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.1
Items.Message: あたしはこけたりしない。
Items.MessageLocalize: I won't ever stumble.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.2
Items.Message: ははっはっはっはっ…はぁはぁはぁはぁ…はぁ～…はぁ～はぁ～！　ふ、ひひ…ぷひぃ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hahaha...ahha, hah, hhh, haaah...hhh, haaahhh! Heh...Hehe, heee!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.3
Items.Message: ドＭってよく言われるけど、そんなことないもん。でも…最近ドＭって言ってくれないと物足りないかも。
Items.MessageLocalize: People keep calling me a masochist, but I'm not! But also, I feel like I'm not getting called a masochist enough lately...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.4
Items.Message: 大島屋の運営も順調！いつか世界が平和になったらお姉ちゃんたちと色々な所で商売をするよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohshima Sundries is doing great! Whenever the world is peaceful again, I'd like to try opening up a whole bunch of businesses with my sisters, all across the region!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.5
Items.Message: さあお姉ちゃんたち、大島屋ご愛顧感謝セール頑張っていこー！！　えいえい、おー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Alright, everyone! Let's do our best in the Ohshima Sundries Appreciation Sale! Hip, hip, hooray!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.6
Items.Message: かき氷フィーバー！　来る来る来る来る！　…キッ、ターー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Shaved ice fever! Hereitcomeshereitcomes HERE...IT...COMES!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.7
Items.Message: ねえねえ、あそこに浮かんでる白いのってクラゲかな？ちょ、ちょっとくらいなら平気だよね…？
Items.MessageLocalize: Hey, hey. Um, that little white floaty thing over there...is a jellyfish, right? C-Can I? Just a little bit? Pleeease?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.8
Items.Message: 二以奈姉が選んでくれた服…ちょっと胸きついな…いつもより谷間出来ちゃってる。
Items.MessageLocalize: The clothes Niina picked out for me...are a bit tight around my chest... I'm showing a lot more cleavage than normal.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.9
Items.Message: 海の家大島屋の経営会議ー！アイデア募集中！　え？　みんなで水着で接客？　涼しいしそれ採用！
Items.MessageLocalize: Ohshima Seaside Sundries management meeting! We're brainstorming ideas! Huh? Serving clients in our swimsuits? What a refreshing idea! That has my vote!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.10
Items.Message: 二以奈姉、隙あり！　それそれそれー！！　うわっぶっ！？　ちょ、まっ、あぶぶぶっ！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Niina! There's a gap! RightthererightthereRIGHTTHERE!!! AblubWUH?! W-Wait! AblublubWUB?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MuOhshima06.11
Items.Message: 昼は海！　夜は花火！　夏って最高だね！　え？　き、きき、肝試し？　そ、それはいいかな…。
Items.MessageLocalize: The ocean during the day! Fireworks in the evening! Isn't summer just the best? A t-t-test of courage? Th-That sounds fun, yeah...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.1
Items.Message: お嬢様の仰せのままに。
Items.MessageLocalize: As my lady desires.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.2
Items.Message: 私は丸山家の跡取りとなる奏多様に仕える執事でございます。
Items.MessageLocalize: My purpose is to serve Kanata Maruyama, the heir to the Maruyama family name.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.3
Items.Message: 私はあらゆる面で優秀であると自負しております。そしてこれら全てはお嬢様を導くためのものです。
Items.MessageLocalize: In all respects, my skills are exceptional. All for the purpose of serving and guiding my lady.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.4
Items.Message: 世界を守ることは、お嬢様の覇道を守ることと同義。そして我々の真の戦いは世界を救ってからです。
Items.MessageLocalize: To save the world is to save my lady's rise to power. Our true battle awaits after the world is at peace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.5
Items.Message: 夜のテールランプは、時に人を大胆にします。付き合ってもらいますよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A tail light glowing in the night... It's enough to drive one wild. Would you join me on this ride?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.6
Items.Message: 少し刺激的な夜のスピードを体験してみませんか。エスコートはお任せください。
Items.MessageLocalize: Are you craving speed? Allow me to escort you on this nighttime drive.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.7
Items.Message:
私と一緒に、一時、全てを忘れ
夜の風となりませんか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's forget about everything for a moment, and become like the wind tonight.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.8
Items.Message: 執事としてあるまじき服装とは思いますが…お嬢様が格好いいと仰ってくれましたので。
Items.MessageLocalize: This is hardly an outfit appropriate for a servant... but my lady complimented me on it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.9
Items.Message: 出力300PS、16kgf･m。思っていたより扱いやすかったですね。もっと速くても問題ありません。
Items.MessageLocalize: About 300 horsepower, with 16kgf-m of torque. It was a lot easier to handle than expected, but a little more speed wouldn't be an issue.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.10
Items.Message: バイクで走っていると、黒沢君の気持ちが少し理解出来ます。これは気持ちがいい。
Items.MessageLocalize: While riding a motorcycle like this, it's easy to imagine why Kurosawa enjoys this so much. This is certainly a pleasurable experience.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi04.11
Items.Message: …どこを見ている。
Items.MessageLocalize: Where are you staring?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.1
Items.Message: お嬢様の仰せのままに。
Items.MessageLocalize: As my lady desires.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.2
Items.Message: 私は丸山家の跡取りとなる奏多様に仕える執事でございます。
Items.MessageLocalize: My purpose is to serve Kanata Maruyama, the heir to the Maruyama family name.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.3
Items.Message: 私はあらゆる面で優秀であると自負しております。そしてこれら全てはお嬢様を導くためのものです。
Items.MessageLocalize: In all respects, my skills are exceptional. All for the purpose of serving and guiding my lady.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.4
Items.Message: 世界を守ることは、お嬢様の覇道を守ることと同義。そして我々の真の戦いは世界を救ってからです。
Items.MessageLocalize: To save the world is to save my lady's rise to power. Our true battle awaits after the world is at peace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.5
Items.Message: ３１Ｆの皆様は信頼に値する方々です…私はよい仲間に恵まれました。
Items.MessageLocalize: Everyone in 31-F are trustworthy friends... One is blessed with fine comrades.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.6
Items.Message: 小さき命もいつか大樹となりましょう。その未来に、祝福を！
Items.MessageLocalize: Even the smallest life will someday bloom into a mighty tree. Blessings upon that future!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.7
Items.Message: 貴様は私のものだ。私に従い私を崇め、私と共に死ぬがいい。…こんな無礼をお望みとは面白い方ですね。
Items.MessageLocalize: You belong to me. Follow me, admire me, and die with me... You harbor such insolent wishes? You amusing soul...

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.8
Items.Message:
ご指名ありがとうございます。今夜は寝かせません。朝まで激しく、
熱く、盛り上がりましょう。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Thank you for calling me over. One will keep you awake all night long.
Let us passionately make merry until dawn.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.9
Items.Message: 頬が赤いですよ。…カクテルのせい？おかしいですね、アルコールは入っていないはずですが。
Items.MessageLocalize: You're flushed... It's because of the cocktail? How peculiar. There is no alcohol in it.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.10
Items.Message: 私には、あなたしかいません…これは一本のバラを贈る際の花言葉です。誰に贈るかは…ふふ、秘密です。
Items.MessageLocalize: You're all one has... Such is the meaning a single rose portrays. Who is its recipient? Well now, that is a secret.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MYanagi06.11
Items.Message: この靴はお嬢様に選んでいただきました。よく見ていただくため、こうして足を持ち上げております。
Items.MessageLocalize: My Lady picked these shoes. One shall raise her feet so you may examine them more closely.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.1
Items.Message: センスの違いを見せてやる
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll show you what refined taste is all about!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.2
Items.Message: 盗撮されている？馬鹿なことを言うな。そんなのボクが気づかないはずないだろ。なあ柳。
Items.MessageLocalize: Pictures of us, taken in secret? Don't be silly. I wouldn't overlook that. Right, Yanagi?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.3
Items.Message:
ふふふふっふー、ふふんふんふんふふーん♪はっ、い、今のは
気にするな！なんでもないからな！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hmmm, hmm hmm hm, hmmhmmhmm♪ Aaah, uhm, ignore that! It was nothing!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.4
Items.Message:
んん…。どこにも行くなぁ…
ずっとボクのそばに居ろぉ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nnn, don't leave... Stay with me, always...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.5
Items.Message:
吼えるぞ！みゃーー！
ふん、これが野生のセンスだ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hear me roar! Mya! Hmph, this is what savage style is all about!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.6
Items.Message:
これは丸山グループがいつか展開
する、子供向け商品のひとつだ。
ボクがプロデュースしたんだぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This is a product for children the Maruyama Group is planning to launch. I was in charge of its production.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.7
Items.Message: 帽子とリュックに合う服を柳に選ばせたけど…短い！スカートがいつもより短いっ！スースーするっ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I had Yanagi pick out clothes that would pair well with a hat and backpack... But it's too short! The skirt's way too short!
It's chilly!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.8
Items.Message:
丸山グループの当主がする格好じゃ
ない？ふ、ふん、これが新商品の
宣伝なら喜んで着てやるさ。
Items.MessageLocalize: This isn't how the leader of the Maruyama Group should dress? H-Hmph. I'd glady wear this to help PR a new product.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.9
Items.Message:
花を見ると屋敷の庭園を思い出す。
お母様がよく愛でていたんだが…
お前と一緒に見るのも悪くないな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Looking at flowers reminds me of the garden in my mansion. Mother tended to the flowers lovingly... But looking at them with you isn't too bad.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.10
Items.Message:
ラスカ…違う！
あれはアライグマだ！
これはレッサーパンダだ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Meeko... No! That's a racoon! This is a red panda!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama05.11
Items.Message:
え…レッサーパンダの鳴き声をしろ
だと？くっ…きゅ…キュルルル～！
…忘れろ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Wh-What does a red panda sound like? Kuh...  K-KURURURURU! ...Forget you ever heard that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.1
Items.Message: センスの違いを見せてやる
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll show you what refined taste is all about!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.2
Items.Message: 盗撮されている？馬鹿なことを言うな。そんなのボクが気づかないはずないだろ。なあ柳。
Items.MessageLocalize: Pictures of us, taken in secret? Don't be silly. I wouldn't overlook that. Right, Yanagi?

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.3
Items.Message:
ふふふふっふー、ふふんふんふんふふーん♪はっ、い、今のは
気にするな！なんでもないからな！
Items.MessageLocalize: Hmmm, hmm hmm hm, hmmhmmhmm♪ Aaah, uhm, ignore that! It was nothing!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.4
Items.Message:
んん…。どこにも行くなぁ…
ずっとボクのそばに居ろぉ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Nnn, don't leave... Stay with me, always...

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.5
Items.Message: ボクたちの戦いは、未来を変えるための戦いだ。振り返らず、隣を歩く仲間を信じて進むぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: We fight this battle to change the world, so we'll walk forth, trusting in the allies walking alongside us, without looking back.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.6
Items.Message:
奮進せよ。
我らの誇りこそが未来を切り開く！
決まった！
Items.MessageLocalize:
March forth.
Our pride will clear a path to the future!
Yes, that was perfect!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.7
Items.Message:
いつかボクは、人々を守り支える
大樹になってみせる。
だから、すぐそばで見ていてくれ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
One day, I will become a mighty tree that will both guard and support the masses.
So stand by my side and watch.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.8
Items.Message:
柳、いつまでこのポーズを取ってればいい？　目がカピカピ、
腕はプルプルになってきたんだが。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Yanagi, how much longer do I need to hold this pose?
My eyes are drying out and my arms are starting to tremble.

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.9
Items.Message: ボクの威厳を世界に示す特注マントだぞ！　風に靡く姿がさまに…ってうわあ！　飛ばされるー！
Items.MessageLocalize: This is a made-to-order cloak designed to put my dignity on full display! Watch it flutter gallantly in the wind—Ahh! It's getting blown away!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.10
Items.Message: ボクの忠臣を紹介する。執事、剣士、指揮者、スタントウーマン、元暴走族総長…って個性的すぎるだろ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Let me introduce my faithful vassals. A butler, a swordswoman, a conductor, a stuntwoman, a former biker gang leader... What's with all these wild personalities?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.KMaruyama07.11
Items.Message: 俯くな！　どんな状況でも必ずボクがお前たちの手を掴む！　希望の灯火になってやる！　なってみせる！
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't hang your heads! No matter the situation, I will grab your hand! I will become a beacon of hope! I will prove that I can!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.1
Items.Message: ここが私のステージだ
Items.MessageLocalize: Welcome to my performance!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.2
Items.Message: ふふ、物欲しそうな顔をしているね。いけない小鳥ちゃんだ。私の部屋でじっくり指導してあげないとね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Heheh, that greedy look on your face... You naughty little songbird. I ought to discipline you thoroughly in my room...

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.3
Items.Message: アジタート！　もっと激しく…！　指を動かして…！　はあっ！　最高の演奏だよ…！
Items.MessageLocalize: Agitato! Go harder...! Move your fingers...! Aaah! That was the finest performance...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.4
Items.Message: 魅力とは、不断の努力の上に成り立つものさ。小鳥ちゃんたちにみっともない姿は見せられないからね。
Items.MessageLocalize: Charm is built upon a foundation of effort. I can't disappoint my little songbirds with an unbecoming appearance, can I?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.5
Items.Message: さあ、力を抜いて。そう、いい子だ。そのまますべてを私に委ねてくれないかい？
Items.MessageLocalize: Come, relax. Yes, that's a good girl... Just leave everything to me...

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.6
Items.Message: 聖夜の魔法さ、小鳥ちゃん。ただ、君だけを想って。コンアモーレ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A touch of Christmas magic, songbird sweetest. I think of you, and nothing else. Con amore.

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.7
Items.Message: ふふ、歌い疲れてしまったのかい。それでは休憩にしよう。私の部屋でゆっくりと、ふたりきりで、ね…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Heheh, did you tire yourself out with your singing? Let us take a break, then.  Just you and me, in the private confines of my room...

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.8
Items.Message: おっと、汗で髪が張り付いてしまうね…情熱的な私も素敵？　おやおや、いけない小鳥ちゃんだ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Oh, my hair is sticking to my forehead from sweat... Hm? The passionate look suits me, too? Oh, goodness. You naughty little songbird...

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.9
Items.Message: アパッシオナート！　演奏を通して君からの愛が伝わってくるよ！　まるであの日の夜みたいに！
Items.MessageLocalize: Appassionato! Through your performance, I can feel your love! Just like on that night!

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.10
Items.Message: 光り輝く真っ白なステージ…さて、今日はどんな音色で染め上げてみようか。君はどうしたい？
Items.MessageLocalize: A brilliant white stage, awash with light... With what tones shall I wash it over today, I wonder. What say you?

Items.Label: CardVoice.SHanamura04.11
Items.Message: 聖なる夜に響く小鳥ちゃんの歌声…ふふ、他意はないよ。ほんの少しの下心があるだけだとも。
Items.MessageLocalize: My little songbird's warbling, filling the holy night... Heheh. I did not mean to offend. Though I do have some... ulterior motives...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.1
Items.Message: どんな戦場でもおまかせあれ
Items.MessageLocalize: No matter the scene, I'm your girl!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.2
Items.Message:
仮面ランナー１号、参上！
カニ怪人め、かかって…うわあああああああああああぁぁぁーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Masked Runner #1, on the scene!
Come at me, crab monster... UWHAAAAAAAAH!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.3
Items.Message:
あくまでボクはスタントウーマン。
脇役としてキミを輝かせることが
出来るなら、本望さ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm a stuntwoman, through and through.
Being the supporting role that helps you shine
the brightest is everything to me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.4
Items.Message:
生傷の絶えないこの体は、
ボクにとって誇りなんだ。
だって、誰かを守った証だからね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Every scrape and bruise on my body
is a badge of honor!
After all, they're there because I protected someone.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.5
Items.Message:
ランナーキーック！からの
着地、爆発、特殊効果、
効果音、決めポーズ、はい！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Runner Kick!
Then land, explosion, special effect, sound effect,
strike a pose, and finished!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.6
Items.Message:
マツチロ印っ！
ふんっ！はっ！せいっ！
元気、一発♪
Items.MessageLocalize:
Matsuchiro mark!
Hmph! Aah!
Aaand, full of cheer!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.7
Items.Message:
漲るカフェインが、
ボクを燃え上がらせる！
さあ、行こう！
Items.MessageLocalize:
A rush of caffeine,
I'm on fiiiiire!
Let's go, gang!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.8
Items.Message:
どうしたんだよ、そんなところで
黄昏て。ほら、これ飲めよ。
なんてね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Why are you zoning out there for, all sad?
Here, drink this.
Teehee, just kidding.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.9
Items.Message:
胸元開けすぎ？ボクのなんて
見ても面白いものじゃな…。
え？綺麗…？あ…ありがと…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm showing too much of my chest?
Who even wants to look at mine...Huh?
You think I'm pretty...? Th-Thanks...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.10
Items.Message: くっ…！吹っ飛びたい…！吹っ飛んだら黒沢さんと選んだ服が汚れちゃう…！でも我慢出来ない…！
Items.MessageLocalize: Kuh, I wanna go flying...! But if I do that, the clothes Kurosawa picked for me will get dirty...! Aaah, but I can't help it...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka04.11
Items.Message:
ん？こっち飲みたかった？
はい、どうぞ…って、ごめん、
これだと間接キスになっちゃうね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Mm? You wanted to drink this one?
Here you go... Ah, sorry.
That would make it an indirect kiss...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.1
Items.Message: どんな戦場でもおまかせあれ
Items.MessageLocalize: No matter the scene, I'm your girl!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.2
Items.Message:
仮面ランナー１号、参上！
カニ怪人め、かかって…うわあああああああああああぁぁぁーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Masked Runner #1, on the scene!
Come at me, crab monster... UWHAAAAAAAAH!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.3
Items.Message:
あくまでボクはスタントウーマン。
脇役としてキミを輝かせることが
出来るなら、本望さ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm a stuntwoman, through and through.
Being the supporting role that helps you shine
the brightest is everything to me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.4
Items.Message:
生傷の絶えないこの体は、
ボクにとって誇りなんだ。
だって、誰かを守った証だからね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Every scrape and bruise on my body
is a badge of honor!
After all, they're there because I protected someone.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.5
Items.Message:
ランナーキーック！からの
着地、爆発、特殊効果、
効果音、決めポーズ、はい！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Runner Kick!
Then land, explosion, special effect, sound effect,
strike a pose, and finished!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.6
Items.Message: インポッシブルを覆す！これで…ミッション・コンプリート！
Items.MessageLocalize: We do the impossible! And with that, our mission's complete!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.7
Items.Message: そんなに薄くて肌に張り付いた服で防御は大丈夫かって？　こう見えて意外と丈夫なんだよ。触ってみる？
Items.MessageLocalize: You're worried these skin-tight clothes make for poor protection? Actually, they're quiet durable. Want to touch and see?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.8
Items.Message: あまりボクから離れないでね！　大丈夫、キミには指一本触れさせない！
Items.MessageLocalize: Don't stray too far from me! Worry not, I won't let them lay a finger on you!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.9
Items.Message: 何故特殊部隊の衣装で太ももが見えてるのか…そんなところばかり見る悪い奴は成敗しちゃうよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Why does my special forces outfit show off my thighs? I might have to punish you if you keep ogling!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.10
Items.Message: 見せてあげるよ、脇役でもストーリーを変えることが出来るってことを！
Items.MessageLocalize: I'll show you how even a minor character can change the story!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CMatsuoka05.11
Items.Message: 次のシーンは…離陸する飛行機にしがみ付く…！？最高だね！スタントウーマンとしての腕がなるよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: In the next scene...I have to cling to a plane that's taking off?! Great! That sets my stuntwoman's pride ablaze!

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.1
Items.Message: 相伝の一閃、いざ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Behold the weight of legacy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.2
Items.Message:
はぁ…。
（以心伝心…面倒な技だ…）
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hm...
(Reading someone's wavelength...what a bothersome move.)

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.3
Items.Message: 明鏡止水。
Items.MessageLocalize: My mind was like the surface of a lake.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.4
Items.Message:
しかと胸に留めておこう。
受け継いだ剣技の意味を。
私が剣を振るう理由を。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will forever remember the meaning behind this legacy, the reason I wield this blade.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.5
Items.Message: 水天一碧。円寂の景。
Items.MessageLocalize: The unity of sky and sea... A scene of nirvana.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.6
Items.Message: 面妖な装束…。だが、悪くはない。
Items.MessageLocalize: What peculiar clothes... But it's not terrible.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.7
Items.Message: 花のように散らせてみせよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: You shall wilt, like a fleeting flower.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.8
Items.Message: …風が心地よいな。
Items.MessageLocalize: ...The wind is quite nice.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.9
Items.Message: 邪な目で見るな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Do not look at me with such ill-intentions.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.10
Items.Message: …茶を点てよう。
Items.MessageLocalize: Time to prepare some green tea...

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume04.11
Items.Message:
ふぅ…。
（鍛錬をしていると押しかけ師匠がやってくる…。どうしたものか）
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hm...
(Whenever I am training, that overbearing "mentor" keeps stopping by. What shall I do...)

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.1
Items.Message: 相伝の一閃、いざ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Behold the weight of legacy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.2
Items.Message:
はぁ…。
（以心伝心…面倒な技だ…）
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hm...
(Reading someone's wavelength...what a bothersome move.)

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.3
Items.Message: 明鏡止水。
Items.MessageLocalize: My mind was like the surface of a lake.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.4
Items.Message:
しかと胸に留めておこう。
受け継いだ剣技の意味を。
私が剣を振るう理由を。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will forever remember the meaning behind this legacy, the reason I wield this blade.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.5
Items.Message: 風より迅き一閃…ふっ。
Items.MessageLocalize: A flash, swifter than the wind... Hmm.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.6
Items.Message:
命のやり取りではなく、
剣を通して道を教わる、か。
よき営みだ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Using the sword not in a clash of lives,
but to learn the way forward, hm?
A fine path to tread.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.7
Items.Message:
バッグを背負うと下着が透ける？
あいにくそんなものは着けて
いない。私はさらし派だ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I might show my panties if I carry my bag like that?
I'm afraid to say I don't wear any to begin with.
I'm the type to go about exposed.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.8
Items.Message:
…閑さや岩にしみ入る蝉の声、
とはならないな。
ここは随分と、賑やかだ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
The sound of cicadas, seeps into the crags...
Is not an appropriate descriptor of this place.
It's quite lively here.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.9
Items.Message:
んくっ、んくっ、んくっ…ふう。
お前も飲むか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Glug, glug, glug... Phew.
Do you want a sip, too?

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.10
Items.Message:
師を先輩と呼んでみるか。…いや、
そもそも先輩部隊だったな。
忘れろ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Perhaps I should treat my teacher as my senior instead... No,
you were a senior squad to begin with.
Forget I said that.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume05.11
Items.Message:
風紀委員が似合いそう？
何を言っている。
叱られたいの意味もわからん。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Being in the disciplinary committee suits me...?
What are you on about?
What? You want me to scold you?

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.1
Items.Message: 相伝の一閃、いざ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Behold the weight of legacy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.2
Items.Message:
はぁ…。
（以心伝心…面倒な技だ…）
Items.MessageLocalize:
Hm...
(Reading someone's wavelength...what a bothersome move.)

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.3
Items.Message: 明鏡止水。
Items.MessageLocalize: My mind was like the surface of a lake.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.4
Items.Message:
しかと胸に留めておこう。
受け継いだ剣技の意味を。
私が剣を振るう理由を。
Items.MessageLocalize: I will forever remember the meaning behind this legacy, the reason I wield this blade.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.5
Items.Message: 友と一緒に食べる飯は、味が違うらしい…今なら、少しわかる。
Items.MessageLocalize: A meal that you enjoy with your friends is supposed to taste different... I think I'm starting to understand that now.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.6
Items.Message:
悪しきものよ。
我が剣舞にて祓い奉る！
散り逝け！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Fiend, know that my blade dance
shall vanquish all evil.
Now wither!

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.7
Items.Message: 心が澄む。それでいて、高揚している…イケイケ、というやつだな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Clear your mind, and let the exaltation naturally follow... Or I guess another way to put it... Get hype.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.8
Items.Message: 風に踊る花びらのように、華やかに舞ってみせよう。刀は、斬るだけのものではないのだから。
Items.MessageLocalize: Let me regale you with an elegant dance, like petals fluttering in the wind. A blade needs not only be for cutting down foes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.9
Items.Message: 私には華美が過ぎるが…よい衣だ。小笠原が見たら、驚くだろうか。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perhaps too flashy for me, but this is a good piece of garment. Perhaps Ogasahara would be surprised to see me wearing this.

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.10
Items.Message: なぜそんなに脇を凝視している？　もしや…太刀筋を読んでいるのか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Why do you gaze at my armpits like so? Could it be... Can you read my swordsmanship?

Items.Label: CardVoice.INatsume06.11
Items.Message: この衣、構造が複雑なんだ。和服とも洋服とも違う…むう…着替えを、手伝ってくれないか？
Items.MessageLocalize: This accouterment is complicated in structure. It's neither Japanese nor Western in nature... Mnh... Could you help me change?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.1
Items.Message: うちの背中についてきんさい！
Items.MessageLocalize: My way or da highway!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.2
Items.Message:
金星騎士二代目総長、
黒沢真希じゃ！夜露死苦！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm Maki Kurosawa,
second leader of da Hiroshima Venus Knights biker gang coalition!
Nice to meetcha!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.3
Items.Message:
この飴が気になるんか？
これはのぉ、甘いもんを食いたい
時に食うんじゃ。お前も食うか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Curious about my candy?
I pop one of dese in whenever I get a cravin' for somethin' sweet.
Want one?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.4
Items.Message:
ええか…
広島焼きっちゅー食いもんなんか
ありぁせんのじゃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Eh...
Fat chance of findin' any Hiroshima fried food around here,
am I right...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.5
Items.Message:
カフェテリアのスイーツ
全制覇したいなぁ…。
はっ！今聞いたことは忘れえ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I oughta sample all da sweets in da Cafeteria...
Ah! Forget ya heard dat.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.6
Items.Message:
露苦・怨！
特攻大車輪ーーーーー！！！
これで、終いじゃあ！
Items.MessageLocalize: LOCK ON! Kamikaze Rolloooooout! It's all over now!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.7
Items.Message: 出発じゃあぁ！気合入れていくぞぉーーー！！バルァルァルァルァーーーーーン！！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Let's roll! Give it yer all! VROOOOOOOOOOM!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.8
Items.Message:
お前も風を感じたいんか？
ほいじゃあ、ケツに乗りんさい。
一緒に走るぞ！ダチんこぉっ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ya wanna feel da wind, too?
Settle in behind me, den.
We'll ride together! Let's go!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.9
Items.Message: 全体止まれ！…今段ボールに入った捨て犬がおった気がする。
Items.MessageLocalize: Everybody, pull over! I tink I just saw an abandoned dog in a cardboard box.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.10
Items.Message:
尾崎はええ曲じゃが
バイクを盗んじゃいけん。
自前のバイクで走りんさい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Ozaki sings good,
but stealin' bikes is a no go.
Get wheels of yer own to ride.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa04.11
Items.Message:
全国制覇ゆうんは、全国にダチを
作るっちゅうことじゃ。一緒に
走りゃあ、もうファミリーじゃ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm gonna tour da whole country n' make
friends all over. When we all ride together,
we're pretty much one big family.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.1
Items.Message: うちの背中についてきんさい！
Items.MessageLocalize: My way or da highway!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.2
Items.Message:
金星騎士二代目総長、
黒沢真希じゃ！夜露死苦！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'm Maki Kurosawa,
second leader of da Hiroshima Venus Knights biker gang coalition!
Nice to meetcha!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.3
Items.Message:
この飴が気になるんか？
これはのぉ、甘いもんを食いたい
時に食うんじゃ。お前も食うか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Curious about my candy?
I pop one of dese in whenever I get a cravin' for somethin' sweet.
Want one?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.4
Items.Message:
ええか…
広島焼きっちゅー食いもんなんか
ありぁせんのじゃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Eh...
Fat chance of findin' any Hiroshima fried food around here,
am I right...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.5
Items.Message:
カフェテリアのスイーツ
全制覇したいなぁ…。
はっ！今聞いたことは忘れえ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I oughta sample all da sweets in da Cafeteria...
Ah! Forget ya heard dat.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.6
Items.Message:
見惚れとる間に夢うつつ。
ほれ、気付けじゃ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Gettin' so enamored dat ya fell inta a trance, eh?
Let's wake ya up den!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.7
Items.Message: この役…あーなんじゃったかのぉ。タイマン、じゃない…タンデム…はっ！　タンヤオじゃ！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Uh, what's dis hand called again... Ol' fashioned brawl...nah. Ridin' tandem...not dat either... Hah! Dat's right! All simples!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.8
Items.Message:
どこ見よんかようわかるのぉ。
今日は気分がええけえ、これで許しちゃる…卓につきんさい。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I can tell where ya's lookin'.
I'm feelin' good today, so I'll let it slide. Now come on over to the table with me.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.9
Items.Message: なんじゃお前、雨にうたれたんか？　寒いじゃろう、このふかふかのファーを使いんさい。
Items.MessageLocalize: What's wrong? Got caught in da rain? Must be cold, eh? Come, put dis fluffy fur coat on.

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.10
Items.Message: この煙か？　実はのぉ…裏でとっておきのお好み焼きを作っとるんじゃ。お前も食うてくか？
Items.MessageLocalize: Dis smoke? We're makin' some badass okonomiyaki inside right now, dontcha know. Ya want some too?

Items.Label: CardVoice.MKurosawa06.11
Items.Message:
ぷるっぷるの杏仁豆腐が食べたいなぁ…はっ！
今聞いたことは忘れぇ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
I could really go for some jiggly almond tofu pudding right now...
Hah! Forget what ya jus' heard!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.1
Items.Message: Ready, steady, die
Items.MessageLocalize: Ready, steady, die!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.2
Items.Message:
ヒーローは挫けない。泣かない。
逃げない。そして必ず勝つ。
このマスクに誓うわ。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Heroes never falter, cry, or run away.
And they never, ever lose!
I swear by this mask.

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.3
Items.Message:
Ｆ○ｃｋ！ん…？演技の練習よ。
どれだけキレのいいＦ○ｃｋ！を
言えるかで映画の出来が決まるわ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
F*CK! Mm? I'm practicin' my craft.
A picture hinges on how well
ya drop your F-bombs!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.4
Items.Message:
Ｗｈｙジャパニーズピーポー！？
どうしていつも人気投票で
ニンジャに勝てないのよ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
WHY, JAPANESE PEOPLE, WHY?!
Why is it that I can never beat
the ninja in the popularity polls?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.5
Items.Message:
ひゃっ！風でマスクが…！
あ、あのっ、あまりこっちを
み、見ないでください…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Whoa! The wind almost blew my mask off...!
E-Erm, could you...
look the other way...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.6
Items.Message:
ロマンティック、フォーユーよ！
ノ…ノォ～。きゃうん！
みゃう～…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Romantic for you!
N-No... Badump!
Aaah...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.7
Items.Message:
この瞬間だけはセラフ部隊の
キャロル・リーパーではなく、ただの
キャロラインで居させてください。

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.8
Items.Message:
わぁっ…！見てください、
メリーゴーランドですよ…！あっ、
ソーリー。はしゃぎすぎました…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Whoa...! Look at dat!
A merry-go-round...! Ah,
sorry. I got carried away...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.9
Items.Message:
今日はヒーローはholidayです…。
頑張って、おしゃれしてきたつもりなんですが…似合ってますか…？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Today's a holiday for heroes...
I tried to dress up for the occasion... Does it look good?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.10
Items.Message: ビューティフル…綺麗なイルミネーションです…えっ、アタシのほうが…？あ、あのっ、その…あぅ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Beautiful... The lighting's gorgeous...  Huh? I'm prettier...? A-Aaah, erm... Uh...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper05.11
Items.Message:
昔に着ていた服なんですが…その…
ちょっと胸が苦しく…
あ、あまり見ないでくださぃ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
These are old clothes of mine, but...
Uh... They're a bit tight around the chest...
A-Ah, please don't look...

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.1
Items.Message: Ready, steady, die
Items.MessageLocalize: Ready, steady, die!

And they never, ever lose!
I swear by this mask.

Items.MessageLocalize:

E-Erm, could you...
look the other way...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.6
Items.Message: カモン、ライトニング！ジャッジメントヘブンズスラッシュ！イェア！
Items.MessageLocalize: C'mon, lightning! Judgment Heaven Slash! Yeah!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.7
Items.Message: 神々しい純白のスーツに身を包んだ死神の名を持つダークヒーロー…光と闇が備わって最強に見えるわね！
Items.MessageLocalize: A anti-hero reaper, dressed in a pure white suit... The perfect balance of light and darkness!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.8
Items.Message: Ｇｏｄｄａｍｎ！　お昼に食べたカリーがついてたわ！　ヴリティカ！　これ、どうやって落とせばいいの！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Goddamn it! Lunch kari stained my clothes! Vritika, how d'ya get this stuff out?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.9
Items.Message: ひとの営みで輝く都市にも悪しきヴィランは潜んでる。けどもう大丈夫。なぜかって？　アタシが来たわ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Vile villains threaten da citizenry. But they're safe now. Why's that? Cuz I'm here!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.10
Items.Message: 裾が汚れている？ノープロブレム！　アナタを守れたなら、スーツの汚れも勲章よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: My sleeve's all dirty? No problem! So long as I'm protectin' the people, every stain's a medal!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper06.11
Items.Message: 露出は少ないですが…んっ、ヒップやバストが窮屈で…あぅ、ボディラインが丸見えですぅ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It don't show much skin, but... Mmgh, it's tight around da waist n' bust... Aaah, it's showin' off my curves!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.1
Items.Message: Ready, steady, die
Items.MessageLocalize: Ready, steady, die!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.2
Items.Message:

逃げない。そして必ず勝つ。

あ、あのっ、あまりこっちを
み、見ないでください…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Whoa! The wind almost blew my mask off...!
E-Erm, could you...
look the other way...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.6
Items.Message:
本場の味をティーチするわ！
ここよ！
It's so アメリカン！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I'll teach ya a little somethin' from back home!
Right here!
It's so American!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.7
Items.Message: 元気がない時こそミートを食べなさい！　一口食べればあっという間に元気ＭＡＸになるわ！
Items.MessageLocalize: When life gets ya down, gotta turn to the meats! One bite, and you got max power!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.8
Items.Message: ステーキとコークで健康に悪いなんてありえないわ！　ミニトマトが２個もあるからノープロブレムよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: No way steak n' coke's bad for your health! Gulp down a coupla cherry tomatoes n' you're good to go!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.9
Items.Message: 昼はダイナーで働くウェスタンガール、夜は悪党をこらしめるガンマン…なんて映画はどうかしら！
Items.MessageLocalize: Waitress by day, gun gal huntin' down villains by night...Howzat for a pitch?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.10
Items.Message: ひゃっ！　コークの雫がおへそにぃ…きゃあっ！　今度はステーキソースが胸元にぃ…！
Items.MessageLocalize: Eeek! Got some coke in my belly button... Eeep! And now I got steak sauce on my chest...!

Items.Label: CardVoice.CReaper07.11
Items.Message: 待たせたわね、キャロルのヒーローステーキセットよ！　スペシャルサービスであーんもしてあげるわ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Sorry for the wait, got'cher Carole's Hero Steak meal! And as a special service, I'll spoonfeed it to you, too!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.1
Items.Message: 我が覇道を見よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Follow in my footsteps!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.2
Items.Message: 諸葛孔明を越える偉業を成すことが偉大な祖先への敬意となろう。
Items.MessageLocalize: To accomplish something greater than Zhuge Liang achieved in life is, I believe, the greatest form of respect to my ancestor.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.3
Items.Message: ぬわーー！ ３１Ｘの連中がまたバラバラに戦闘しおるーー！ わらわの策に従わぬーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aghhh! Commanding 31-X in battle is like trying to herd cats!!! They completely refuse to follow my strategies!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.4
Items.Message: もし、このような荒れた世界でなければ、わらわは星々の探求を続けておったのかもしれぬな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perhaps, if the world was not ravaged as it is now, I would have continued to chase the stars as before...

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.5
Items.Message:
わらわこそが傾国の夢見鳥…。
さあ、進むが良い！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Bewitching are my charms...
Now, march forth for me!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.6
Items.Message: 世が世なら、わらわの美貌で国が傾いておったやもしれんな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perhaps in a different time, my beauty would have destroyed kingdoms.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.7
Items.Message: ふふっ…抑えることも隠すことも出来ぬ高貴なオーラに見とれようと咎めはせぬ。一時酔いしれよ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Haha... I can neither hide nor hold back this regal aura of mine, so I will not fault you for staring. Take a moment to gander at my grace.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.8
Items.Message: ３１Ｘの誰もこの衣装に触れてくれぬ…。唯一シャロだけが、ルカに着せたい…などと言いおったわーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: No one in 31-X is willing to wear this outfit...except for Charlotta, who was rambling about wanting to make Ruka wear it!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.9
Items.Message: この絢爛にして美麗な装いこそ我が国の伝統衣装よ。どうだ、華やかであろう。
Items.MessageLocalize: This luxurious and beautiful garment is a traditional costume of my country. Breathtaking, isn't it?

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.10
Items.Message: どれ、わらわが舞を披露してやろう。戦の前に士気を高めるのも軍師の役目。見惚れ過ぎるなよ？
Items.MessageLocalize: Shall I dance for you? It is, after all, a tactician's responsibility to keep troop morale high. But don't get TOO enamored by my beauty.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua04.11
Items.Message: うぬは少々見過ぎではないか…？ もう少し遠慮せよ。さすがに…その…恥ずかしくなってきたわ…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Mind your eyes! You're staring far too much. It's frankly, um... rather embarrassing...

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.1
Items.Message: 我が覇道を見よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Follow in my footsteps!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.2
Items.Message: 諸葛孔明を越える偉業を成すことが偉大な祖先への敬意となろう。
Items.MessageLocalize: To accomplish something greater than Zhuge Liang achieved in life is, I believe, the greatest form of respect to my ancestor.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.3
Items.Message: ぬわーー！ ３１Ｘの連中がまたバラバラに戦闘しおるーー！ わらわの策に従わぬーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aghhh! Commanding 31-X in battle is like trying to herd cats!!! They completely refuse to follow my strategies!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.4
Items.Message: もし、このような荒れた世界でなければ、わらわは星々の探求を続けておったのかもしれぬな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perhaps, if the world was not ravaged as it is now, I would have continued to chase the stars as before...

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.5
Items.Message:
よくわらわを見つけたな。
だが軍師の暇は備えと知れ！
Items.MessageLocalize:
You have done well to find me.
But you would do well to know that a tactician is always prepared!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.6
Items.Message:
普段のほうがエロいだと？この胸元の魅力が理解出来ぬのか！って
わらわは何を見せつけておるーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize:
My usual outfit is sexier? You just don't understand my chest's charm!
Wait, why am I showing it off?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.7
Items.Message:
ええい！さっきから頭のお団子を
ぽんぽん触るな！折角まとめたのに、
崩れてしまうであろう！
Items.MessageLocalize:
Grr! Stop touching my hair dumplings!
Tying them up takes so much work, do not ruin my hairstyling!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.8
Items.Message:
これはタンフールという宋の時代に
誕生した菓子で…食べさせて欲しい？
し、痴れ者め！自分で買え！
Items.MessageLocalize:
This is called Tanghulu, a treat from the Song dynasty... Would you like a taste?
H-Hmph, fool! Buy your own!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.9
Items.Message:
胸元のハートを見たシャロが
なるほど…と言ってどこかへ消えたのだ。あれはなんだったのだ…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
When Charl saw the heart on my chest,
she said, "I see," and ran off somewhere. What was that about...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.10
Items.Message:
この格好は軍師然としとらん。
可愛すぎるのだ…。いや、逆に敵を
欺くため、アリかもしれんな。
Items.MessageLocalize:
This outfit does not suit a tactician.
'Tis too cute... But prehaps
it will prove effective for fooling the enemy.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua05.11
Items.Message:
皮肉なものだな。
鮮やかに街を彩るネオンが、
星々の瞬きを遠いものにしておる。
Items.MessageLocalize:
It is ironic.
The brighter the neon lights the streets,
the more distant the twinkling of the stars becomes.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.1
Items.Message: 我が覇道を見よ！
Items.MessageLocalize: Follow in my footsteps!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.2
Items.Message: 諸葛孔明を越える偉業を成すことが偉大な祖先への敬意となろう。
Items.MessageLocalize: To accomplish something greater than Zhuge Liang achieved in life is, I believe, the greatest form of respect to my ancestor.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.3
Items.Message: ぬわーー！ ３１Ｘの連中がまたバラバラに戦闘しおるーー！ わらわの策に従わぬーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Aghhh! Commanding 31-X in battle is like trying to herd cats!!! They completely refuse to follow my strategies!!!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.4
Items.Message: もし、このような荒れた世界でなければ、わらわは星々の探求を続けておったのかもしれぬな。
Items.MessageLocalize: Perhaps, if the world was not ravaged as it is now, I would have continued to chase the stars as before...

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.5
Items.Message: どこを見ておる！　人の胸元を見ながら肉まんと言うでないわーーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: I see the line of your gaze! And do not mention meat buns while staring at my chest!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.6
Items.Message: 踊れ踊れ踊れ、大軍師の婚礼、踊り明かすがよい！
Items.MessageLocalize: Dance, dance, dance! At this master strategist's wedding, we dance the night away!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.7
Items.Message: 黙っておらず正直に感想を申してみよ。胸下の穴がセクシャル…だと！？　セクシャルなのはうぬの頭だー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Do not stand dumbfounded, speak your mind. The hole is the underbust is very...naughty?! Your mind is the only naughty thing here!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.8
Items.Message: シャロは面倒ではあるが、愛情が深く優しい子だ。わらわはそんなところが…待て、深い意味はないぞ！？
Items.MessageLocalize: Charl can indeed be difficult, but she is a kind and affectionate girl. I find it most...wait, no, I intend no deeper meaning!

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.9
Items.Message: ふふ。何を惚けておる。見惚れていないで、わらわをエスコートしてみせよ。チンアイデァ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Heheh, why the vacant stare? Enough standing and admiring me, you have a duty to escort me properly, qin'aide.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.10
Items.Message: ドレス姿で階段を降りるのは優雅でよいものだ。ふむ、花びらの舞い方がイマイチだ。もう一往復行くぞ。
Items.MessageLocalize: It is an elegant moment when one descends a staircase in such a dress. Hm, the petals are not falling correctly. Come, we try again.

Items.Label: CardVoice.LShanhua07.11
Items.Message: ぬわーー！　プロポーズに三顧の礼とはどういうつもりだーー！　断るぞ！　流石に断るからなーー！
Items.MessageLocalize: Nuha?! What are you getting at with all these dignified marriage proposals?! Are you trying to be Liu Bei?! I decline! I reject you, understand?!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.1
Items.Message: 真実はひとつだけ
Items.MessageLocalize: There's only one truth.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.2
Items.Message:
どんな難事件も名探偵
アイリーン・レドメインがＱＥＤ
してみせましょう！えっへん！
Items.MessageLocalize:
No matter the mystery,
Master Detective Irene Redmayne
will always find her QED! Eheh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.3
Items.Message:
ジェイミーがパンツばかり盗むせい
で皆さんがどんなのを履いているか
覚えてしまいました…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
With Jamie stealing panties all the time,
I've memorized what
kind everyone wears...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.4
Items.Message:
おかしいですね。名探偵が居るのに
依頼が舞い込んでこない…。これは
もしかして何者かによる陰謀…？
Items.MessageLocalize: It's strange. A master detective is sitting here, waiting, but no cases come in... Is someone conspiring against me...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.5
Items.Message:
予告通り参上。今宵は怪盗。
華麗に奪い取ります！
Items.MessageLocalize:
I've arrived, as per the calling card.
Tonight, I am a phantom thief,
and I'll gracefully snatch everything away!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.6
Items.Message:
いけませんね。こんな夜中に
ひとりで居ては。手癖の悪い怪盗に
ハートを盗まれてしまいますよ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
Oh, you shouldn't walk around
all alone at this time of night. What if
a phantom thief's sticky fingers snatched your heart away?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.7
Items.Message:
え、この宝石持って帰っていいん
ですか！？やったー！！って、
全部おもちゃじゃないですか！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Huh, I can take these jewels back with me?! Yay! Wait, they're all fake!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.8
Items.Message:
この衣装、足を出しすぎだとマリア
さんに叱られました。ですが映夏さんほどセクシャルじゃないですよ？
Items.MessageLocalize:
This outfit shows too much leg. Maria's going to give me an earful...
But it's still not as sexy as Yingxia's outfit...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.9
Items.Message:
どんな宝石よりも輝くものを知っていますか？それは誰かのために
必死になれる真摯な想いです。
Items.MessageLocalize:
Do you know what shines brighter than any jewel?
It's the sincerity that drives us to work hard for another!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.10
Items.Message:
あたしを捕まえたければ
アイリーン・レドメインを
連れてきてください。…なんてね。
Items.MessageLocalize:
If you want to catch me,
then bring Irene Redmayne...
Just having a laugh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne04.11
Items.Message:
名探偵と怪盗、隠しているものを
見つけたがるという点では
紙一重だと思いませんか？
Items.MessageLocalize:
A master detective and phantom thief
both uncover that which is hidden.
Two sides of the same coin, don't you think?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.1
Items.Message: 真実はひとつだけ
Items.MessageLocalize: There's only one truth.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.2
Items.Message:
どんな難事件も名探偵
アイリーン・レドメインがＱＥＤ
してみせましょう！えっへん！
Items.MessageLocalize:
No matter the mystery,
Master Detective Irene Redmayne
will always find her QED! Eheh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.3
Items.Message:
ジェイミーがパンツばかり盗むせい
で皆さんがどんなのを履いているか
覚えてしまいました…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
With Jamie stealing panties all the time,
I've memorized what
kind everyone wears...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.4
Items.Message:
おかしいですね。名探偵が居るのに
依頼が舞い込んでこない…。これは
もしかして何者かによる陰謀…？
Items.MessageLocalize: It's strange. A master detective is sitting here, waiting, but no cases come in... Is someone conspiring against me...?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.5
Items.Message: うう…謎が足りない…。このままでは名探偵とは名ばかりのただの美少女になってしまいます…。
Items.MessageLocalize: Aaah, I'm not solving enough mysteries... I'm going to end up as nothing but a cutie with a detective aesthetic...

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.6
Items.Message: 春の訪れです！　事件も絶景も逃しません！　えへっ。
Items.MessageLocalize: Spring cometh! Thrilling scenery and mysteries abound! Eheh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.7
Items.Message: たまには可憐に少女らしく…って、あわわ、風でスカートが！　見ないでくださいーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: It's nice to dress up lovely sometimes... Ah, aaah, the wind blew up my skirt! Don't look!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.8
Items.Message:
お花畑と、ひっそり佇むお家。
サセックスの住処で、ホームズも
こんな景色を見たんでしょうか。
Items.MessageLocalize: A lone house, standing atop a field of flowers... Did Holmes have a view like this from his abode at Sussex?

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.9
Items.Message: 折角の休日なのでカメラを用意しました。これで綺麗な風景も事件の瞬間も逃しませんよ！
Items.MessageLocalize: I got a camera for my day off. I'll capture all the lovely sights and all the riveting mysteries in my shutter!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.10
Items.Message: これで証拠写真をばっちり激写です…って、盗撮犯じゃないですーーー！！　誤解ですーーー！！
Items.MessageLocalize: Now I've got some compelling photographic evidence... Wait, no, I'm not a peeping tom!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne05.11
Items.Message: わぁ！　一面の花畑！　こんな景色が見られるなんて…まさに自然からの贈り物ですね！
Items.MessageLocalize: Whoa, flowers in all directions! Such a majestic scene... It's truly a gift from nature!

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne07.1
Items.Message: 真実はひとつだけ
Items.MessageLocalize: There's only one truth.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne07.2
Items.Message:
どんな難事件も名探偵
アイリーン・レドメインがＱＥＤ
してみせましょう！えっへん！
Items.MessageLocalize:
No matter the mystery,
Master Detective Irene Redmayne
will always find her QED! Eheh.

Items.Label: CardVoice.IRedmayne07.3
Items.Message:
ジェイミーがパンツばかり盗むせい
で皆さんがどんなのを履いているか
覚えてしまいました…。
Items.MessageLocalize:
With Jamie stealing panties all the time,
I've memorized what
kind everyone wears...
